title: 道具与装饰（树石花草、装饰种类、各风格包特有物件、家具与庭院陈列、采集点、过场特写卡）

subject.zh: 村边孤立的铁杉：塔形针叶树，高约 5 到 6 米，树冠由下而上层层收窄，针叶深绿 #3d6b3a 到暗绿 #1e2a1c 分三阶，树皮红褐带竖裂，下部枝条略下垂，根部露出几道粗根。
subject.en: A lone ironhemlock at the village edge: a conical conifer about 5 to 6 meters tall, tiers of branches narrowing toward the top, needles in three steps from deep green #3d6b3a to dark green #1e2a1c, reddish brown bark with vertical cracks, lower boughs drooping slightly, a few thick roots showing at the base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格幼树，约 3 米，枝叶稀；第 2 格标准成树，约 5 米，对称塔形；第 3 格老树，约 6 米，树冠略歪向一侧；第 4 格断了树梢的老树，顶部枯成灰褐。
extra.en: Cell 1: a young tree about 3 m with sparse boughs; cell 2: a standard mature tree about 5 m, a symmetrical cone; cell 3: an old tree about 6 m with the crown leaning to one side; cell 4: an old tree with a broken top that has died back to grey brown.

items.notes: 树干底部正中贴格底；与边地野林的铁杉是同一树种，这里是村边的孤树，枝叶比林中的稀、颜色略亮。

subject.zh: 村中的阔叶老橡：短粗的灰褐树干分出三四根粗枝，撑起宽圆的树冠，高约 5 米、冠宽约 4 米；叶团用 #8fb35a、#5a8a3a、#3d6b3a 三阶色块加有序抖动，树皮有深纵纹与一两个树瘤。
subject.en: An old broadleaf oak in the village: a short thick grey brown trunk splitting into three or four heavy limbs under a broad round crown, about 5 m tall and 4 m wide; leaf clusters in three steps #8fb35a, #5a8a3a, #3d6b3a with ordered dithering, deeply furrowed bark with one or two burls.

extra.zh: 第 1 格较年轻的橡树，约 4 米，冠圆而紧；第 2 格标准老橡，约 5 米，冠宽圆；第 3 格冠偏向左侧的老橡，一根粗枝横伸；第 4 格秋天的老橡，叶团转为赭黄 #b4823a 与褐色。
extra.en: Cell 1: a younger oak about 4 m with a tight round crown; cell 2: a standard old oak about 5 m with a broad round crown; cell 3: an old oak with the crown leaning left and one heavy limb reaching sideways; cell 4: the old oak in autumn, leaf clusters turned ochre #b4823a and brown.

items.notes: M0 全链路样板：树冠只用 3 到 4 阶色块与抖动，不画平滑渐变；受光侧在左上，树干底部贴格底正中。

subject.zh: 农家果园的苹果树：矮而歪的灰褐树干，约 3.5 米高，枝条向四周伸开，树冠低而疏，适合放在民居院后与果园里；叶片中绿 #5a8a3a，果实小而圆，红黄相间。
subject.en: A farmstead apple tree: a short crooked grey brown trunk about 3.5 m tall, branches spreading outward under a low open crown, suited to backyards and orchards; leaves mid green #5a8a3a, small round fruit mixed red and yellow.

extra.zh: 第 1 格春天开花，枝上满是白中带粉的小花；第 2 格夏天，绿叶间挂着青果；第 3 格秋天，红黄苹果挂满枝，树下落了几个；第 4 格冬天，光秃的枝条，枝头留着一两个干果。
extra.en: Cell 1: spring, the boughs covered in small white and pink blossoms; cell 2: summer, green fruit among the leaves; cell 3: autumn, red and yellow apples crowding the boughs, a few fallen beneath; cell 4: winter, bare branches with one or two shriveled fruits left.

items.notes: 四格是同一棵树的四季，树干与枝形保持一致，只换叶与果；果实每颗至少 2 像素，免得缩小后消失。

subject.zh: 田野与路边的灰色花岗岩大石：圆钝的块状巨石，高 1.5 到 3 米，石面灰 #8a8780 带浅黄绿地衣斑，底部长着一圈短草，顶面受光，右下暗面带几道裂缝。
subject.en: A grey granite boulder by fields and roads: a blunt rounded block 1.5 to 3 m tall, stone grey #8a8780 with pale yellow green lichen patches, a ring of short grass at the base, the top catching the light, a few cracks on the darker lower right face.

extra.zh: 第 1 格矮宽的大石，约 1.5 米；第 2 格高耸的大石，约 3 米，顶部略尖；第 3 格两块靠在一起的大石；第 4 格从中裂开一道缝的大石，缝里长着草。
extra.en: Cell 1: a low wide boulder about 1.5 m; cell 2: a tall boulder about 3 m with a slightly pointed top; cell 3: two boulders leaning together; cell 4: a boulder split by a crack with grass growing in it.

items.notes: 石面每种材质 2 到 3 级明暗，不画高光过曝；会阻挡的石头由空间层决定，这里只画外观。

subject.zh: 田边与路旁的野石：几块大小不一的灰褐卵石与棱角石，最大的到膝盖高（约 0.5 米），石缝间夹着几根草，颜色在 #8a8780 与 #7a6a52 之间。
subject.en: Fieldstones by fields and paths: a few grey brown cobbles and angular rocks of different sizes, the largest knee high (about 0.5 m), a few blades of grass between them, colors between #8a8780 and #7a6a52.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散开的小石；第 2 格堆成小堆的田边拣石；第 3 格一块半埋在土里的扁石；第 4 格一圈围成火塘形状的石头。
extra.en: Cell 1: three small scattered stones; cell 2: a small pile of stones cleared from a field; cell 3: a flat stone half buried in the soil; cell 4: a ring of stones laid out like a fire pit.

items.notes: 尺寸都很小，像素少；每块石头用 2 级明暗加 1 像素深色描边即可，别画成碎渣。

subject.zh: 乡间灌丛：榛子与接骨木一类的圆团灌木，高约 1.2 米，叶团中绿到暗绿两三阶，枝条在底部露出，偶有浆果或白花点缀，适合放在栅栏边与屋角。
subject.en: A country shrub: round clumps of hazel and elder, about 1.2 m tall, leaves in two or three steps from mid to dark green, twigs showing at the base, sometimes dotted with berries or white flowers, for fence lines and house corners.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆团的榛子灌丛；第 2 格开着白色伞形小花的接骨木；第 3 格结着紫黑浆果的接骨木；第 4 格矮而宽的一丛，被修剪过。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round hazel clump; cell 2: elder with flat white flower clusters; cell 3: elder with purple black berries; cell 4: a low wide clump that has been trimmed.

items.notes: 浆果用暗紫偏黑的小点，面积很小，不要做成大面积澱紫；底边贴格底。

subject.zh: 草地上的野花丛：一簇齐膝以下的野花与草叶，约 0.4 米高，花朵是几像素的小色点，混着虞美人红、雏菊白与矢车菊蓝，叶片用浅绿 #8fb35a 与中绿两阶。
subject.en: A clump of meadow wildflowers: flowers and grass blades below knee height, about 0.4 m, blossoms as tiny dots of a few pixels in poppy red, daisy white and cornflower blue, leaves in two steps of light green #8fb35a and mid green.

extra.zh: 第 1 格以红色虞美人为主；第 2 格以白色雏菊为主；第 3 格以蓝色矢车菊为主；第 4 格三色混杂的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly red poppies; cell 2: mostly white daisies; cell 3: mostly blue cornflowers; cell 4: a mixed clump of all three colors.

items.notes: 花朵要小而稀，像撒在草里的色点，不要画成花束；不画地面草皮。

subject.zh: 乡镇路灯：一根约 2.6 米高的深褐方木柱 #6b4a32，顶端伸出一截铁弯臂，挂着四面玻璃的黑铁提灯，灯顶是小尖帽，柱脚用两块石头楔住；木纹与铁锈清楚可见。
subject.en: A village street lamp: a dark brown square wooden post #6b4a32 about 2.6 m tall, an iron bracket arm at the top holding a four-paned black iron lantern with a small pointed cap, the foot wedged with two stones; wood grain and rust clearly visible.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是单臂挂一盏提灯的木柱路灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是顶上直接坐一盏方灯的短木柱的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the single-arm post with one hanging lantern, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a short post with a square lamp sitting on top, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: M0 全链路样板：入夜由渲染层按点亮格换图并登记光源，所以熄灭格里玻璃是灰暗的，点亮格只在灯罩里画暖光 #ffd58a。

subject.zh: 广场石井：灰石砌成的圆形井圈，齐腰高，井口上方两根木柱撑着双坡小木顶，顶下横着辘轳与绳，绳端挂一只木桶；石缝有苔，木顶用陶红瓦 #a8543a，整体高约 2.5 米。
subject.en: A village square well: a round wellhead of grey fieldstone at waist height, two wooden posts above it holding a small gabled roof, a windlass with rope under the roof and a wooden bucket on the rope; moss in the joints, terracotta tiles #a8543a on the little roof, about 2.5 m tall overall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带陶红瓦小顶与辘轳的完整石井；第 2 格只有井圈与木架、没有顶的简易井；第 3 格茅草小顶的旧井，井圈缺了一块石头；第 4 格盖着木板井盖的井，辘轳绳收起。
extra.en: Cell 1: the complete stone well with a terracotta roof and windlass; cell 2: a simple well with only the wellhead and a wooden frame, no roof; cell 3: an old well with a thatched roof and one stone missing from the rim; cell 4: a well closed with a plank lid, the windlass rope wound up.

items.notes: M0 全链路样板：井口画成略带俯视的椭圆，看得见一点井内暗色；高度按人体（井圈到腰）。

subject.zh: 橡木桶：腰鼓形的木桶，高约 0.9 米，桶板是浅木色 #9a7448 带深色木缝，上下两道黑铁箍，桶盖木板拼成，侧面有一个木塞孔。
subject.en: An oak barrel: a bellied cask about 0.9 m tall, staves of light wood #9a7448 with dark seams, two black iron hoops top and bottom, a lid of fitted planks, a wooden bung hole on the side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格立着的完整木桶；第 2 格两只并排的木桶，一只略小；第 3 格横放在木架上的木桶；第 4 格开了盖、桶里盛着水的旧木桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a complete upright barrel; cell 2: two barrels side by side, one slightly smaller; cell 3: a barrel lying on a wooden cradle; cell 4: an old barrel with its lid off, filled with water.

items.notes: M0 全链路样板：桶身按人体约到大腿高；铁箍用金属灰，不用纯黑描边。

subject.zh: 木板箱：浅黄褐松木板钉成的方箱，约 0.8 米见方，板缝清楚，四角钉着深色木条，侧面有一个烙上去的小圆记号（不是字），适合放在店后、码头与仓库门口。
subject.en: A wooden crate: a square box of pale yellow brown pine boards about 0.8 m on a side, clear seams, dark wooden battens nailed at the corners, a small branded round mark on the side (not lettering), for shop backs, docks and storehouse doors.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道深色斜绑带的单箱；第 2 格两道交叉绑带的单箱；第 3 格两只叠起来的箱子；第 4 格撬开了盖、露出干草填料的箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single crate with one dark diagonal strap; cell 2: a single crate with two crossed straps; cell 3: two crates stacked; cell 4: a crate with its lid pried open showing straw packing.

items.notes: M0 全链路样板：第 1、2 格对应地图数据的变体 0、1；烙印只是圆形图案，不写任何字。

subject.zh: 乡镇木路牌：一根约 1.8 米高的深褐木柱，钉着削尖一头的浅木指向板，或挂着一块带小檐的告示板，板上钉着几张米白纸片，纸面只有灰色短横线，看不出是字。
subject.en: A village wooden signpost: a dark brown post about 1.8 m tall with pale wooden arrow boards cut to a point, or a notice board with a small roof edge carrying a few cream paper sheets marked only with grey dashes that do not read as writing.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两块指向板朝左右的岔口路牌；第 2 格三块指向板错开的路牌；第 3 格带小雨檐、钉着纸片的告示板；第 4 格歪斜的旧路牌，指向板裂了一块。
extra.en: Cell 1: a crossroads post with two arrow boards pointing left and right; cell 2: a post with three staggered arrow boards; cell 3: a notice board with a small rain hood and pinned paper sheets; cell 4: a leaning old signpost with one cracked arrow board.

items.notes: 不写任何字：指向板空白或只有刻出的箭头纹；告示纸上只有灰色短线。地名由界面层绘制。

subject.zh: 原木木栅一段：三根削尖的直立木桩，中间钉两道横木，高约 1.2 米、宽约 2 米，木色从浅褐 #9a7448 到深褐 #6b4a32，桩头有劈痕，适合围院子、菜畦与牲口栏。
subject.en: A section of log fence: three upright stakes cut to points with two rails nailed between them, about 1.2 m tall and 2 m wide, wood from light brown #9a7448 to dark brown #6b4a32, split marks on the stake tops, for yards, vegetable plots and livestock pens.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的一段直栅；第 2 格一端是转角立桩的栅段；第 3 格横木断了一根、斜挂着的旧栅；第 4 格开着一扇木栅门的栅段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a complete straight section; cell 2: a section ending in a corner post; cell 3: an old section with one rail broken and hanging; cell 4: a section with a small wooden gate standing open.

items.notes: 左右两端要能接上下一段（桩在两端），不画地面；高度按人体到腰。

subject.zh: 集市木货摊：约 2.8 米宽的木摊，两根立柱撑起条纹布棚，棚布是色条与米白相间，摊台上摆着几个藤筐，筐里是苹果、面包与成捆的草药，摊台下方挂着布帘。
subject.en: A wooden market stall: a stand about 2.8 m wide, two posts holding a striped cloth awning in colored and cream bands, baskets on the counter holding apples, bread and bundled herbs, a cloth skirt hanging under the counter.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红白条纹棚，摊上是苹果；第 2 格蓝白条纹棚，摊上是面包；第 3 格绿白条纹棚，摊上是草药与蔬菜；第 4 格赭黄 #b4823a 布棚，摊上是陶罐与布匹。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red and white striped awning with apples on the counter; cell 2: a blue and white striped awning with bread; cell 3: a green and white striped awning with herbs and vegetables; cell 4: an ochre #b4823a awning with clay pots and cloth bolts.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应地图数据的变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；货品是小色块，不写价签。

subject.zh: 木长椅：约 1.8 米长的浅褐木长椅，椅面三块木板拼成，四条方腿，椅面高到膝盖，木板边缘被坐得圆润发亮，椅腿下部颜色更深。
subject.en: A wooden bench: a light brown bench about 1.8 m long, the seat of three planks on four square legs, seat at knee height, plank edges worn smooth and glossy, the lower legs darker.

extra.zh: 第 1 格无靠背的长凳；第 2 格带木靠背的长椅；第 3 格一端放着一只篮子的长凳；第 4 格一条腿垫着石块的旧长凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a backless bench; cell 2: a bench with a wooden backrest; cell 3: a bench with a basket on one end; cell 4: an old bench with one leg propped on a stone.

items.notes: 椅面到膝盖（约 0.45 米），整张图里椅子显得矮宽；不画坐着的人。

subject.zh: 镇旗：约 3.5 米高的深褐木旗杆，顶端一颗铁球，横杆下垂挂一面长方布旗，旗尾剪成燕尾，旗面中央是一枚简单的金黄菱形纹章（不是字），布面有两道褶。
subject.en: A town banner: a dark brown wooden pole about 3.5 m tall topped with an iron ball, a crossbar from which hangs a long rectangular cloth banner with a swallowtail end, a simple golden lozenge emblem in the center (not lettering), two folds in the cloth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红底 #8a2e2a 旗；第 2 格蓝底 #3e4a7a 旗；第 3 格陶红与米白分色的旗；第 4 格赭黄底、边缘磨破的旧旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red #8a2e2a banner; cell 2: a blue #3e4a7a banner; cell 3: a banner split terracotta and cream; cell 4: an old ochre banner with frayed edges.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应地图数据的变体 0、1；旗杆底部贴格底正中，旗面不随风大幅飘动。

subject.zh: 铁火盆：三根弯脚的黑铁架托着一只宽口铁盆，高约 1 米，盆里堆着柴块与炭，盆沿有锈与烟熏的黑痕，火焰从盆口向上收成尖。
subject.en: An iron brazier: a wide iron bowl on three curved black iron legs, about 1 m tall, logs and charcoal heaped inside, rust and soot marks on the rim, flames rising from the bowl and narrowing to a point.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格三脚铁盆，火势中等；第 2 格更大的四脚铁盆，火势旺；第 3 格石砌底座上的矮铁盆；第 4 格挂在三脚架下的吊盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the three-legged bowl with a medium fire; cell 2: a larger four-legged bowl with a strong fire; cell 3: a low iron bowl on a stone base; cell 4: a bowl hung beneath a tripod.

items.notes: 火盆一直点着，渲染层固定登记光源；火焰只用暖色硬边色块，不画烟雾大团与光晕。

subject.zh: 广场石像：灰石雕成的旧日守边人，披斗篷、双手拄着一柄长剑立在方形石座上，连座约 3 米高；风化得厉害，脸部只剩圆润的轮廓，没有五官细节，肩头有鸟粪白斑与苔。
subject.en: A square statue: an old border warden carved in grey stone, cloaked, both hands resting on a longsword, standing on a square plinth, about 3 m tall with the base; heavily weathered, the face only a smooth outline without features, white bird droppings and moss on the shoulders.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的守边人石像；第 2 格剑尖断掉的石像；第 3 格石座下摆着野花与小石子的石像；第 4 格只剩半身、上半截倒在座旁的残像。
extra.en: Cell 1: the complete warden statue; cell 2: the statue with the sword tip broken off; cell 3: the statue with wildflowers and pebbles laid at the plinth; cell 4: a ruined statue with only the lower half, the upper half fallen beside the plinth.

items.notes: 石像不能像任何真实人物，脸部故意风化成无五官；石座上不刻字。

subject.zh: 墓园墓碑：灰石或深褐木做的单人墓标，高 0.7 到 1 米，立在一小块长着短草的土丘前，石面有风化与苔点，碑面只有简单的刻线边框，没有字。
subject.en: A graveyard marker: a single grave marker of grey stone or dark brown wood, 0.7 to 1 m tall, standing before a small grassy mound, the stone weathered with moss spots, the face carrying only a simple carved border with no lettering.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶石墓碑；第 2 格立柱加横木的木墓标；第 3 格向后倾斜的旧石碑，半埋在草里；第 4 格前面放着一束干花的方石碑。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped headstone; cell 2: a wooden marker of a post with a crossbar; cell 3: an old headstone tilting back, half sunk in grass; cell 4: a square stone with a bunch of dried flowers before it.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应地图数据的变体 0、1；横木墓标是本世界的普通墓标，不要画成任何现实宗教的符号；碑面不写字。

subject.zh: 草垛：金黄 #c9b98f 干草堆成的圆顶草垛，约 2 米高，表面用硬边色块表现草束的层次，顶上压着一根木杆或几块石头，底部散着几缕干草。
subject.en: A haystack: a dome of golden #c9b98f hay about 2 m tall, its surface showing layered bundles in hard-edged color steps, a wooden pole or a few stones weighting the top, a few loose wisps scattered at the base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶大草垛；第 2 格中间立一根木杆的锥形草垛；第 3 格三个方草捆叠成的小堆；第 4 格被扒走一半的草垛，露出内部较新的绿黄色。
extra.en: Cell 1: a large dome haystack; cell 2: a conical haystack around a central pole; cell 3: a small stack of three square bales; cell 4: a half-dug haystack showing fresher green yellow inside.

items.notes: 草色在 #c9b98f 与 #b4823a 之间，不要画成大块平涂；不画地面。

subject.zh: 木推车：两个辐条木轮的手推车，车厢是浅木板钉成的敞口箱，约 2.5 米长（含两根推杆），车轮包着铁圈，车厢里铺着麻布，推杆落地时用一根短木支着。
subject.en: A wooden handcart: a two-wheeled cart with spoked wooden wheels, an open box of pale planks, about 2.5 m long including the two handles, iron tires on the wheels, sacking spread in the box, a short prop stick holding it level when the handles rest.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空车；第 2 格装着干草的车；第 3 格装着两只木桶与布袋的车；第 4 格缺了一个轮子、斜靠在地上的破车。
extra.en: Cell 1: an empty cart; cell 2: a cart loaded with hay; cell 3: a cart carrying two barrels and sacks; cell 4: a broken cart missing one wheel, tilted onto the ground.

items.notes: 车身侧面朝镜头略带俯视，看得见车厢内部；推杆朝画面右侧。

subject.zh: 林中高大的铁杉：笔直的深褐 #5a3e2a 树干，约 6 米高，枝层密而下垂，针叶从 #2e5a30 到 #121c10 三阶，比村边孤树更暗更密，树冠下部有枯枝，树皮挂着一缕灰绿苔。
subject.en: A tall ironhemlock in the deep wood: a straight dark brown #5a3e2a trunk about 6 m tall, dense drooping tiers of boughs, needles in three steps from #2e5a30 to #121c10, darker and denser than the lone village tree, dead twigs low on the crown, a strand of grey green moss on the bark.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准成树；第 2 格更高更瘦的老树，下半截没有枝叶；第 3 格两棵并生、树冠交叠的铁杉；第 4 格被雷劈过、树干有焦黑裂口但仍活着。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard mature tree; cell 2: a taller leaner old tree bare of boughs on its lower half; cell 3: two ironhemlocks growing together with overlapping crowns; cell 4: a lightning-struck tree with a charred split in the trunk, still alive.

items.notes: 林中会成片实例化摆放，四个变体的树干粗细要接近；树干底部正中贴格底。

subject.zh: 长满苔藓与蕨的老橡：粗短扭曲的树干，约 5 米高，主枝上覆着厚厚的苔绿 #4a7a3a，枝杈间长着小蕨，树冠宽而不整，叶团暗绿两阶，树根盘出地面像几只爪子。
subject.en: An old oak grown over with moss and ferns: a thick, short, twisted trunk about 5 m tall, the main limbs coated in thick moss green #4a7a3a, small ferns growing in the forks, a broad ragged crown in two steps of dark green, roots coiling out of the ground like claws.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准的苔橡；第 2 格树干上有一个能藏人的大树洞；第 3 格一侧大枝断落、挂着藤的苔橡；第 4 格半枯的苔橡，只有一侧还有叶子。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard mossy oak; cell 2: one with a hollow in the trunk big enough to hide in; cell 3: one with a great limb broken off on one side and vines hanging; cell 4: a half-dead oak with leaves on only one side.

items.notes: 苔与叶是两种绿，苔偏黄绿、叶偏暗绿，不要糊成一团。

subject.zh: 白桦：细高的白皮树干，约 5 米，白皮上有一道道横向黑色节痕，枝条细软，叶团小而稀，夏天浅绿 #6a9a50，阳光能透过；夜风走廊的桦村与雪地外观也用它。
subject.en: A birch: a slender white-barked trunk about 5 m tall, the white bark marked with horizontal black scars, thin supple twigs, small sparse leaf clusters in pale green #6a9a50 in summer letting light through; also used for the birch villages of the Nightwind Corridor and the snow look.

extra.zh: 第 1 格夏天的单棵白桦；第 2 格三棵从同一根部长出的白桦；第 3 格秋天，叶子金黄 #e0d8a0；第 4 格冬天，光枝挂雪。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single birch in summer; cell 2: three birches growing from one root; cell 3: autumn, the leaves golden #e0d8a0; cell 4: winter, bare boughs carrying snow.

items.notes: 白皮用暖白偏灰，不用纯白；黑节是短横的硬边色块。

subject.zh: 林中覆苔大石：圆滚的灰岩块，高 1.5 到 3 米，顶面与北侧盖着厚苔，石面灰 #6e7270，苔从 #4a7a3a 到 #2e5a30，石脚长着蕨与落叶堆，石缝里冒出一株小树苗。
subject.en: A moss-covered boulder in the woods: a rounded grey rock 1.5 to 3 m tall, its top and north side under thick moss, stone grey #6e7270, moss from #4a7a3a to #2e5a30, ferns and leaf litter at its foot, a small sapling sprouting from a crack.

extra.zh: 第 1 格矮宽的苔石；第 2 格高耸的苔石；第 3 格被树根抱住的苔石；第 4 格一半埋在土坡里的苔石。
extra.en: Cell 1: a low wide mossy boulder; cell 2: a tall mossy boulder; cell 3: a boulder gripped by tree roots; cell 4: a boulder half buried in an earth bank.

items.notes: 苔只盖在顶面与背光侧的一部分，左上受光处露出石面。

subject.zh: 林下覆苔碎石：几块大小不一的灰石，最高到膝盖，表面斑驳地盖着苔，石缝里夹着松针与落叶，颜色比洛萨乡野的田石更暗更绿。
subject.en: Mossy stones on the forest floor: a few grey stones of different sizes, the tallest knee high, patchily covered in moss, pine needles and fallen leaves wedged between them, darker and greener than the field stones of the Lotha countryside.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格一圈围着小水洼的石头；第 3 格长着小蘑菇的石堆；第 4 格一块扁平的踏石。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered stones; cell 2: a ring of stones around a small puddle; cell 3: a stone pile with tiny mushrooms; cell 4: a single flat stepping stone.

items.notes: 水洼只画一小块深色，不画倒影；尺寸都很小。

subject.zh: 林下蕨丛与灌木：羽状的蕨叶从中心向外散开，约 1 米高，叶色由 #4a7a3a 到 #2e5a30，叶尖略亮，夹杂几根细灌木枝与一两片宽叶。
subject.en: Ferns and undergrowth: feathery fronds fanning out from a center, about 1 m tall, colored from #4a7a3a to #2e5a30 with slightly brighter tips, mixed with a few thin shrub stems and one or two broad leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一大丛蕨；第 2 格两小丛蕨并排；第 3 格蕨与荆棘混生的一丛；第 4 格秋天转为锈褐的蕨。
extra.en: Cell 1: one large clump of ferns; cell 2: two small clumps side by side; cell 3: ferns mixed with brambles; cell 4: ferns turned rusty brown in autumn.

items.notes: 羽叶要有清楚的锯齿轮廓，缩到 32 像素仍能认出是蕨。

subject.zh: 倒木旁的蘑菇丛：一簇高低不一的普通林菇，菌盖是赭褐、土黄与米白，最大的到小腿高，菌柄粗短，旁边有一截长苔的枯枝。不发光，不用紫色。
subject.en: A cluster of mushrooms beside a fallen log: ordinary forest mushrooms of uneven heights, caps in ochre brown, earthy yellow and cream, the largest reaching mid-shin, short thick stems, a mossy dead branch beside them. Not glowing, no purple.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一簇褐色蘑菇；第 2 格一圈仙女环似的小白菇；第 3 格长在枯枝上的层叠木耳状菌；第 4 格赭黄与褐色混生的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cluster of brown mushrooms; cell 2: a small ring of little white mushrooms; cell 3: shelf fungi stacked on a dead branch; cell 4: a mixed clump of ochre and brown.

items.notes: 这是普通蘑菇；发淡紫光的磷光菌是另一条采集点条目，这里不要用澱紫。

subject.zh: 林缘提灯柱：一根约 2.4 米高、保留树皮的原木柱，顶端钉着一根弯木钩，钩上挂一盏黑铁框的小提灯，柱身缠着一圈麻绳，柱脚用石块围住，是"灯止于危险开始处"的那盏灯。
subject.en: A forest-edge lantern post: a log post about 2.4 m tall with its bark left on, a curved wooden hook nailed at the top holding a small black-iron lantern, a turn of hemp rope around the post, stones piled around its foot; this is the last lamp before danger begins.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是原木柱挂提灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是两根木杆搭成的人字架下挂提灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the log post with a hanging lantern, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a lantern hung beneath an A-frame of two poles, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 野外只在出口与营地放这盏灯；点亮格的光只在灯罩里。

subject.zh: 猎户的石井：一圈到膝盖高的矮石井圈，石块大小不一、缝里长苔，井上用三根原木搭成三角架，吊着一只木桶，架顶盖着一小片树皮瓦。
subject.en: A hunter's stone well: a low ring of uneven stones at knee height with moss in the joints, a tripod of three logs over it holding a wooden bucket, a small patch of bark shingles on top of the tripod.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三角木架的石井；第 2 格只有井圈、盖着木板的井；第 3 格井边放着两只水桶与瓢；第 4 格井圈塌了一角的旧井。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stone well with a log tripod; cell 2: only the wellhead, covered with planks; cell 3: the well with two buckets and a ladle beside it; cell 4: an old well with one corner of the rim collapsed.

items.notes: 比洛萨乡野的广场井矮小粗糙；井口略带俯视。

subject.zh: 猎户木桶：深色旧木桶，高约 0.8 米，用两道藤条箍代替铁箍，盖子用皮绳交叉捆住，桶身有烟熏与磨损，侧面挂着一只木瓢。
subject.en: A hunter's barrel: an old dark wooden cask about 0.8 m tall, two bands of bound withy in place of iron hoops, its lid tied down crosswise with leather thong, smoke stains and wear on the staves, a wooden ladle hanging on the side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盖子捆着的木桶；第 2 格开盖的雨水桶；第 3 格两只并排的木桶；第 4 格桶上放着一捆箭杆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a barrel with its lid tied; cell 2: an open rain barrel; cell 3: two barrels side by side; cell 4: a barrel with a bundle of arrow shafts on top.

items.notes: 藤条箍是浅褐色，与洛萨乡野的铁箍木桶区分开。

subject.zh: 伐木营的粗木箱：用没刨平的厚木板钉成，约 0.8 米见方，板面保留斧痕与树皮边，四角用木楔加固，颜色深褐 #5a3e2a 到浅褐 #846a4c。
subject.en: A rough crate from the logging camp: nailed from thick unplaned boards, about 0.8 m on a side, axe marks and bark edges left on the boards, corners reinforced with wooden wedges, colored from dark brown #5a3e2a to light brown #846a4c.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑麻绳的箱子；第 2 格两道交叉麻绳的箱子；第 3 格上面摞着一只小箱与一卷绳；第 4 格开盖、装着楔子与工具的箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: a crate with one diagonal hemp rope; cell 2: a crate with two crossed ropes; cell 3: a crate with a small box and a coil of rope on top; cell 4: an open crate holding wedges and tools.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应地图数据的变体 0、1；箱面不写字。

subject.zh: 林间路牌：一根粗糙的原木柱，约 1.8 米高，钉着两三块削尖的木板，板上只刻着箭头与简单图形（树、山、斧头），柱顶绑着一条褪色的红布条，方便在林中远远看到。
subject.en: A forest signpost: a rough log post about 1.8 m tall with two or three pointed boards nailed on, the boards carved only with arrows and simple pictures (a tree, a mountain, an axe), a faded red cloth strip tied at the top so it can be seen from afar in the woods.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两块指向板的岔口路牌；第 2 格单块指向板、斜钉的路牌；第 3 格一块挂在树枝上的木牌；第 4 格被藤蔓缠住的旧路牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a crossroads post with two arrow boards; cell 2: a post with a single board nailed at a slant; cell 3: a board hung from a branch; cell 4: an old signpost wound with vines.

items.notes: 只刻图形与箭头，不写任何字；地名由界面层绘制。

subject.zh: 林间劈木横栏：两根带树皮的木桩之间架着两根劈开的半圆横木，高约 1 米、宽约 2 米，横木用麻绳绑在桩上，木头灰褐带苔点。
subject.en: A split-rail fence in the woods: two bark-covered stakes with two half-round split rails between them, about 1 m tall and 2 m wide, rails lashed to the stakes with hemp rope, the wood grey brown with moss spots.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格一根横木掉下来的一段；第 4 格缠着荆棘的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a complete section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with one rail fallen; cell 4: a section tangled with brambles.

items.notes: 两端要能接上下一段；不画地面。

subject.zh: 榆集的林间货摊：四根带树皮的木杆撑起一片布棚，约 2.6 米宽，摊台是一块厚木板，上面摆着蜂蜜罐、成卷的兽皮、木雕与草药束，摊边挂着一串干蘑菇。
subject.en: A woodland market stall at Elmfair: four bark-covered poles holding a cloth awning about 2.6 m wide, a thick plank for a counter with honey jars, rolled hides, wood carvings and herb bundles on it, a string of dried mushrooms hanging at the side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红布棚，摊上是蜂蜜与蜡块；第 2 格蓝布棚，摊上是兽皮；第 3 格绿布棚，摊上是草药；第 4 格树皮色粗麻棚，摊上是木雕与骨饰。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red awning with honey and wax; cell 2: a blue awning with hides; cell 3: a green awning with herbs; cell 4: a bark-colored sacking awning with carvings and bone ornaments.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；布色比城里的摊子更旧更暗。

subject.zh: 原木长凳：一段约 1.8 米长的原木劈成两半，平面朝上，下面垫着两截短木桩当腿，凳面高到膝盖，树皮还留在两侧，一头被坐得发亮。
subject.en: A log bench: a log about 1.8 m long split in half with the flat face up, resting on two short stumps as legs, seat at knee height, bark still on the sides, one end polished by sitting.

extra.zh: 第 1 格劈木长凳；第 2 格一整根放倒的原木当凳；第 3 格带一块木板靠背的长凳；第 4 格长了苔的旧凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a split-log bench; cell 2: a whole fallen log used as a seat; cell 3: a bench with a plank backrest; cell 4: an old bench grown over with moss.

items.notes: 凳面到膝盖；不画坐着的人。

subject.zh: 林中部族与猎团的布旗：一根约 3 米高、带分杈的木杆，横绑一根树枝，挂着一面粗麻布旗，旗面画着简单的兽爪或鹿角图形，旗边缀着羽毛与骨珠。
subject.en: A banner of woodland clans and hunting bands: a forked wooden pole about 3 m tall with a branch lashed across, hanging a coarse hemp banner painted with a simple claw or antler design, the edges trimmed with feathers and bone beads.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红布旗，画兽爪；第 2 格蓝布旗，画鹿角；第 3 格树皮色布旗，画三道爪痕；第 4 格褪色撕裂的旧旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red banner with a claw; cell 2: a blue banner with antlers; cell 3: a bark-colored banner with three claw marks; cell 4: an old faded torn banner.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；图形是简单的剪影，不写字。

subject.zh: 林间营火：一圈拳头大的石头围成的火塘，直径约 1 米，里面交叉架着几根粗柴，火塘边插着一根挂锅的木叉，旁边放着一小捆备用的柴。
subject.en: A forest campfire: a fire pit ringed with fist-sized stones about 1 m across, a few thick logs crossed inside, a forked stick for hanging a pot planted at the edge, a small bundle of spare firewood beside it.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格石圈营火；第 2 格架着吊锅的营火；第 3 格一堆火光较低的小营火；第 4 格用三根长柴搭成锥形的大篝火。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: a stone-ringed campfire; cell 2: a campfire with a hanging pot; cell 3: a small campfire burning low; cell 4: a large bonfire of three long logs stacked in a cone.

items.notes: 这是边地野林包的火盆种类（brazier）；营地与敌营都用它；火焰只用暖色硬边色块。

subject.zh: 林中覆苔的古旧石像：一尊约 2.5 米高的灰石立像，造型已被风雨磨圆，只看得出是一个披着长袍、双手合在胸前的人形，脸与手的细节全无，苔与藤从脚下爬到肩头。
subject.en: An ancient mossy stone figure in the woods: a grey stone standing figure about 2.5 m tall, so worn by weather that it only reads as a robed person with hands folded at the chest, no detail left in face or hands, moss and vines creeping from its feet to its shoulders.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的苔像；第 2 格头部断落、放在脚边的苔像；第 3 格被一棵小树从旁顶歪的苔像；第 4 格只剩下半身与基座的苔像。
extra.en: Cell 1: the complete mossy figure; cell 2: the figure with its head broken off and lying at its feet; cell 3: the figure pushed askew by a young tree growing beside it; cell 4: only the lower half and base remaining.

items.notes: 看不出是谁：不刻五官、不带任何徽记。

subject.zh: 林中墓：一个长着苔的小石堆，约 0.8 米高，前面插着一根木墓标或立着一块扁平的野石，石堆上放着鹿角、羽毛一类的小祭物，周围落满松针。
subject.en: A forest grave: a small mossy cairn about 0.8 m tall, a wooden marker planted before it or a flat fieldstone standing at its head, small offerings such as an antler or feathers laid on the stones, pine needles fallen all around.

extra.zh: 第 1 格前立扁平野石的石堆墓；第 2 格前插立柱加横木木标的石堆墓；第 3 格放着一副鹿角的石堆墓；第 4 格塌散、几乎认不出的旧墓。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cairn with a flat fieldstone at its head; cell 2: a cairn with a wooden post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: a cairn bearing a pair of antlers; cell 4: an old cairn collapsed and barely recognizable.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0（圆顶石）与 1（立柱横木），这里用野石与木标表现；不写字。

subject.zh: 林间小屋旁的柴垛与草垛：劈好的柴块整齐码成约 1.8 米高的柴墙，上面盖着树皮防雨，旁边有一小堆喂牲口的干草，柴的截面是浅黄木色、外皮深褐。
subject.en: Woodpiles and hay by a forest cabin: split logs stacked neatly into a wall of firewood about 1.8 m tall, bark laid on top against rain, a small heap of hay for the animals beside it, the cut ends pale yellow wood and the bark dark brown.

extra.zh: 第 1 格码成方墙的柴垛；第 2 格围着一根中柱码成圆形的柴垛；第 3 格一小堆干草；第 4 格柴垛与干草堆并排。
extra.en: Cell 1: a square wall of firewood; cell 2: a round stack built around a central pole; cell 3: a small heap of hay; cell 4: a woodpile and haystack side by side.

items.notes: 这是边地野林包的 haystack 种类；夜风走廊三村的柴垛也用它。

subject.zh: 伐木运材车：两只实心木轮托着一副长木架，约 3 米长，架上用铁链捆着两三根去了枝的原木，车辕落地，辕头拴着一截绳，车轮沾着泥。
subject.en: A timber cart: two solid wooden wheels under a long wooden bed about 3 m long, two or three trimmed logs chained onto it, the shafts resting on the ground with a length of rope at their tip, mud on the wheels.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装着原木的运材车；第 2 格空车架；第 3 格装着柴捆与工具的车；第 4 格陷在泥里、车轮歪斜的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: the cart loaded with logs; cell 2: an empty cart bed; cell 3: the cart carrying firewood bundles and tools; cell 4: a cart stuck in mud with a crooked wheel.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头；原木截面是浅黄的年轮圆。

subject.zh: 荒原外缘的石化树：整棵树连枝杈都变成了灰白石头 #b9b4a8，约 4 到 5 米高，表面保留树皮纹理却毫无生气，裂缝里嵌着米粒大的淡紫晶点，枝头断口是锐利的石茬。
subject.en: A petrified tree on the Ashen Rim: the whole tree down to its twigs turned to grey white stone #b9b4a8, about 4 to 5 m tall, the bark texture preserved but utterly lifeless, rice-grain sized pale violet crystal specks set in its cracks, its branch tips ending in sharp stone stubs.

extra.zh: 第 1 格高大完整的石化树；第 2 格树冠断了一半的石化树；第 3 格向一侧倾倒、斜撑在地上的石化树；第 4 格只剩下半截粗干的石化树桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a tall intact petrified tree; cell 2: one with half its crown broken off; cell 3: one toppled sideways and propped on the ground; cell 4: a stump of the thick lower trunk only.

items.notes: 淡紫晶点很小很少，是澱的痕迹（保留语义色），不要把整棵树染紫；地图 A9 的提案编号，也是本包的第一种树。

subject.zh: 焦黑的枯死树：被烧过的树干与枝杈全是焦炭色 #3a2e28，约 4 米高，没有一片叶子，树皮裂成方块状的炭纹，几根细枝已经断落，树根处积着一圈灰白的灰。
subject.en: A charred dead tree: trunk and branches all burnt to charcoal #3a2e28, about 4 m tall, not a single leaf, the bark cracked into blocky charcoal scales, several thin branches broken off, a ring of grey white ash gathered at the roots.

extra.zh: 第 1 格焦枯的直立树；第 2 格主干被劈成两半的焦树；第 3 格只剩几根粗枝的焦树；第 4 格断在齐胸高的焦黑树桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: an upright charred tree; cell 2: one with its trunk split in two; cell 3: one with only a few heavy limbs left; cell 4: a charred stump broken off at chest height.

items.notes: 焦黑用暗褐与深灰，不用纯黑；树缝里不发光（发余烬光的是夜境的另一种枯树）。

subject.zh: 灰烬林的灰皮树：还活着的树，树皮是灰白色 #9a8a76 并带细密的鳞纹，约 5 米高，树冠稀疏，叶片是暗淡的灰绿，像蒙着一层灰，枝干微微扭曲，根部被灰半埋。
subject.en: An ashbark tree of the Ashwood: a living tree with grey white bark #9a8a76 covered in fine scale-like patterning, about 5 m tall, a sparse crown of dull grey green leaves as if dusted with ash, slightly twisted limbs, its roots half buried in ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准的灰皮树；第 2 格树冠更稀、叶子掉了一半的灰皮树；第 3 格两棵交缠生长的灰皮树；第 4 格树干上有一块被剥去树皮的白色伤口。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard ashbark tree; cell 2: one with a thinner crown, half its leaves fallen; cell 3: two ashbark trees grown entwined; cell 4: one with a white wound where bark has been stripped.

items.notes: 叶子是灰绿不是死灰，看得出它还活着；采集点"灰烬林灰心"另有条目。

subject.zh: 焦黑岩块：被灰与火烤过的黑岩，高 1.5 到 3 米，棱角分明，侧面露出一道道铁锈色 #8a3a24 的岩层，顶面落着一层灰白的灰，背光面裂缝很深。
subject.en: A scorched rock: black stone baked by ash and fire, 1.5 to 3 m tall with hard edges, rust-colored #8a3a24 strata showing on its sides, a layer of grey white ash settled on its top, deep cracks on the shaded face.

extra.zh: 第 1 格方块状的黑岩；第 2 格尖顶的高岩；第 3 格层层叠起的板状岩；第 4 格裂成两半、中间夹着灰的岩块。
extra.en: Cell 1: a blocky black rock; cell 2: a tall pointed rock; cell 3: a stack of layered slabs; cell 4: a rock split in two with ash filling the gap.

items.notes: 铁锈色只在岩层里，岩体本身是焦黑偏褐。

subject.zh: 落满灰的碎石：几块拳头到膝盖大小的黑褐碎石，表面盖着一层灰白的灰，只有棱角露出原来的颜色，石块之间积着细灰。
subject.en: Ash-covered rubble: a few dark brown stones from fist to knee size, their surfaces coated in grey white ash with only the edges showing their true color, fine ash drifted between them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格一小堆碎石；第 3 格一块半埋在灰里的扁石；第 4 格一圈围成火塘的黑石。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered stones; cell 2: a small heap of rubble; cell 3: a flat stone half buried in ash; cell 4: a ring of black stones laid as a fire pit.

items.notes: 灰是 #b9b4a8 到 #d8d0c4 的灰白，不是雪白。

subject.zh: 枯死的刺灌：一丛约 1 米高的干枯灌木，枝条灰褐而尖硬，长满长刺，没有叶子，枝梢挂着几缕被风吹来的灰与布丝。
subject.en: A dead thornbush: a withered shrub about 1 m tall, its stems grey brown, hard and sharp, covered in long thorns, no leaves, a few wisps of wind-blown ash and cloth threads caught on the tips.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆团的刺灌；第 2 格被风吹得一边倒的刺灌；第 3 格两丛相连的刺灌；第 4 格烧剩下的几根黑刺枝。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round thornbush; cell 2: one bent to one side by the wind; cell 3: two clumps joined; cell 4: a few blackened thorny stems left after burning.

items.notes: 刺是 1 像素的短线；不画叶子。

subject.zh: 灰白的干草簇：一簇齐小腿高的枯草，草叶细长、发灰发白，顶端带着干瘪的草穗，根部被灰埋住，像一撮被风吹乱的灰发。
subject.en: A tuft of grey white dry grass: a clump of dead grass up to mid-shin, its blades long, thin and bleached grey white, shriveled seed heads at the tips, its roots buried in ash, like a wind-tousled lock of grey hair.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一簇直立的干草；第 2 格被风吹倒的一簇；第 3 格三小簇连在一起；第 4 格夹着一点灰绿新芽的干草。
extra.en: Cell 1: an upright tuft; cell 2: a tuft blown flat; cell 3: three small tufts together; cell 4: dry grass with a little grey green new growth.

items.notes: 颜色在灰白与浅褐之间，不要画成绿色草地。

subject.zh: 拾荒者的挑灯：一根约 2.2 米高、歪斜的灰木杆，顶端绑着一截横木，横木一头挂着一盏锈铁皮提灯，杆脚用一堆碎石压住，杆身缠着破布条。
subject.en: A scavenger's lantern pole: a crooked grey wooden pole about 2.2 m tall with a crosspiece bound at the top, a rusty tin lantern hanging from one end, its foot weighted with a heap of rubble, the pole wrapped in rags.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是横木挑着的锈铁提灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是直接插在一根铁杆上的旧玻璃灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the rusty tin lantern on its crosspiece, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are an old glass lamp stuck on an iron rod, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 荒原上只在南口、营地与驿站点灯；点亮格的光只在灯罩里，是暖色。

subject.zh: 灰村残井：一圈断了大半的灰石井圈，齐膝高，石缝里塞满灰，井口斜搭着一根木杆，杆上垂下一段磨毛的绳，绳头系着一只瘪了的铁桶。
subject.en: A ruined well of the ash hamlets: a grey stone rim mostly broken down to knee height, ash packed into the joints, a wooden pole laid across the mouth with a frayed length of rope hanging from it, a dented iron bucket tied at its end.

extra.zh: 第 1 格残井带绳桶；第 2 格井口被一块石板盖住的残井；第 3 格井圈完全塌平、只剩一个黑洞的井；第 4 格拾荒者用木架修过、还能打水的井。
extra.en: Cell 1: the ruined well with rope and bucket; cell 2: the well capped with a stone slab; cell 3: a well collapsed flat, only a black hole left; cell 4: a well repaired by scavengers with a wooden frame, still usable.

items.notes: 井口略带俯视；井里是暗色，不画水光。

subject.zh: 烧焦的木桶：外层木板被火燎得发黑，约 0.9 米高，一道铁箍已经脱落斜挂着，桶身有裂缝，桶里积着灰，桶边放着一只破陶碗。
subject.en: A scorched barrel: its outer staves blackened by fire, about 0.9 m tall, one iron hoop slipped off and hanging askew, cracks in the body, ash collected inside, a broken clay bowl beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直立的焦桶；第 2 格横倒在灰里的焦桶；第 3 格两只叠在一起的焦桶；第 4 格拾荒者补过、装着雨水的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: an upright scorched barrel; cell 2: a scorched barrel lying in ash; cell 3: two scorched barrels stacked; cell 4: a barrel patched by scavengers, holding rainwater.

items.notes: 焦黑只在下半部与边缘，上半部仍看得出木色。

subject.zh: 拾荒者与掘手的木箱：用各种拆来的旧木板拼钉成的箱子，约 0.8 米见方，板色深浅不一，有的板子还带着烧痕，箱角包着一块锈铁皮，上面落满灰。
subject.en: A crate of scavengers and diggers: knocked together from salvaged boards of different shades, about 0.8 m on a side, some boards still bearing burn marks, a scrap of rusty sheet iron wrapped over one corner, ash settled on top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑麻绳的拼板箱；第 2 格两道交叉麻绳的拼板箱；第 3 格两只叠起、上面压着铁镐的箱子；第 4 格开盖、装着碎晶与旧铁的箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: a patchwork crate with one diagonal rope; cell 2: one with two crossed ropes; cell 3: two stacked crates with a pick laid on top; cell 4: an open crate holding crystal chips and scrap iron.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；第 4 格的碎晶只有几点淡紫。

subject.zh: 灰路路牌：一根歪斜的灰木桩，约 1.8 米高，钉着一块锈铁皮或旧木板做的指向牌，牌上用白漆画着箭头与简单图形（门框、火堆），桩脚堆着一圈压桩的碎石。
subject.en: A signpost of the ash road: a crooked grey wooden stake about 1.8 m tall with an arrow board of rusty sheet iron or old planking, painted in white with an arrow and simple pictures (a doorframe, a campfire), a ring of rubble piled around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单块铁皮指向牌；第 2 格两块木板指向牌；第 3 格倒在地上的路牌；第 4 格桩顶挂着一只破靴的路牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single sheet-iron arrow; cell 2: two wooden arrow boards; cell 3: a signpost fallen on the ground; cell 4: a signpost with a worn boot hung on top.

items.notes: 只画箭头与图形，不写任何字；地名由界面层绘制。

subject.zh: 残缺的木桩栅：几根高矮不齐、被烧掉半截的木桩，中间连着一两根断横木，约 1 米高、2 米宽，木头灰白发脆，桩脚埋在灰里。
subject.en: A broken stake fence: a few stakes of uneven height, some burnt halfway down, linked by one or two broken rails, about 1 m tall and 2 m wide, the wood grey white and brittle, the feet buried in ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格还算完整的一段；第 2 格只剩两根桩的一段；第 3 格横木挂着破布的一段；第 4 格用绳与铁丝临时补过的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a fairly intact section; cell 2: a section of only two stakes; cell 3: a section with rags hanging on the rail; cell 4: a section patched with rope and wire.

items.notes: 两端能接；灰色调，不要画成新木。

subject.zh: 拾荒者的摊子：两根木杆斜撑起一块褪色旧布当遮棚，约 2.5 米宽，下面铺着一张毯子，摆着拣来的旧铁件、陶罐、旧靴与几块碎晶，摊边插着一面小布条。
subject.en: A scavenger's stall: two poles propping a faded old cloth as a shade, about 2.5 m wide, a blanket spread beneath with salvaged scrap iron, clay pots, old boots and a few crystal chips, a small strip of cloth stuck at the side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格褪色红布棚；第 2 格褪色蓝布棚；第 3 格褪色绿布棚；第 4 格灰褐毯子摊，没有棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: a faded red shade; cell 2: a faded blue shade; cell 3: a faded green shade; cell 4: a grey brown blanket stall with no shade.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿，但都褪色发灰；货品不写价签。

subject.zh: 荒原上的石板长凳：一块约 1.6 米长的扁平黑石板搁在两块方石上，凳面高到膝盖，石面被坐得光滑，凹处积着灰，旁边靠着一根拐杖。
subject.en: A stone-slab bench of the waste: a flat black slab about 1.6 m long laid on two square stones, seat at knee height, the top polished smooth by sitting, ash gathered in its hollows, a walking staff leaning beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格石板长凳；第 2 格一截倒下的石柱当凳；第 3 格铺着旧毯子的石凳；第 4 格断成两截的石凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a slab bench; cell 2: a fallen column section used as a seat; cell 3: a stone bench with an old blanket on it; cell 4: a stone bench broken in two.

items.notes: 荒原外缘营地与驿站用；凳面到膝盖。

subject.zh: 荒原上褪色破烂的布旗：一根约 3 米高、弯曲的灰木杆，挂着一面被风撕成条的长布旗，布色褪得发灰，旗面残存一枚简单的图形纹章，旗尾磨成毛边。
subject.en: A faded ragged banner of the waste: a bent grey pole about 3 m tall hung with a long cloth banner torn into strips by the wind, the color bleached grey, a simple emblem still faintly visible, the tail frayed.

extra.zh: 第 1 格褪色的红旗；第 2 格褪色的蓝旗；第 3 格灰白底、画着门框图形的旗；第 4 格只剩一条布挂在杆上的残旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a faded red banner; cell 2: a faded blue banner; cell 3: a grey white banner showing a doorframe figure; cell 4: a ruin with a single strip left on the pole.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；门框图形不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 荒原营地的火：一只架在三块黑石上的旧铁盆，或一圈石头围着的火堆，约 1 米高，烧的是灰皮树枝与碎木，火焰偏橙红，盆沿与石头被熏得发黑。
subject.en: A camp fire of the waste: an old iron basin set on three black stones, or a fire ringed by stones, about 1 m tall, burning ashbark branches and scrap wood, the flames orange red, the rim and stones smoke-blackened.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格三石支起的铁盆火；第 2 格石圈火堆；第 3 格半截铁桶改成的火桶；第 4 格掘手营地的大篝火。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: an iron basin on three stones; cell 2: a stone-ringed fire; cell 3: a fire in half an iron drum; cell 4: a large bonfire of the diggers' camp.

items.notes: 火是暖橙 #ff9a4a 一类，不用冷色；荒原夜里这是唯一的光。

subject.zh: 被灰磨圆的残像：一尊约 2.5 米高的灰白石像，被风沙与灰打磨得只剩圆钝的人形轮廓，像是披着斗篷、举着一只手，脸与手的细节全无，一侧被灰堆埋到腰。
subject.en: A statue worn round by ash: a grey white stone figure about 2.5 m tall, ground by wind and ash down to a blunt human outline, seemingly cloaked with one hand raised, no detail left in face or hands, one side buried in an ash drift up to the waist.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直立的残像；第 2 格举起的手臂断落的残像；第 3 格倒在灰里、只露出上半身的残像；第 4 格只剩一块底座与一双石脚。
extra.en: Cell 1: an upright worn figure; cell 2: the figure with its raised arm broken off; cell 3: the figure fallen in ash with only its upper body showing; cell 4: only a plinth and a pair of stone feet.

items.notes: 不刻五官、不带徽记；石色灰白，不用澱紫。

subject.zh: 荒原上的石堆坟：一个约 0.8 米高的黑褐碎石堆，前面插着一柄生锈的断剑或一根木标，石堆上压着一只破头盔或一块布，周围的灰被风吹成一道道细纹。
subject.en: A cairn grave of the waste: a dark brown rubble heap about 0.8 m tall, a rusted broken sword or a wooden marker stuck before it, a dented helmet or a scrap of cloth weighted on top, the surrounding ash combed into fine lines by the wind.

extra.zh: 第 1 格前立一块圆顶扁石的石堆坟；第 2 格前插立柱加横木木标的石堆坟；第 3 格插着断剑的石堆坟；第 4 格压着破头盔的石堆坟。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cairn with a round-topped flat stone at its head; cell 2: a cairn with a post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: a cairn with a broken sword; cell 4: a cairn weighted with a dented helmet.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；不写字。

subject.zh: 灰绿的干枝捆：拾荒者收集的灰皮树枝与枯草捆成的捆，约 1.5 米高，用麻绳扎着，颜色灰绿发白，几捆斜靠在一起，当柴烧也当遮风墙。
subject.en: Bundles of grey green dry brush: ashbark branches and dead grass gathered by scavengers and tied into bundles about 1.5 m tall with hemp rope, grey green and pale, a few leaning together, burned as fuel and used as a windbreak.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三捆斜靠在一起；第 2 格一大捆立着；第 3 格一排排成挡风墙；第 4 格散开的枯枝堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: three bundles leaning together; cell 2: one large upright bundle; cell 3: a row set up as a windbreak; cell 4: a loose heap of dead brush.

items.notes: 这是灰烬荒原包的 haystack 种类；颜色不要用金黄。

subject.zh: 废弃的破车：一辆木板货车，约 3 米长，一只木轮已经掉了，车身斜着一角着地，车板裂开，车里积着灰，残留着几只破麻袋，车辕折断。
subject.en: An abandoned broken wagon: a plank cart about 3 m long with one wooden wheel gone, the body tilted with a corner on the ground, the boards split, ash heaped inside with a few torn sacks left behind, the shaft snapped.

extra.zh: 第 1 格缺一只轮、斜在地上的车；第 2 格翻倒、车底朝天的车；第 3 格被灰埋了一半的车；第 4 格拾荒者拆得只剩车架的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: missing a wheel and tilted; cell 2: overturned, bottom up; cell 3: half buried in ash; cell 4: stripped by scavengers to a bare frame.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头；木色灰白发脆。

subject.zh: 庭院的白皮树：银白光滑的树干 #eeeae2，约 4.5 米高，枝条舒展而匀称，叶团是带淡金的浅绿 #8cbc74 与 #7ab868 两阶，树形端正得像被精心照料过，树下没有一片落叶。
subject.en: A whitebark tree of the court garden: a smooth silver white trunk #eeeae2 about 4.5 m tall, evenly spreading boughs, leaf clusters in two steps of pale green touched with gold #8cbc74 and #7ab868, its form so balanced it seems lovingly tended, not a single fallen leaf beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准的白皮树；第 2 格较高、树冠呈卵形的白皮树；第 3 格两棵并立的小白皮树；第 4 格秋天叶子转为淡金 #e8c86a 的白皮树。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard whitebark; cell 2: a taller one with an oval crown; cell 3: two young whitebarks side by side; cell 4: a whitebark in autumn, its leaves turned pale gold #e8c86a.

items.notes: 整洁到近乎不真实；树干不要纯白，用暖白分阶。

subject.zh: 修剪成几何形的常青树：浓密的深绿小叶被剪成圆球、圆锥或叠层圆盘的形状，约 3 米高，下面是一截短短的浅褐树干与一只白石圆盆，轮廓干净利落。
subject.en: An evergreen clipped into geometry: dense small dark green leaves shaped into a ball, a cone or stacked discs, about 3 m tall, above a short light brown trunk set in a round white stone planter, its outline crisp and clean.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆球形；第 2 格圆锥形；第 3 格三层圆盘叠起；第 4 格两个小圆球上下相叠。
extra.en: Cell 1: a ball; cell 2: a cone; cell 3: three stacked discs; cell 4: two small balls one above the other.

items.notes: 轮廓要锐利对称；绿色用本包的 #7ab868 与更暗一阶。

subject.zh: 开白花的小乔木：细瘦的灰白树干约 3.5 米高，枝条向上张开，枝头开满五瓣小白花，花心点着一点淡金，花团之间露出少许嫩绿叶，树下落着几片花瓣。
subject.en: A small flowering tree: a slender grey white trunk about 3.5 m tall, branches opening upward, their tips crowded with small five-petaled white blossoms with a touch of pale gold at the centers, a little fresh green leaf between the clusters, a few petals fallen beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛开；第 2 格花开一半、叶多一些；第 3 格花谢、满树嫩叶；第 4 格冬天只剩光枝与零星花苞。
extra.en: Cell 1: in full bloom; cell 2: half in bloom, more leaves; cell 3: blossoms gone, full of young leaves; cell 4: winter, bare boughs with a few buds.

items.notes: 门内庭院的时间与箱庭同步，所以有四季；花瓣用暖白，不用纯白。

subject.zh: 白色大理石庭石：一块圆润光滑的白石，高 1 到 2 米，石面带着淡灰与淡紫 #a89cc8 的细纹理，像被流水打磨过，底部一圈短草修剪得整整齐齐。
subject.en: A white marble garden stone: a rounded smooth white rock 1 to 2 m tall, its surface veined with fine pale grey and pale lavender #a89cc8, as if polished by running water, a ring of neatly trimmed short grass at its base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格卧石；第 2 格立石；第 3 格两块相依的石；第 4 格石面一侧长着一小片青苔。
extra.en: Cell 1: a reclining stone; cell 2: an upright stone; cell 3: two stones leaning together; cell 4: a small patch of moss on one side.

items.notes: 纹理里的淡紫是石纹不是澱，面积极小、偏灰；不画高光过曝。

subject.zh: 庭院白卵石与踏石：几块圆润的白色与浅灰卵石，最大的到膝盖，表面光滑，排列得错落有致，石缝里点缀着细小的白花。
subject.en: White pebbles and stepping stones of the court: a few rounded white and pale grey stones, the largest knee high, smooth-surfaced and artfully arranged, tiny white flowers dotted between them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块错落的卵石；第 2 格一列扁平踏石；第 3 格围着小泉眼的一圈卵石；第 4 格一块带浅坑的盛水石。
extra.en: Cell 1: three artfully placed pebbles; cell 2: a line of flat stepping stones; cell 3: a ring of pebbles around a little spring; cell 4: a stone with a shallow basin holding water.

items.notes: 尺寸小；画面略带俯视。

subject.zh: 修剪整齐的矮树篱：一段齐腰高、约 2 米长的深绿树篱，顶面与侧面剪得笔直平整，叶子细密，四角是利落的直角，底部露出一线白石边。
subject.en: A neatly trimmed low hedge: a waist-high dark green hedge about 2 m long, its top and sides clipped straight and flat, the leaves fine and dense, crisp right-angled corners, a line of white stone edging showing at its base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格中间开着一个拱形缺口的一段；第 4 格开着零星白花的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with an arched opening in the middle; cell 4: a section dotted with small white flowers.

items.notes: 两端能接；规整到近乎刻板，体现神庭的秩序感。

subject.zh: 白与淡金的花坛花丛：一圈白石围边里种着一丛齐膝高的花，花色只有白、乳白与淡金 #e8c86a，花形是小杯状与星状，叶片嫩绿，排列得像被精心数过。
subject.en: A bed of white and pale gold flowers: a knee-high clump inside a ring of white stone edging, the blossoms only white, cream and pale gold #e8c86a, small cup and star shapes, fresh green leaves, arranged as if each one had been counted.

extra.zh: 第 1 格全白的一丛；第 2 格白与淡金相间；第 3 格只有淡金的一丛；第 4 格刚冒出花苞的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: all white; cell 2: white and pale gold mixed; cell 3: pale gold only; cell 4: just budding.

items.notes: 颜色克制，只用白与淡金；淡金不是门扉金 #f0d890，偏暖黄一些。

subject.zh: 神庭的白石灯柱：一根约 2.5 米高的白石方柱，柱身有细金线勾边，柱顶托着一只金边玻璃灯罩，灯罩是四面拱形窗，底座是两级白石台阶。
subject.en: A white stone lamp post of the court: a square white stone column about 2.5 m tall edged with fine gold lines, holding at its top a gold-rimmed glass shade of four arched panes, its base two white stone steps.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是方柱金边灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是矮一些、柱顶是一只圆球灯罩的庭院灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the square gold-edged column lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a shorter garden lamp with a round globe shade on top, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 门内庭院的门灯与路灯；点亮格的光只在灯罩里，暖白偏金。

subject.zh: 白石喷泉水盆：一只齐腰高的圆形白石水盆，盆沿雕着一圈卷叶纹，盆心立着一根细石柱，柱顶的小钵里有清水溢下，水面平静清澈，盆边镶着淡金细线。
subject.en: A white stone fountain basin: a waist-high round white stone basin, a band of curling leaves carved on its rim, a slender stone column rising from its center with clear water brimming over from a little bowl at its top, the water calm and clear, a fine pale gold line inlaid along the edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有中心石柱的水盆；第 2 格只有低矮水盆、没有石柱；第 3 格方形水盆；第 4 格水停了、盆里落着几片花瓣。
extra.en: Cell 1: the basin with its central column; cell 2: a low basin without a column; cell 3: a square basin; cell 4: the water stilled, a few petals in the basin.

items.notes: 这是神庭包的 well 装饰；采集用的庭井（art_prop_court_well）是另一条；水只画平静的浅色面，不画流动特效。

subject.zh: 白漆木桶：约 0.9 米高的木桶，桶板漆成乳白，上下两道金色细箍，桶盖是浅木色，侧面画着一圈淡金的叶纹，干净得像从没装过东西。
subject.en: A white-painted barrel: a cask about 0.9 m tall, its staves painted cream, two fine gold hoops top and bottom, a pale wooden lid, a band of pale gold leaf pattern painted around its side, so clean it seems never to have held anything.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只白桶；第 2 格两只并排；第 3 格开盖、盛着清水的桶；第 4 格桶上放着一只木勺与一束花。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single white barrel; cell 2: two side by side; cell 3: lid off, full of clear water; cell 4: a wooden ladle and a posy of flowers on top.

items.notes: 门内庭院已有的木桶装饰用它。

subject.zh: 白木箱：浅色白杨木钉成的方箱，约 0.8 米见方，木板几乎没有节疤，边角圆润，箱面烙着一枚淡金的门形小纹，看起来崭新。
subject.en: A white wooden crate: a square box of pale aspen about 0.8 m on a side, the boards nearly knotless, corners rounded, a small pale gold door-shaped mark branded on its face, looking brand new.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑白绳的箱子；第 2 格两道交叉白绳的箱子；第 3 格两只叠起的箱子；第 4 格开盖、装着干草与几只苹果的箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: a crate with one diagonal white cord; cell 2: with two crossed white cords; cell 3: two crates stacked; cell 4: open, holding straw and a few apples.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；门形小纹是淡金不是门扉金，面积很小。

subject.zh: 神庭的白石路标：一根约 1.5 米高的白石小方柱，柱顶刻着一枚门形纹，柱身朝路的一面刻着一个指向的箭头凹槽，没有任何字，底座是一级圆台。
subject.en: A white stone waymark of the court: a small square white stone post about 1.5 m tall, a door motif carved at its top, an arrow-shaped groove carved on the face toward the path, no writing at all, a round step for its base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单箭头的路标；第 2 格双箭头的岔口路标；第 3 格矮的界标；第 4 格柱顶放着一盏小灯的路标（熄着）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single-arrow waymark; cell 2: a double-arrow fork marker; cell 3: a low boundary marker; cell 4: a waymark with a small lamp on top (unlit).

items.notes: 只有图形与箭头，不写字。

subject.zh: 白色矮栅：一段约 0.9 米高、2 米宽的白漆木栅，竖条顶端削成圆头，两道横条上刻着细小的卷叶，栅柱顶各有一颗小圆球，漆面无一处剥落。
subject.en: A low white fence: a white-painted wooden section about 0.9 m tall and 2 m wide, the pickets rounded at their tops, fine curling leaves carved on the two rails, a small ball atop each post, the paint without a single chip.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一扇小栅门的一段；第 4 格缠着开白花的藤的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a small gate; cell 4: a section wound with a white-flowered vine.

items.notes: 两端能接；庭院每次扩建加一到两段。

subject.zh: 白布棚的小陈列台：两根白木立柱撑起一片白布小棚，约 2.5 米宽，台面铺着乳白桌布，摆着几只小篮与陶罐，棚边缀着淡金流苏，干净得像节日用的摆设。
subject.en: A small white-canopied display stand: two white wooden posts holding a small white cloth canopy about 2.5 m wide, the counter spread with a cream cloth and set with a few little baskets and clay jars, pale gold tassels along the canopy edge, as clean as a festival display.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白底红边的棚；第 2 格白底蓝边的棚；第 3 格白底绿边的棚；第 4 格全白、摆着草药束的棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: white with a red trim; cell 2: white with a blue trim; cell 3: white with a green trim; cell 4: all white, laid with herb bundles.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格以棚边颜色对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；神庭不卖东西，这是庭院的展台。

subject.zh: 白石长椅：一条约 1.8 米长的白石长椅，椅面平滑，两端扶手雕成简洁的卷涡，椅腿是两块方石，椅面到膝盖高，石面纤尘不染。
subject.en: A white stone bench: a white stone bench about 1.8 m long with a smooth seat, its two armrests carved into simple scrolls, its legs two square blocks, the seat at knee height, the stone spotless.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带卷涡扶手的长椅；第 2 格无扶手的平长椅；第 3 格带矮靠背的长椅；第 4 格一端放着一只白瓷杯的长椅。
extra.en: Cell 1: with scroll armrests; cell 2: a plain bench without arms; cell 3: with a low backrest; cell 4: with a white porcelain cup at one end.

items.notes: 序章候见厅的两张长椅就是第 1 格；候见厅"纯白"，椅子不加装饰色。

subject.zh: 白底金纹的长幡：一根约 3.5 米高的白木杆，顶端是一颗金色圆钮，挂着一条窄长的白色长幡，幡面中央绣着一枚淡金的门形纹，幡尾垂着金色流苏，布面几乎不动。
subject.en: A long white and gold pennant: a white wooden pole about 3.5 m tall topped by a gold knob, hanging a long narrow white pennant embroidered at its center with a pale gold door motif, gold tassels at the tail, the cloth nearly motionless.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白底红边的长幡；第 2 格白底蓝边的长幡；第 3 格纯白长幡；第 4 格淡金底白纹的长幡。
extra.en: Cell 1: white with a red border; cell 2: white with a blue border; cell 3: pure white; cell 4: pale gold with a white motif.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝以边色对应变体 0、1；门形纹用淡金，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 金色光盆：一只齐腰高的白石台上托着一只浅金铜盆，盆里不是火，而是一团柔和的暖白光，像一小片凝住的日光，盆沿刻着一圈卷叶纹。
subject.en: A golden light basin: a waist-high white stone stand holding a shallow gilded bowl, holding not fire but a soft warm white glow like a little piece of sunlight held still, a band of curling leaves carved on the rim.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格石台上的浅金盆；第 2 格三足的小金盆；第 3 格一对中较矮的那只；第 4 格悬在细链下的吊盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the gilded bowl on its stone stand; cell 2: a small three-footed gold bowl; cell 3: the shorter of a pair; cell 4: a bowl hung on fine chains.

items.notes: 神庭的"火盆"是光不是火：用暖白与淡金分 3 阶硬边色块，不画火舌；不用门扉金与神光白金的大面积。

subject.zh: 无面的白石袍像：一尊约 3 米高的白石立像，穿着垂地长袍，双手捧在胸前，袍褶雕得细致流畅，头部只是光滑的椭圆，没有五官，立在一座刻卷叶纹的方座上。
subject.en: A faceless white stone robed statue: a white stone standing figure about 3 m tall in a floor-length robe, both hands cupped at its chest, the folds carved fine and flowing, the head only a smooth oval without features, on a square plinth carved with curling leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格双手捧胸；第 2 格一手向前伸出；第 3 格双手垂下、微低着头；第 4 格只有袍与座、人形略小。
extra.en: Cell 1: hands cupped at the chest; cell 2: one hand reaching forward; cell 3: hands lowered, head slightly bowed; cell 4: robe and plinth only, the figure slightly smaller.

items.notes: 无五官是刻意的，让人不安；不带任何女神的徽记，不表现性别细节。

subject.zh: 白石纪念碑：一块约 0.8 米高的小方碑，白石磨光，碑顶是圆弧或方平，碑面只刻着一圈细边框与一枚小门形纹，碑前一块白石供台。
subject.en: A white stone memorial: a small square stele about 0.8 m tall of polished white stone, round-topped or flat, its face carved only with a fine border and a small door motif, a white stone offering slab before it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶小碑；第 2 格立柱加横木形的白石标；第 3 格碑前放着一束白花；第 4 格平放在草地上的白石板。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped small stele; cell 2: a white stone post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: with a bouquet of white flowers before it; cell 4: a white slab laid flat in the grass.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；不写字。

subject.zh: 庭院草垛：一堆金黄 #e8c86a 的干草堆成整齐的圆顶，约 1.8 米高，表面像被梳过一样顺，顶上插着一把木叉，底部散着几缕干草。
subject.en: A court haystack: golden #e8c86a hay heaped into a tidy dome about 1.8 m tall, its surface smooth as if combed, a wooden pitchfork stuck in the top, a few wisps scattered at its base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶草垛；第 2 格两个方草捆；第 3 格畜栏角落的小草堆；第 4 格被扒开一半的草垛。
extra.en: Cell 1: a dome haystack; cell 2: two square bales; cell 3: a small heap in the corner of a pen; cell 4: a haystack half pulled apart.

items.notes: 门内庭院已有的草垛装饰用它；颜色比洛萨乡野的草垛更亮更整齐。

subject.zh: 白木小推车：一辆约 2 米长的白漆小推车，独轮在前、两根推把在后，车斗边缘刻着淡金细线，车斗里铺着一块乳白布，轮辋是浅金铜。
subject.en: A small white handcart: a white-painted barrow about 2 m long with a single wheel in front and two handles behind, fine pale gold lines along the rim of its bed, a cream cloth spread in the bed, the wheel rim pale gilded bronze.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空车；第 2 格装着菜蔬的车；第 3 格装着几块白石的车；第 4 格装着干草与一只木桶的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: empty; cell 2: loaded with greens; cell 3: carrying a few white stones; cell 4: carrying hay and a bucket.

items.notes: 庭院扩建与园圃用；侧面朝镜头，推把朝画面右侧。

subject.zh: 城中街边的悬铃木：粗直的树干约 5.5 米高，树皮斑驳成灰白与灰绿的大块，枝条在上部伸展成宽卵形树冠，叶团中绿两三阶，树脚围着一圈方石护栏。
subject.en: A street plane tree of the city: a thick straight trunk about 5.5 m tall, its bark mottled in large patches of grey white and grey green, branches spreading above into a broad oval crown, leaves in two or three steps of mid green, a square stone curb around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格夏天的悬铃木；第 2 格修剪过、树冠更圆的悬铃木；第 3 格秋天叶子转为黄褐；第 4 格冬天光秃、挂着几颗圆球果。
extra.en: Cell 1: a plane tree in summer; cell 2: pollarded with a rounder crown; cell 3: autumn, the leaves yellow brown; cell 4: winter, bare with a few round seed balls hanging.

items.notes: 斑驳树皮是辨识点，用两三种灰色硬边色块；树脚的石护栏只画一圈矮边。

subject.zh: 瓦伦河岸的杨树：高而窄的树形，约 6 米，灰白树干笔直，枝条向上收拢，叶片小而密，正面暗绿背面银灰，在风里会翻出银光，适合成排种在河堤上。
subject.en: A poplar on the Valen riverbank: tall and narrow, about 6 m, a straight grey white trunk, branches gathered upward, small dense leaves dark green above and silver grey beneath that flash silver in the wind, suited to rows along the embankment.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准杨树；第 2 格更高更瘦的杨树；第 3 格叶子翻出银灰的杨树；第 4 格秋天金黄的杨树。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard poplar; cell 2: a taller leaner one; cell 3: its leaves turned to show silver grey; cell 4: golden in autumn.

items.notes: 成排实例化摆放，四个变体的宽度相近。

subject.zh: 水边垂柳：短粗弯曲的灰褐树干约 5 米高，长长的细枝像帘子一样垂到地面，叶片细长浅绿，柳帘之间透出空隙，适合种在码头与河港边。
subject.en: A waterside weeping willow: a short thick crooked grey brown trunk about 5 m tall, long thin twigs hanging to the ground like a curtain, slender pale green leaves, gaps showing between the hanging strands, suited to docks and the river harbor.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准垂柳；第 2 格向水面一侧倾斜的垂柳；第 3 格春天嫩黄绿的垂柳；第 4 格冬天只剩细枝的垂柳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard willow; cell 2: one leaning toward the water; cell 3: spring, a tender yellow green; cell 4: winter, only bare thin twigs.

items.notes: 垂下的枝条是竖向的细色带，不要画成一整块绿。

subject.zh: 河岸卵形大石：瓦伦河边被水冲圆的灰褐大石，高 1.5 到 2.5 米，石面光滑，靠水一侧颜色更深并挂着一圈干了的水草，顶面落着几块鸟粪白斑。
subject.en: An oval river boulder: a grey brown rock rounded by the Valen, 1.5 to 2.5 m tall, its surface smooth, darker on the water side with a ring of dried waterweed, a few white bird droppings on top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单块卵石；第 2 格两块相叠；第 3 格一半没入水线的石（水线用深色带表示）；第 4 格石上系着一根缆绳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single boulder; cell 2: two stacked; cell 3: half below the waterline (a dark band marks the line); cell 4: a mooring rope tied around it.

items.notes: 不画水面；水线只用一条平直深色带。

subject.zh: 堆着的方整石料与碎砖：几块切割平整的灰白石块与一小堆砖红碎砖，最大的石块到膝盖高，石块上留着凿痕，旁边靠着一根撬棍，是城里修房修墙剩下的材料。
subject.en: Stacked cut stone and broken brick: a few squared grey white blocks and a small heap of brick red fragments, the largest block knee high with chisel marks left on it, a crowbar leaning beside them, leftovers from repairing houses and walls in the city.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两块叠起的石料；第 2 格一堆碎砖；第 3 格三块排开的石料；第 4 格石料上放着一只灰浆桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: two blocks stacked; cell 2: a heap of broken brick; cell 3: three blocks in a row; cell 4: a mortar bucket set on a block.

items.notes: 城里没有野石，用石料代替；砖红用 #a8583e。

subject.zh: 石砌花槽里的黄杨矮篱：一只约 1.5 米长、到膝盖高的长方石槽，槽里种着修剪成方块的黄杨，叶子细密暗绿，石槽边缘刻着一道简单的线脚。
subject.en: Box hedge in a stone planter: a rectangular stone trough about 1.5 m long and knee high, planted with boxwood clipped into blocks, its leaves fine and dark green, a simple molding carved along the trough's rim.

extra.zh: 第 1 格长方花槽；第 2 格圆形花槽里的球形黄杨；第 3 格两只并排的方槽；第 4 格黄杨枯了一半的旧槽。
extra.en: Cell 1: a rectangular planter; cell 2: a round planter with a ball of boxwood; cell 3: two square planters side by side; cell 4: an old planter with the box half dead.

items.notes: 城里的"灌丛"种类；石槽是灰白石。

subject.zh: 陶盆花与窗台花箱：几只砖红陶盆与一只窄长木花箱，种着红、白、黄的小花与垂下的绿藤，最高到膝盖，花盆边沿有白色的盐碱痕。
subject.en: Clay pots and a window box: a few brick red clay pots and a long narrow wooden flower box planted with small red, white and yellow flowers and trailing green vines, the tallest knee high, white mineral marks on the pot rims.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三只陶盆；第 2 格一只窄长木花箱；第 3 格叠成小台阶的花盆；第 4 格一只打碎的陶盆与散土。
extra.en: Cell 1: three clay pots; cell 2: one long wooden window box; cell 3: pots arranged on little steps; cell 4: a broken pot and spilled soil.

items.notes: 城里的"花草"种类；花是几像素的色点。

subject.zh: 城中铸铁街灯：一根约 3 米高的黑铁柱，柱身有凹槽与一道铸花腰箍，顶上一只六面玻璃灯笼，灯笼顶是小穹顶，柱脚是方石座，柱身有一根让点灯人搭梯的横档。
subject.en: A cast iron street lamp of the city: a black iron column about 3 m tall with fluting and a cast ornamental band, a six-paned glass lantern at its top under a little dome, a square stone base, a crossbar on the column for the lamplighter's ladder.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是立柱式铸铁街灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是从墙角伸出的铁臂挂灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the cast iron column lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a lamp hung from an iron arm reaching out of a wall corner, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 主街每 10 格一盏；点亮格只在玻璃里有暖光。

subject.zh: 城中广场的喷泉：一只约 4 米宽、到大腿高的圆形石池，池心一根石柱托着两层小石盆，水从上层盆边流下，池沿是灰白石，池里的水是浅灰蓝，池边有几级台阶。
subject.en: A city square fountain: a round stone basin about 4 m wide and thigh high, a column at its center holding two tiers of small stone bowls with water spilling over their rims, the coping grey white stone, the water a pale grey blue, a few steps around the edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两层石盆的喷泉；第 2 格单层、池心是一只石鱼的喷泉；第 3 格靠墙的半圆壁泉；第 4 格干涸、池底积着落叶的喷泉。
extra.en: Cell 1: the two-tier fountain; cell 2: a single tier with a stone fish at its center; cell 3: a half-round wall fountain; cell 4: a dry fountain with leaves in its basin.

items.notes: 这是瓦伦城邑包的 well 装饰；水只画平静的浅色面与几道流水的竖线，不画溅水特效。

subject.zh: 码头货桶：一只约 1 米高的大橡木桶，三道铁箍，桶身用白漆画着一个商号的圆形记号（不是字），桶边沾着湿痕，常成排码在码头与仓库门口。
subject.en: A dock barrel: a large oak cask about 1 m tall with three iron hoops, a merchant house's round mark painted in white on its side (not lettering), wet streaks along it, often stacked in rows on the docks and at warehouse doors.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只货桶；第 2 格横放成金字塔的三只；第 3 格两只并排；第 4 格开盖装着咸鱼的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single cask; cell 2: three laid in a pyramid; cell 3: two side by side; cell 4: open and holding salted fish.

items.notes: 商号记号只是圆与线的图形。

subject.zh: 码头货箱：一只约 1 米见方的深色木箱，四角包铁，侧面钉着两道粗木条，箱盖上压着一块油布，箱面用黑漆画着一个锚形或秤形的记号。
subject.en: A dock crate: a dark wooden box about 1 m on a side, iron-capped corners, two heavy battens nailed on its sides, an oilcloth weighted on its lid, an anchor or scale mark painted in black on its face.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑绳的货箱；第 2 格两道交叉绳的货箱；第 3 格吊货网兜里的两只箱；第 4 格叠起三只的货箱。
extra.en: Cell 1: a crate with one diagonal rope; cell 2: with two crossed ropes; cell 3: two crates in a cargo net; cell 4: three stacked.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；记号只是图形。

subject.zh: 城中路牌与挂牌：一根约 2 米高的灰石小方柱，柱顶装着铁指向牌；或一只从墙上伸出的铁架，挂着一块只画纹章的木招牌（杯、砧、秤、书），铁架有卷花装饰。
subject.en: City signposts and hanging signs: a small grey stone pillar about 2 m tall with iron arrow plates at its top; or an iron bracket reaching from a wall with a wooden sign painted only with an emblem (a cup, an anvil, scales, a book), the bracket decorated with scrollwork.

extra.zh: 第 1 格石柱铁指向牌；第 2 格铁架挂着酒杯纹章牌；第 3 格铁架挂着秤纹章牌；第 4 格立在两屋之间空隙里的侧缝立牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a stone pillar with iron arrows; cell 2: an iron bracket with a cup emblem sign; cell 3: an iron bracket with a scales emblem sign; cell 4: a side-gap sign standing in the space between two houses.

items.notes: 只有纹章与箭头，不写字；侧缝立牌是镜头补救用的，要从南面看得清。

subject.zh: 铸铁栏杆一段：约 1.2 米高、2 米宽的黑铁栏杆，竖条顶端是矛头形，中间有一道铸花横带，两端是方石小柱，铁面有一点锈。
subject.en: A section of cast iron railing: black iron about 1.2 m tall and 2 m wide, its bars topped with spearheads, an ornamental cast band across the middle, small square stone piers at both ends, a little rust on the iron.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一扇铁门的一段；第 4 格一根竖条弯掉的旧栏杆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with an iron gate; cell 4: an old section with one bent bar.

items.notes: 两端能接；矛头形是简单的三角，不加多余花饰。

subject.zh: 瓦伦集市的雨棚货摊：一座约 3 米宽的木摊，四根柱子撑起斜坡的条纹布雨棚，摊台分两层，摆着布匹、陶器、苹果与面包，台下是装货的木箱。
subject.en: A Valen market awning stall: a wooden stand about 3 m wide, four posts holding a sloped striped canvas awning, a two-tier counter laid with cloth bolts, pottery, apples and bread, crates of stock beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红白条纹雨棚；第 2 格蓝白条纹雨棚；第 3 格绿白条纹雨棚；第 4 格砖红素色雨棚、挂着一串香肠。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red and white striped awning; cell 2: a blue and white striped awning; cell 3: a green and white striped awning; cell 4: a plain brick red awning with a string of sausages.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；比洛萨乡野的摊子更大更规整。

subject.zh: 城中长椅：两块灰石座托着一条厚木椅面，约 2 米长，椅面到膝盖高，木板被磨得发亮，石座上刻着简单的线脚。
subject.en: A city bench: two grey stone supports carrying a thick wooden seat about 2 m long at knee height, the boards polished by use, simple moldings carved on the stone supports.

extra.zh: 第 1 格石座木面长椅；第 2 格带铁靠背的长椅；第 3 格整块石凳；第 4 格一端堆着几只麻袋的长椅。
extra.en: Cell 1: stone supports and a wooden seat; cell 2: with an iron backrest; cell 3: a solid stone bench; cell 4: with a few sacks piled at one end.

items.notes: 前庭四角与市集用。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡城门旗帜：一根约 4.5 米高的木旗杆，顶上一枚铁矛尖，挂着一面竖长的旗，旗面中央是城徽：一只展翅的鹰立在一座岩丘上，旗边缀着金色流苏。
subject.en: A Valenburg gate banner: a wooden pole about 4.5 m tall tipped with an iron spearhead, hanging a tall vertical banner whose center bears the city arms: a hawk with spread wings standing on a rocky hill, gold fringe along its edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红底 #8a3e30 鹰旗；第 2 格蓝底 #3e4a5e 鹰旗；第 3 格黑底白鹰的伯爵家旗；第 4 格褪色、下沿磨破的旧旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red #8a3e30 hawk banner; cell 2: a blue #3e4a5e hawk banner; cell 3: the count's house banner, a white hawk on black; cell 4: an old faded banner frayed at the bottom.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；鹰与岩丘是图形，不写字。

subject.zh: 卫兵的铁火篮：一只立在长铁脚上的铁条编笼火篮，约 1.5 米高，篮里烧着柴与煤块，铁条被烧得发黑发红，脚下放着一桶备用的煤。
subject.en: A guard's iron fire basket: a cage of iron straps on a tall iron stand, about 1.5 m high, burning wood and coal inside, the straps blackened and reddened by heat, a bucket of spare coal at its foot.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格长脚铁火篮；第 2 格挂在墙上铁臂里的火篮；第 3 格城门下的大铁盆；第 4 格码头边的圆铁桶火。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the tall-legged fire basket; cell 2: a basket in an iron wall bracket; cell 3: a large iron bowl under the gate; cell 4: a round iron drum fire on the docks.

items.notes: 城门内侧与码头守军用；火只在篮里。

subject.zh: 城中英雄石像：一尊约 3.5 米高的灰白石像，披甲持剑、剑尖拄地，斗篷垂在身后，脸部风化得只剩轮廓，立在一座刻着鹰纹的方座上，肩头积着鸽子留下的白痕。
subject.en: A city hero statue: a grey white stone figure about 3.5 m tall in armor, sword point resting on the ground, a cloak hanging behind, the face weathered to a bare outline, on a square plinth carved with a hawk, white marks on the shoulders left by pigeons.

extra.zh: 第 1 格拄剑的石像；第 2 格举剑向天的石像；第 3 格骑马的小石像（马与人都风化）；第 4 格断了剑、座上长着苔的石像。
extra.en: Cell 1: leaning on the sword; cell 2: raising the sword skyward; cell 3: a small equestrian statue (horse and rider both weathered); cell 4: with a broken sword and moss on the plinth.

items.notes: 不能像任何真实人物；脸部无细节；座上不刻字。

subject.zh: 教堂墓园的墓碑：一块约 1 米高的灰白石碑，碑顶有简单的拱形或尖角线脚，碑面刻着一圈细边框，碑前一小块整齐的草地，石面有雨水留下的深色竖纹。
subject.en: A cathedral churchyard headstone: a grey white stone about 1 m tall with a simple arched or pointed molding at its top, a fine border carved on its face, a small neat patch of grass before it, dark vertical rain streaks on the stone.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶墓碑；第 2 格立柱加横木的石墓标；第 3 格平放的墓板；第 4 格围着铁栏的家族墓碑。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped headstone; cell 2: a stone post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: a flat grave slab; cell 4: a family headstone with an iron railing.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；碑面不写字。

subject.zh: 马厩的方草捆堆：几个用麻绳捆紧的长方草捆叠成约 2 米高的一堆，草色金黄偏灰，草捆边缘整齐，旁边靠着一把草叉。
subject.en: Square hay bales of the stables: a few rectangular bales bound tight with twine stacked about 2 m high, the hay golden with a grey cast, the bale edges neat, a hayfork leaning beside them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格叠成方堆；第 2 格散放的两捆；第 3 格叠成阶梯形；第 4 格一捆被拆开、草散了一地。
extra.en: Cell 1: stacked into a block; cell 2: two bales loose; cell 3: stacked like steps; cell 4: one bale broken open, hay spread on the ground.

items.notes: 城里的草垛是方捆不是圆垛。

subject.zh: 商人的篷车：一辆约 3.5 米长的四轮货车，车上用弓形木架撑起一片米白帆布篷，篷侧画着一个商号的圆形记号，车板上露出木箱与布包，车辕落在地上。
subject.en: A merchant's covered wagon: a four-wheeled cart about 3.5 m long, hooped wooden frames holding a cream canvas cover painted on its side with a merchant house's round mark, crates and bundles visible at the tailboard, the shafts resting on the ground.

extra.zh: 第 1 格帆布篷车；第 2 格没篷、装满货箱的平板车；第 3 格篷布卷起、正在卸货的车；第 4 格缺了一只轮、用木块垫着的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: the canvas-covered wagon; cell 2: a flatbed piled with crates, no cover; cell 3: the cover rolled back, being unloaded; cell 4: missing a wheel, propped on blocks.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头；不画马。

subject.zh: 教国丘陵的橄榄树：扭曲多节的灰褐树干，约 4 米高，树干中间常有空洞，树冠低而宽，细长的叶片正面暗绿 #6b7a3a、背面银绿 #a9b878，枝间挂着小小的青黑果实。
subject.en: An olive tree of the Holy See hills: a gnarled, twisting grey brown trunk about 4 m tall, often hollowed in the middle, a low broad crown of slender leaves dark green #6b7a3a above and silver green #a9b878 beneath, small green black fruit hanging among the twigs.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准橄榄树；第 2 格老树，树干中空分成两股；第 3 格修剪过、树冠圆整的果园树；第 4 格结满黑果的橄榄树。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard olive; cell 2: an old tree with a hollow trunk split in two; cell 3: a pruned orchard tree with a neat round crown; cell 4: an olive heavy with black fruit.

items.notes: 银绿的叶背是辨识点，用两阶绿交错。

subject.zh: 修院与墓园旁的柏树：细高如火焰的深绿柏树，约 6 米高，树冠紧密，顶端尖细，叶色暗绿到墨绿两阶，底部露出一小截红褐树干。
subject.en: A cypress by cloisters and graveyards: a tall slender dark green tree shaped like a flame, about 6 m tall, a tight crown narrowing to a fine point, foliage in two steps from dark to ink green, a short bit of red brown trunk showing at the base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单棵柏树；第 2 格更矮更胖的柏树；第 3 格两棵并立；第 4 格被风吹歪了尖的柏树。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single cypress; cell 2: a shorter, fuller one; cell 3: two standing together; cell 4: one with its tip bent by wind.

items.notes: 常成排种在路边与墓园，四个变体宽度接近。

subject.zh: 白石丘陵上的伞松：一根略弯的红褐树干撑起平顶伞状的树冠，约 5.5 米高，树冠是浓密的暗绿针叶，下沿平齐，树干上半截才分枝。
subject.en: A stone pine on the white hills: a slightly curved red brown trunk holding up a flat umbrella-shaped crown about 5.5 m tall, the crown dense dark green needles with a level underside, the trunk branching only in its upper half.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准伞松；第 2 格树干弯向一侧的伞松；第 3 格两层伞冠的伞松；第 4 格年轻、伞冠较小的伞松。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard stone pine; cell 2: one with its trunk bending to one side; cell 3: one with a two-tiered canopy; cell 4: a young pine with a smaller canopy.

items.notes: 伞冠的平底是辨识点。

subject.zh: 白色石灰岩：教国丘陵上的大块白石，高 1.5 到 2.5 米，石面有雨水溶出的细沟与小孔，颜色是暖白 #ddd8cc 带浅灰阴影，石脚长着几丛干草与百里香。
subject.en: White limestone: a large white rock of the Holy See hills, 1.5 to 2.5 m tall, its surface etched with fine rain-cut grooves and small pits, warm white #ddd8cc with pale grey shadows, a few tufts of dry grass and thyme at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶白石；第 2 格层叠的板状白石；第 3 格裂成两半的白石；第 4 格一块倒卧的长条白石。
extra.en: Cell 1: a dome-topped rock; cell 2: stacked slabs; cell 3: a rock split in two; cell 4: a long rock lying on its side.

items.notes: 白石不用纯白，暗面用浅灰与一点暖褐。

subject.zh: 白垩碎石：几块大小不一的白色碎石，最高到膝盖，棱角被磨圆，石缝里夹着干枯的橄榄叶与一株小百里香。
subject.en: Chalk stones: a few white stones of different sizes, the tallest knee high, their edges worn round, dry olive leaves and a small sprig of thyme caught between them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格朝圣路边堆起的小石塔；第 3 格半埋在土里的白石；第 4 格一圈白石围着一株小橄榄苗。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered stones; cell 2: a little cairn by the pilgrim road; cell 3: a white stone half buried; cell 4: a ring of stones around an olive seedling.

items.notes: 朝圣路边的小石塔是信徒堆的，不写字。

subject.zh: 薰衣草与迷迭香丛：一丛约 0.8 米高的灰绿灌丛，薰衣草挺着一根根淡紫花穗，迷迭香是针形细叶开着浅蓝小花，适合种在修院小径两侧。
subject.en: Lavender and rosemary: a grey green clump about 0.8 m tall, the lavender raising slender pale lilac spikes, the rosemary with needle-fine leaves and small pale blue flowers, suited to both sides of cloister paths.

extra.zh: 第 1 格开花的薰衣草丛；第 2 格迷迭香丛；第 3 格两者混种的一丛；第 4 格剪过花穗的薰衣草。
extra.en: Cell 1: flowering lavender; cell 2: rosemary; cell 3: the two planted together; cell 4: lavender with its spikes cut.

items.notes: 薰衣草的淡紫偏粉蓝，要和澱紫明显不同：亮、浅、偏蓝。

subject.zh: 白百合花丛：一丛约 0.9 米高的白百合，长长的绿茎上开着喇叭形的大白花，花蕊点着一点淡金，叶片细长，适合种在圣堂前庭与圣像脚下。
subject.en: White lilies: a clump about 0.9 m tall, long green stems bearing large trumpet-shaped white flowers with a touch of pale gold at their hearts, long slender leaves, suited to cathedral forecourts and the feet of statues.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛开的一丛；第 2 格花苞多、开花少；第 3 格种在白石盆里；第 4 格插在陶瓶里的一束。
extra.en: Cell 1: in full bloom; cell 2: mostly buds, few open; cell 3: planted in a white stone pot; cell 4: a bunch in a clay vase.

items.notes: 花用暖白，花蕊淡金不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 教国的圣灯：一根约 3 米高的白石灯柱，柱身刻着细细的光芒纹，柱顶托着一只金框四面灯笼，灯笼顶上是一枚小小的镂空光轮，柱脚是两级白石台。
subject.en: A Holy See sacred lamp: a white stone lamp column about 3 m tall carved with fine ray patterns, holding at its top a gold-framed four-sided lantern topped by a small pierced halo wheel, its foot two white stone steps.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是白石柱圣灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是从拱廊墙上伸出的金铁臂挂灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the white column lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a lamp hung from a gilded iron arm reaching out of an arcade wall, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在灯笼里有暖光；光轮用暖金 #c9a646，不用神光白金。

subject.zh: 修院回廊的白石井：一口齐腰高的八角形白石井，八面各刻着一枚小光轮，井上架着一副弯曲的铁井架，挂着一只铜桶，井沿被打水的绳磨出几道凹痕。
subject.en: A cloister well of white stone: a waist-high octagonal white stone wellhead with a small halo wheel carved on each of its eight faces, a curved iron wellhead frame above it holding a copper bucket, rope grooves worn into the rim by drawing water.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带铁井架的八角井；第 2 格盖着木盖的井；第 3 格井边摆着几只陶罐的井；第 4 格井架上爬着葡萄藤的井。
extra.en: Cell 1: the octagonal well with its iron frame; cell 2: covered with a wooden lid; cell 3: with a few clay jars beside it; cell 4: with a grapevine climbing its frame.

items.notes: 光轮浅刻，不涂金。

subject.zh: 葡萄酒桶：一只约 1 米高的大橡木桶，两道铁箍，桶身被红酒染出几道深紫红的痕，桶头装着一只木龙头，桶上烙着一枚小葡萄串纹。
subject.en: A wine barrel: a large oak cask about 1 m tall with two iron hoops, its staves stained with a few deep wine red streaks, a wooden tap in its head, a small bunch-of-grapes mark branded on it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格立着的酒桶；第 2 格横放在木架上的酒桶；第 3 格两只叠起；第 4 格开盖、装着压过的葡萄渣。
extra.en: Cell 1: an upright barrel; cell 2: on a wooden cradle; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: open, full of pressed grape pulp.

items.notes: 酒渍是暗红偏紫，面积小，不要与澱紫混淆。

subject.zh: 修院的白木箱：一只约 0.8 米见方的浅色木箱，箱板刷过白灰，四角包着薄铜，箱面烙着一枚光轮，常装着蜡烛、经卷与橄榄油罐。
subject.en: A monastery white crate: a pale wooden box about 0.8 m square, its boards washed with whitewash, thin copper caps on its corners, a halo wheel branded on its face, often holding candles, scrolls and olive oil jars.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑麻绳的箱子；第 2 格两道交叉麻绳的箱子；第 3 格开盖、露出一捆白蜡烛；第 4 格叠起的两只箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal rope; cell 2: two crossed ropes; cell 3: open, showing a bundle of white candles; cell 4: two stacked.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1。

subject.zh: 朝圣路标：一根约 1.6 米高的白石方柱，柱顶刻着一枚光轮，朝路的一面刻着一个指向的手形与几道代表路程的短刻线，柱脚放着朝圣者留下的小石子。
subject.en: A pilgrim waymark: a square white stone post about 1.6 m tall with a halo wheel carved at its top, the face toward the road carved with a pointing hand and a few short notches marking the distance, pebbles left by pilgrims at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单向路标；第 2 格岔口的双向路标；第 3 格矮的里程石；第 4 格柱上系着朝圣者布条的路标。
extra.en: Cell 1: a one-way marker; cell 2: a two-way marker at a fork; cell 3: a low milestone; cell 4: a marker tied with pilgrims' ribbons.

items.notes: 只有图形与短刻线，不写字不写数字。

subject.zh: 白石矮墙一段：一段约 1 米高、2 米长的干砌白石矮墙，石块大小不一但砌得整齐，墙顶压着一排扁平的盖石，墙脚长着几丛薰衣草。
subject.en: A low white stone wall section: a dry-laid white stone wall about 1 m tall and 2 m long, its stones of mixed sizes but neatly fitted, a row of flat capstones along its top, a few clumps of lavender at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格中间开着一道拱形小门的一段；第 4 格塌了一角的旧墙。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a small arched gate; cell 4: an old section collapsed at one corner.

items.notes: 两端能接；葡萄园与修院用。

subject.zh: 朝圣者纪念品摊：一座约 2.5 米宽的木摊，白布棚上缀着金色流苏，摊台上摆着小光轮挂件、蜡烛、圣水小瓶与橄榄木念珠，摊边挂着一串小铜铃。
subject.en: A pilgrim souvenir stall: a wooden stand about 2.5 m wide under a white awning with gold tassels, its counter laid with small halo-wheel pendants, candles, little vials of holy water and olive wood prayer beads, a string of small bells hanging at its side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白棚红边；第 2 格白棚蓝边；第 3 格白棚绿边；第 4 格全白棚、只卖蜡烛。
extra.en: Cell 1: white with red trim; cell 2: white with blue trim; cell 3: white with green trim; cell 4: all white, selling only candles.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格以棚边色对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；货品不写价签。

subject.zh: 白石长椅：一条约 2 米长的白石长椅，椅面光滑微凹，两端是雕着橄榄枝的石座，椅面到膝盖高，椅背后种着一排矮柏。
subject.en: A white stone bench: a bench about 2 m long, its seat smooth and slightly dished, both ends carved stone supports with olive branches, the seat at knee height, a row of low cypress behind it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格无背石椅；第 2 格带矮靠背的石椅；第 3 格半圆形的环椅一段；第 4 格椅面落着橄榄叶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a backless bench; cell 2: with a low back; cell 3: a section of a semicircular exedra seat; cell 4: olive leaves fallen on the seat.

items.notes: 矮柏只画一点点作背景，不要压过椅子。

subject.zh: 教会长幡：一根约 4 米高的白木杆，顶上一枚金色光轮，挂着一条白底长幡，幡面中央是一枚大金光轮，四周有一圈橄榄枝纹，幡尾剪成三角并缀着金穗。
subject.en: A church pennant: a white wooden pole about 4 m tall topped by a gold halo wheel, hanging a long white pennant bearing a large gold halo wheel at its center ringed by olive branches, its tail cut in a point and fringed with gold.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白底红边长幡；第 2 格白底蓝边长幡；第 3 格纯白金纹长幡；第 4 格橄榄绿底金纹的修会幡。
extra.en: Cell 1: white with a red border; cell 2: white with a blue border; cell 3: pure white with gold; cell 4: an olive green order pennant with gold.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝以边色对应变体 0、1；金用暖金 #c9a646。

subject.zh: 青铜火盆：一只约 1.2 米高的三足青铜火盆，盆沿铸着一圈光芒纹，三只兽爪形盆脚，盆里燃着橄榄木，火焰旺而干净，盆身有暗绿铜锈。
subject.en: A bronze brazier: a three-legged bronze fire bowl about 1.2 m tall, a band of rays cast around its rim, three claw-shaped feet, burning olive wood with a bright clean flame, dark green patina on its body.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格三足青铜盆；第 2 格高柱上的大盆；第 3 格一对中较小的那只；第 4 格石台上的方形火盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the three-legged bronze bowl; cell 2: a large bowl on a tall column; cell 3: the smaller of a pair; cell 4: a square brazier on a stone base.

items.notes: 圣堂前庭与碑庭用；火是暖色。

subject.zh: 教国的圣像：一尊约 3.5 米高的白石圣徒像，身披长袍、头戴兜帽，一手持着顶端是光轮的长杖，一手按在胸前，脸部只雕出平静的轮廓，立在雕着橄榄枝的方座上。
subject.en: A Holy See saint statue: a white stone figure about 3.5 m tall in a long robe and hood, one hand holding a tall staff crowned with a halo wheel, the other pressed to the chest, the face carved only as a calm outline, on a square plinth carved with olive branches.

extra.zh: 第 1 格持杖圣徒像；第 2 格双手合十的圣徒像；第 3 格怀抱书卷的圣徒像；第 4 格脚下摆满蜡烛与花的圣徒像。
extra.en: Cell 1: the saint with the staff; cell 2: a saint with hands joined; cell 3: a saint holding a scroll; cell 4: a saint with candles and flowers heaped at its feet.

items.notes: 不刻五官细节，不能像任何现实宗教人物；光轮杖不涂神光白金。

subject.zh: 白大理石墓：一块约 1 米高的白大理石墓碑，碑顶雕成拱形并刻着一枚小光轮，碑前是一块长方的白石墓板，墓板上放着一束白百合，石面有细小的雨痕。
subject.en: A white marble grave: a white marble headstone about 1 m tall arched at its top and carved with a small halo wheel, a long white stone slab before it with a bunch of white lilies laid on it, fine rain streaks on the stone.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶墓碑；第 2 格立柱加横木的白石墓标；第 3 格带一对小柏树的家族墓；第 4 格一块平放的墓板。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped headstone; cell 2: a white stone post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: a family grave flanked by two small cypresses; cell 4: a flat grave slab.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；碑面不写字。

subject.zh: 麦秸垛：一堆约 2 米高的浅金色麦秸垛成的尖顶垛，表面平整，垛顶插着一根木杆，杆上挂着一只小草编的光轮，垛脚散着几缕麦秸。
subject.en: A straw stack: a pointed stack of pale golden wheat straw about 2 m tall with a smooth surface, a wooden pole stuck in its top hung with a small woven straw halo wheel, a few wisps of straw at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格尖顶麦秸垛；第 2 格圆顶麦秸垛；第 3 格一排麦捆；第 4 格被扒开一半的垛。
extra.en: Cell 1: a pointed straw stack; cell 2: a dome stack; cell 3: a row of sheaves; cell 4: a stack half pulled apart.

items.notes: 颜色比洛萨草垛更浅更亮。

subject.zh: 朝圣者推车：一辆约 2.5 米长的两轮木推车，车上用弓形木条撑起一片白布篷，篷侧画着一枚金光轮，车里放着行囊、水罐与一根朝圣杖，车轮包着铁圈。
subject.en: A pilgrim cart: a two-wheeled wooden handcart about 2.5 m long under a white cloth hood held on bent wooden hoops, a gold halo wheel painted on the hood's side, bundles, water jars and a pilgrim's staff inside, iron tires on its wheels.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白布篷推车；第 2 格篷布卷起、装着行囊；第 3 格空车；第 4 格一只轮子陷进路边沟里的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: with the white hood; cell 2: the hood rolled back, loaded with bundles; cell 3: empty; cell 4: one wheel stuck in a roadside ditch.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头；不画朝圣者。

subject.zh: 成行的钻天杨：柱形的树冠紧紧收拢，约 6 米高，灰绿树皮笔直，叶子细碎在风里闪着浅绿与银灰，帝国御道两旁成排种植。
subject.en: A row-planted Lombardy poplar: a columnar crown pulled tight, about 6 m tall, a straight grey green trunk, small leaves flickering pale green and silver grey in the wind, planted in rows along the imperial roads.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准钻天杨；第 2 格更高更细的一棵；第 3 格秋天金黄的一棵；第 4 格冬天光秃的柱形枝。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard Lombardy poplar; cell 2: a taller, thinner one; cell 3: golden in autumn; cell 4: bare columnar branches in winter.

items.notes: 与瓦伦河岸的杨树区分：这里更窄更像柱子。

subject.zh: 栗树：粗壮的灰褐树干带螺旋状的树皮纹，约 5 米高，宽大的树冠由锯齿状长叶组成，叶色中绿，枝间挂着带刺的绿色栗球。
subject.en: A chestnut tree: a stout grey brown trunk with spiraling bark grooves, about 5 m tall, a broad crown of long serrated leaves in mid green, spiny green burrs hanging among the twigs.

extra.zh: 第 1 格夏天的栗树；第 2 格秋天，栗球裂开、叶子金褐；第 3 格树下落满栗球的老树；第 4 格冬天光秃的栗树。
extra.en: Cell 1: in summer; cell 2: autumn, burrs split open, leaves gold brown; cell 3: an old tree with burrs fallen all around; cell 4: bare in winter.

items.notes: 螺旋树皮纹是辨识点。

subject.zh: 剥过树皮的栓皮栎：树干下半截的厚树皮被剥去，露出赭红 #a85a3a 的内层，上半截保留灰褐粗皮，约 4.5 米高，树冠是暗绿的小硬叶。
