subject.en: A stripped cork oak: the thick bark of the lower trunk stripped away to show the ochre red #a85a3a layer beneath, the upper trunk keeping its grey brown rough bark, about 4.5 m tall, a crown of small hard dark green leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚剥皮的赭红树干；第 2 格剥过几年、颜色变暗的树干；第 3 格没剥过皮的老树；第 4 格树脚堆着剥下的树皮。
extra.en: Cell 1: freshly stripped, bright ochre; cell 2: stripped years ago, darkened; cell 3: an old unstripped tree; cell 4: stripped bark piled at its foot.

items.notes: 赭红树干呼应本包主色。

subject.zh: 赭红砂岩：帝国平原上的大块赭红砂岩，高 1.5 到 3 米，石面有一层层水平的沉积纹，颜色从赭红 #a85a3a 到土黄，顶面被风磨圆。
subject.en: Ochre sandstone: a large block of ochre red sandstone on the imperial plain, 1.5 to 3 m tall, its face banded with horizontal sedimentary layers, colored from ochre red #a85a3a to earthy yellow, its top rounded by wind.

extra.zh: 第 1 格方块砂岩；第 2 格蘑菇形的风蚀岩；第 3 格层层叠起的砂岩；第 4 格一侧被凿成石料的砂岩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a blocky sandstone; cell 2: a mushroom-shaped wind-carved rock; cell 3: stacked layers; cell 4: one side quarried into blocks.

items.notes: 水平层纹用两三阶赭红与土黄交替。

subject.zh: 夯土与碎砖：长垒旧段坍下来的赭红夯土块与碎砖，最高到膝盖，夯土块上看得见一层层的夯筑横纹，碎砖边缘磨圆，夹着几片锈甲片。
subject.en: Rammed earth and broken brick: ochre lumps of rammed earth and broken brick fallen from old stretches of the Long Rampart, the tallest knee high, the earth lumps showing their layered tamping lines, the brick edges worn round, a few rusted armor scales among them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一小堆夯土块；第 2 格散开的碎砖；第 3 格一块带夯筑纹的大土块；第 4 格碎砖里插着一截断矛。
extra.en: Cell 1: a small heap of rammed earth; cell 2: scattered brick; cell 3: one large lump with tamping lines; cell 4: a broken spear stuck in the brick.

items.notes: 帝国包的"碎石"种类。

subject.zh: 干旱的刺灌：一丛约 1 米高、枝条坚硬的灰绿刺灌，叶子小而厚，枝间开着几朵小黄花，根部周围的土是干裂的赭黄。
subject.en: A drought thornbush: a clump about 1 m tall of hard grey green thorny stems, small thick leaves, a few tiny yellow flowers among the twigs, the earth around its roots cracked dry ochre yellow.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆团刺灌；第 2 格开小黄花的刺灌；第 3 格被羊啃过、枝条参差的刺灌；第 4 格枯死发灰的刺灌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round thornbush; cell 2: with tiny yellow flowers; cell 3: browsed by goats, stems ragged; cell 4: dead and grey.

items.notes: 颜色偏灰绿，与平原的麦黄搭配。

subject.zh: 麦田边的红罂粟与麦穗：一丛齐膝高的金黄麦穗中夹着几朵大红罂粟，花瓣是鲜红 #8a3a26 偏亮，花心黑点，麦芒细而直。
subject.en: Red poppies and wheat at the field edge: a knee-high clump of golden wheat ears with a few large red poppies among them, the petals bright red #8a3a26 lifted a step, black dots at their hearts, the wheat awns fine and straight.

extra.zh: 第 1 格麦穗多、罂粟少；第 2 格罂粟多；第 3 格只有罂粟的一丛；第 4 格割过的麦茬与一朵罂粟。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly wheat, few poppies; cell 2: mostly poppies; cell 3: poppies alone; cell 4: cut stubble with a single poppy.

items.notes: 麦色 #d8b45a 一类；千穗平原的气质。

subject.zh: 帝国御道的铁灯柱：一根约 3 米高的方形铁柱，柱顶挂着一只方形铁框灯笼，灯笼四面是磨砂玻璃，柱身中段有一圈铸着军团徽记（双头斧与月桂）的铁箍，柱脚是赭石方座。
subject.en: An imperial road lamp: a square iron post about 3 m tall with a square iron-framed lantern of frosted glass at its top, a cast iron band bearing the legion device (a double axe and laurel) around its middle, an ochre stone square base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是方柱铁灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是营门两侧的方石灯台的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the square iron post lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a square stone lamp pillar flanking a camp gate, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在灯笼里；徽记是图形。

subject.zh: 军营方石井：一口齐腰高的方形赭石井，四角立着四根矮石柱，井上架着一根木横梁与一只铁辘轳，绳上挂着一只皮水袋，井边放着一排军用水桶。
subject.en: A camp square well: a waist-high square well of ochre stone with four low stone posts at its corners, a wooden crossbeam and an iron windlass above, a leather water bag on the rope, a row of army buckets beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带辘轳的方井；第 2 格盖着铁栅盖的井；第 3 格井边排着水桶；第 4 格学城灰石的方井（换材质）。
extra.en: Cell 1: the square well with windlass; cell 2: covered with an iron grate; cell 3: with buckets lined up beside it; cell 4: a square well of the academy city's grey stone (alternate material).

items.notes: 第 4 格给斯克里瓦学城用（灰石与青瓦外观）。

subject.zh: 军需木桶：一只约 0.9 米高的木桶，三道铁箍，桶身烙着一枚圆形军团徽记（双头斧与月桂），桶盖封着蜡，常成排码在营地辎重区。
subject.en: A supply barrel: a wooden cask about 0.9 m tall with three iron hoops, a round legion device (a double axe and laurel) branded on its side, its lid sealed with wax, often stacked in rows in the camp baggage yard.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只军需桶；第 2 格三只成一排；第 3 格横放的两只；第 4 格开盖、装着谷粒的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single supply barrel; cell 2: three in a row; cell 3: two lying on their sides; cell 4: open, holding grain.

items.notes: 徽记是图形不写字。

subject.zh: 军团补给箱：一只约 0.9 米长的长方木箱，箱板漆成赭红，四角包铁，两侧装着铁提手，箱面用白漆画着一个简单的连队记号（三道竖杠与一个圆）。
subject.en: A legion supply crate: a rectangular wooden box about 0.9 m long, its boards painted ochre red, iron-capped corners, iron carrying handles on both ends, a simple company mark painted in white on its face (three vertical bars and a circle).

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑皮带的箱子；第 2 格两道交叉皮带的箱子；第 3 格叠成三层的箱子；第 4 格开盖、装着短剑的箱子。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal strap; cell 2: two crossed straps; cell 3: stacked three high; cell 4: open, holding short swords.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；连队记号是几何图形。

subject.zh: 帝国里程柱：一根约 1.6 米高的赭石圆柱，柱顶是一个小方帽，柱身刻着一圈横向刻线与一个指向的箭头，刻线代表到帝都的路程，柱脚围着一圈铺路石。
subject.en: An imperial milestone: a round ochre stone column about 1.6 m tall with a small square cap, a ring of horizontal incised lines and a pointing arrow carved on its shaft, the lines counting the distance to the capital, a ring of paving stones around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格里程柱；第 2 格路口的指向柱（三个箭头）；第 3 格倒在路边的旧里程柱；第 4 格柱上钉着一块布告木牌（牌面空白）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a milestone; cell 2: a crossroads post with three arrows; cell 3: an old milestone fallen by the road; cell 4: a notice board nailed to the column (blank).

items.notes: 刻线不能像数字；牌面空白。

subject.zh: 营垒尖木桩栅：一段约 1.8 米高、2 米宽的削尖木桩栅，桩与桩之间用横木与麻绳绑牢，桩头削得锐利，木色赭黄，底部用夯土培住。
subject.en: A camp palisade section: sharpened stakes about 1.8 m tall and 2 m wide, lashed together with crossbars and hemp rope, the points cut keen, the wood ochre yellow, the base banked with rammed earth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一扇木栅门的一段；第 4 格一根桩被拔掉的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a wooden gate; cell 4: a section with one stake pulled out.

items.notes: 两端能接；军营与斗场外围用。

subject.zh: 帝都市集摊：一座约 2.8 米宽的木摊，两根柱子撑着一片斜挂的厚布棚，摊台上摆着赭陶罐、成捆的麦穗、橄榄油瓶与一筐无花果，台下挂着一张草席。
subject.en: A capital market stall: a wooden stand about 2.8 m wide, two posts holding a slanting heavy cloth awning, the counter laid with ochre clay jars, bound sheaves of wheat, olive oil bottles and a basket of figs, a straw mat hanging beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红棚；第 2 格蓝棚；第 3 格绿棚；第 4 格赭黄棚、卖陶器。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red awning; cell 2: a blue awning; cell 3: a green awning; cell 4: an ochre yellow awning selling pottery.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；不写价签。

subject.zh: 赭石长凳：一条约 2 米长的赭红石凳，凳面是整块打磨过的石板，两端是方形石墩，石墩侧面刻着一枚月桂纹，凳面到膝盖高。
subject.en: An ochre stone bench: a red ochre bench about 2 m long, its seat a single ground slab, square stone blocks at both ends with a laurel carved on their sides, the seat at knee height.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平凳；第 2 格带矮靠背的石凳；第 3 格斗场看台的一段石阶座；第 4 格凳上放着一顶头盔。
extra.en: Cell 1: a plain bench; cell 2: with a low backrest; cell 3: a section of arena tier seating; cell 4: a helmet resting on it.

items.notes: 帝都与竞技场共用。

subject.zh: 帝国军旗：一根约 4.5 米高的黑木旗杆，杆顶是一只展翅的铁鹰，横杆下挂着一面方形军旗，旗面中央是钢灰的双头斧与环绕的金色月桂，旗下沿缀着金穗，布面厚重。
subject.en: The imperial banner: a black wooden pole about 4.5 m tall topped by an iron eagle with spread wings, a square war banner hanging from its crossbar, steel grey double axe at its center ringed by a gold laurel, gold fringe along its lower edge, heavy cloth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格赭红底 #8a3a26 军旗；第 2 格钢灰底 #6a6e74 军旗；第 3 格赭黄底的辅军旗；第 4 格残破焦黑的旧军旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: an ochre red #8a3a26 banner; cell 2: a steel grey #6a6e74 banner; cell 3: an ochre yellow auxiliary banner; cell 4: an old banner tattered and scorched.

items.notes: 兼作帝国包的 banner 装饰：第 1 格（变体 0）赭红、第 2 格（变体 1）钢灰；纹章只是图形。

subject.zh: 军团铁火盆：一只四足方形铁火盆，约 1 米高，盆壁铸着月桂纹，四只盆脚是简洁的方柱，盆里烧着木炭，火焰整齐，旁边一只铁桶装着备用的炭。
subject.en: A legion iron brazier: a square four-legged iron fire box about 1 m tall, laurel cast on its sides, plain square posts for its feet, charcoal burning inside with an orderly flame, an iron pail of spare charcoal beside it.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格四足方火盆；第 2 格城墙上的大火盆；第 3 格营门前一对中的一只；第 4 格架在三脚架上的圆火盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the four-legged square brazier; cell 2: a large brazier on the walls; cell 3: one of a pair at the camp gate; cell 4: a round brazier on a tripod.

items.notes: 皇城城墙与军营用；火是暖色。

subject.zh: 持盾军团兵石像：一尊约 3.5 米高的赭石军团兵像，左手持一面长方大盾，右手握着短剑贴在身侧，头戴羽冠头盔，脸部只雕轮廓，立在刻着月桂纹的方座上。
subject.en: A shield-bearing legionary statue: an ochre stone figure about 3.5 m tall, a tall rectangular shield in its left hand, a short sword held close at its right side, a crested helmet on its head, the face carved only in outline, on a square plinth carved with laurel.

extra.zh: 第 1 格持盾持剑的军团兵；第 2 格举起短剑的军团兵；第 3 格骑马的将军像（人马都风化）；第 4 格断了一臂的旧像。
extra.en: Cell 1: the legionary with shield and sword; cell 2: raising the short sword; cell 3: a mounted general (horse and rider weathered); cell 4: an old statue missing an arm.

items.notes: 不能像任何真实人物；不刻五官细节；座上不写字。

subject.zh: 士兵墓标：一个约 1 米高的土丘前插着一柄短剑或一根木桩，木桩顶上扣着一顶铁头盔，土丘上压着几块赭石，墓标旁插着一小束干麦穗。
subject.en: A soldier's grave marker: a mound about 1 m tall with a short sword or a wooden stake planted before it, an iron helmet set atop the stake, a few ochre stones weighting the mound, a small bunch of dry wheat ears stuck beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格前立圆顶石碑的士兵墓；第 2 格立柱加横木木标上扣着头盔；第 3 格插着短剑的墓；第 4 格一排三座的士兵墓。
extra.en: Cell 1: a soldier's grave with a round-topped stone; cell 2: a post-and-crossbar marker crowned with a helmet; cell 3: a grave with a short sword; cell 4: a row of three soldiers' graves.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；不写字。

subject.zh: 麦捆垛：一束束扎好的金黄麦捆立着靠成一个圆锥形的垛，约 2 米高，麦穗朝上，捆腰用麦秆扎着，垛脚散着几根麦穗。
subject.en: A sheaf stook: bound golden wheat sheaves leaned together into a conical stook about 2 m tall, ears upward, each sheaf tied at the waist with straw, a few ears scattered at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆锥麦捆垛；第 2 格一排立着的麦捆；第 3 格大方麦垛；第 4 格被雨淋倒的麦捆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a conical stook; cell 2: a row of standing sheaves; cell 3: a large square rick; cell 4: sheaves knocked down by rain.

items.notes: 千穗平原的麦黄 #d8b45a。

subject.zh: 军用辎重车：一辆约 3.5 米长的四轮重车，车厢侧板漆成赭红，钉着铁条，车上捆着帐篷布卷、成捆的长枪与补给箱，车辕上挂着一面小连队旗。
subject.en: A military baggage wagon: a heavy four-wheeled wagon about 3.5 m long, its side boards painted ochre red and strapped with iron, tent rolls, bundled spears and supply crates lashed on board, a small company pennant hanging from the shaft.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装满辎重的车；第 2 格空车；第 3 格装着伤兵担架的车；第 4 格陷在泥里的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: fully loaded; cell 2: empty; cell 3: carrying stretchers; cell 4: stuck in mud.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头；不画牲口与士兵。

subject.zh: 海岸伞松：一根被海风吹得斜向内陆的红褐树干，约 5 米高，顶上撑开一把平顶伞状的暗绿树冠，树冠一侧被风削平，树皮有鳞片状裂纹。
subject.en: A coastal stone pine: a red brown trunk leaning inland from the sea wind, about 5 m tall, opening at its top into a flat umbrella crown of dark green needles, one side of the crown shorn flat by the wind, scaly cracks in its bark.

extra.zh: 第 1 格斜向一侧的伞松；第 2 格笔直的伞松；第 3 格两棵交错的伞松；第 4 格树下落满松果的老伞松。
extra.en: Cell 1: leaning to one side; cell 2: standing straight; cell 3: two crossing each other; cell 4: an old pine with cones fallen beneath.

items.notes: 与教国的伞松区分：这里更斜、被风塑形。

subject.zh: 无花果树：一棵枝干灰白光滑、分杈很低的矮树，约 4 米高，宽大的掌状叶片翠绿，枝间挂着紫褐与青绿的果实，常种在港城院落的墙边。
subject.en: A fig tree: a low-branching tree with smooth grey white limbs, about 4 m tall, broad palmate leaves of bright green, purple brown and green fruit hanging among the twigs, often planted against courtyard walls of the harbor towns.

extra.zh: 第 1 格结果的无花果树；第 2 格靠着墙生长、一侧平的树；第 3 格年轻的小树；第 4 格冬天落叶、只剩灰白枝。
extra.en: Cell 1: in fruit; cell 2: grown against a wall, flat on one side; cell 3: a young tree; cell 4: leafless in winter, only grey white limbs.

items.notes: 果实的紫褐偏红，避开澱紫。

subject.zh: 耐盐的柽柳：一丛细枝的小树，约 3.5 米高，羽毛状的细枝灰绿，枝梢开着一簇簇粉红小花，树干扭曲，常长在海堤与沙滩边。
subject.en: A salt-tolerant tamarisk: a small tree of fine twigs about 3.5 m tall, its feathery branches grey green, sprays of tiny pink flowers at the tips, a twisted trunk, often growing by sea walls and beaches.

extra.zh: 第 1 格开粉花的柽柳；第 2 格不开花的灰绿柽柳；第 3 格被风压低的柽柳；第 4 格两丛相连。
extra.en: Cell 1: in pink bloom; cell 2: grey green without flowers; cell 3: pressed low by the wind; cell 4: two clumps joined.

items.notes: 羽毛状细枝用细碎的硬边点表现。

subject.zh: 海边礁石：一块被海浪冲刷的深灰礁石，高 1.5 到 3 米，下半截附着白色藤壶与暗绿海藻，水线以上干燥发白，石面有被浪掏出的孔洞。
subject.en: A shore rock: a dark grey rock scoured by waves, 1.5 to 3 m tall, its lower half crusted with white barnacles and dark green seaweed, dry and whitened above the waterline, its face pitted with holes carved by the surf.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶礁石；第 2 格尖顶礁石；第 3 格两块相叠的礁石；第 4 格礁石上停着一只海鸟（只是一个小剪影）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a dome-topped rock; cell 2: a pointed rock; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: a seabird perched on it (only a small silhouette).

items.notes: 水线用一条平直色界表示，不画水面。

subject.zh: 海滩卵石与贝壳：几块被海水磨圆的卵石，颜色有灰白、赤陶与深灰，中间夹着几只扇贝壳与一截漂流木，最高到小腿。
subject.en: Beach pebbles and shells: a few stones rounded by the sea, grey white, terracotta and dark grey, a few scallop shells and a piece of driftwood among them, the tallest shin high.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一小堆卵石；第 2 格散开的贝壳与卵石；第 3 格一截漂流木与卵石；第 4 格孩子摆成一圈的贝壳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a small heap of pebbles; cell 2: scattered shells and pebbles; cell 3: driftwood with pebbles; cell 4: shells arranged in a ring by children.

items.notes: 尺寸很小，画面略带俯视。

subject.zh: 海风里的耐盐灌丛：一丛约 1 米高的灰绿灌木，叶子肉质而小，枝条被海风吹得向一侧伸，枝间挂着一点白色的盐霜。
subject.en: A salt shrub in the sea wind: a grey green clump about 1 m tall with small fleshy leaves, its branches swept to one side by the sea wind, a little white salt rime caught among the twigs.

extra.zh: 第 1 格被风吹斜的灌丛；第 2 格圆团灌丛；第 3 格开小黄花的灌丛；第 4 格半埋在沙里的灌丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: swept sideways by wind; cell 2: a round clump; cell 3: with small yellow flowers; cell 4: half buried in sand.

items.notes: 盐霜只是几个白点。

subject.zh: 陶盆里的三角梅：一只赤陶大盆里种着一丛三角梅，枝条攀垂，开着一片洋红偏紫红的苞片花，叶子深绿，最高到腰，常摆在商馆的台阶与窗台。
subject.en: Bougainvillea in a clay pot: a large terracotta pot planted with a clump of bougainvillea, its stems trailing, covered in magenta-red bracts, dark green leaves, waist high at most, often set on merchant hall steps and windowsills.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一盆盛开的三角梅；第 2 格攀在木架上的一丛；第 3 格两只小盆；第 4 格花落了一地的盆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a pot in full bloom; cell 2: a clump climbing a wooden frame; cell 3: two small pots; cell 4: a pot with petals fallen all around.

items.notes: 苞片用红偏洋红，但不要用纯洋红 #ff00ff（那是抠图背景色），也避开澱紫。

subject.zh: 港口灯柱：一根约 3 米高的海蓝漆铁柱，柱顶挂着一只黄铜框六面灯笼，灯笼顶上是一只小铜船形风向标，柱身缠着一圈缆绳，柱脚是赤陶方座。
subject.en: A harbor lamp post: a sea-blue painted iron post about 3 m tall with a brass-framed six-sided lantern at its top, a small bronze ship-shaped weathervane above the lantern, a turn of mooring rope wound around the post, a terracotta square base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是铁柱港口灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是码头尽头的矮石灯塔灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the iron harbor lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a low stone beacon lamp at the end of a pier, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在灯笼里；黄铜用暖金褐 #c9a227。

subject.zh: 港城的蓄水池井口：一只齐腰高的圆形白石井口，石面贴着一圈赤陶与海蓝的花砖，井上架着一副铜辘轳，井边放着几只陶罐。
subject.en: A cistern wellhead of the harbor towns: a waist-high round white stone wellhead faced with a band of terracotta and sea-blue tiles, a brass windlass above it, a few clay jars beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带铜辘轳的井口；第 2 格盖着铜盖的井口；第 3 格井边排着水罐；第 4 格方形的广场水池井口。
extra.en: Cell 1: with its brass windlass; cell 2: capped with a brass lid; cell 3: with water jars lined up; cell 4: a square plaza cistern head.

items.notes: 花砖是几何纹，不写字。

subject.zh: 鱼油与葡萄酒桶：一只约 1 米高的橡木桶，铜箍，桶身用海蓝漆画着一个锚形记号，桶缝渗着一点油光，常和别的桶一起码在码头上。
subject.en: A fish-oil and wine barrel: an oak cask about 1 m tall with brass hoops, an anchor mark painted in sea blue on its side, a little oily sheen seeping at its seams, usually stacked with others on the quay.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只桶；第 2 格三只码成金字塔；第 3 格吊在吊钩上的桶；第 4 格开盖、装着咸鱼的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single barrel; cell 2: three stacked in a pyramid; cell 3: a barrel hanging from a crane hook; cell 4: open, full of salt fish.

items.notes: 锚形记号是图形。

subject.zh: 货运箱：一只约 1 米见方的结实木箱，箱板钉着铜角，侧面烙着一枚秤形商号记号，箱外罩着一张粗绳网兜，方便吊装。
subject.en: A cargo crate: a sturdy wooden box about 1 m on a side with brass corner caps, a scales-shaped merchant mark branded on its side, a coarse rope net around it for hoisting.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑绳的货箱；第 2 格两道交叉绳的货箱；第 3 格网兜吊着的两只；第 4 格撬开、露出香料袋的货箱。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal rope; cell 2: two crossed ropes; cell 3: two hoisted in a net; cell 4: pried open showing spice sacks.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；商号记号是图形。

subject.zh: 商行挂牌：一只从拱廊柱上伸出的黄铜卷花铁架，挂着一块椭圆木牌，牌上只画着纹章（秤、硬币、帆船、钥匙），牌边镶着一圈海蓝漆。
subject.en: A merchant house hanging sign: a brass scrollwork bracket reaching from an arcade column, holding an oval wooden board painted only with an emblem (scales, coins, a sailing ship, a key), its edge rimmed in sea blue.

extra.zh: 第 1 格秤纹章牌；第 2 格硬币纹章牌；第 3 格帆船纹章牌；第 4 格立在码头的指路柱（只有箭头与锚形）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a scales emblem; cell 2: a coin emblem; cell 3: a ship emblem; cell 4: a quay waypost (arrows and an anchor only).

items.notes: 只有纹章，不写字；钥匙纹不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 码头绳索栏桩：一排约 1 米高的木桩，桩顶包着铜帽，桩间垂着两道粗缆绳，木桩被海水泡得发黑，缆绳上挂着一只救生圈形的软木浮环。
subject.en: A quay rope railing: a row of wooden posts about 1 m tall with brass caps, two heavy ropes sagging between them, the wood blackened by seawater, a ring-shaped cork float hanging on the rope.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一处登船缺口的一段；第 4 格缆绳断了一道的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a boarding gap; cell 4: a section with one rope broken.

items.notes: 两端能接。

subject.zh: 商行拱廊下的货摊：一座约 3 米宽的木摊，帆布棚的边缘缀着流苏，摊台上摆着香料袋、成卷的染布、玻璃瓶与一杆铜秤，摊后挂着几串干辣椒。
subject.en: A stall under the merchant arcade: a wooden stand about 3 m wide, its canvas awning fringed with tassels, the counter laid with spice sacks, rolled dyed cloth, glass bottles and a brass steelyard, strings of dried peppers hanging behind.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红白条纹棚；第 2 格蓝白条纹棚；第 3 格绿白条纹棚；第 4 格海蓝与金的条纹棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: red and white stripes; cell 2: blue and white stripes; cell 3: green and white stripes; cell 4: sea blue and gold stripes.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；不写价签。

subject.zh: 港城的石面长椅：一条约 2 米长的白石长椅，椅面贴着一圈海蓝花砖，两端是卷涡形的石扶手，椅面到膝盖高，椅脚积着一点沙。
subject.en: A harbor town stone bench: a white stone bench about 2 m long, its seat edged with a band of sea blue tiles, scroll-shaped stone armrests at both ends, the seat at knee height, a little sand drifted at its feet.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白石花砖长椅；第 2 格木面长椅；第 3 格码头边的绳卷当凳；第 4 格椅上放着一只装鱼的篮子。
extra.en: Cell 1: the tiled white stone bench; cell 2: a wooden-seated bench; cell 3: a coil of rope used as a seat on the quay; cell 4: a fish basket left on the bench.

items.notes: 花砖是几何纹。

subject.zh: 同盟商旗：一根约 4 米高的白漆旗杆，杆顶一只铜球，挂着一面燕尾长旗，海蓝底上绣着一枚金色的秤与环绕的波浪纹，旗边缀着金穗。
subject.en: A league merchant banner: a white-painted pole about 4 m tall with a brass ball on top, hanging a swallowtail banner of sea blue embroidered with gold scales ringed by waves, gold fringe along its edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红底金秤旗；第 2 格海蓝底金秤旗；第 3 格白底蓝浪的港务旗；第 4 格被海风撕破的旧旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red banner with gold scales; cell 2: a sea blue banner with gold scales; cell 3: a white harbor banner with blue waves; cell 4: an old banner torn by sea wind.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；秤是图形。

subject.zh: 港口信标火盆：一只立在石柱顶上的铁笼火盆，约 2 米高，笼里烧着浸了鱼油的木柴，火焰旺而跳动，石柱上缠着铁箍，柱脚堆着备用的柴。
subject.en: A harbor beacon brazier: an iron cage fire on top of a stone column about 2 m tall, burning wood soaked in fish oil with a lively leaping flame, iron bands around the column, spare firewood stacked at its foot.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格石柱铁笼信标；第 2 格码头上的矮铁盆；第 3 格一对中较高的那只；第 4 格船形铁盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the stone column beacon; cell 2: a low iron bowl on the quay; cell 3: the taller of a pair; cell 4: a ship-shaped iron bowl.

items.notes: 火是暖橙；不画烟柱。

subject.zh: 商团先贤铜像：一尊约 3 米高的青铜立像，身穿长袍、一手抱着账册、一手托着一只小秤，铜面泛着绿锈，脸部只有平和的轮廓，立在白石方座上。
subject.en: A bronze statue of a merchant founder: a standing bronze figure about 3 m tall in a long robe, a ledger under one arm and a small scale held up in the other hand, green patina on the bronze, the face only a calm outline, on a white stone plinth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格抱账托秤的先贤像；第 2 格手指大海的先贤像；第 3 格坐在椅上的先贤像；第 4 格被擦得发亮的铜像（只有托秤的手发亮）。
extra.en: Cell 1: the founder with ledger and scale; cell 2: pointing out to sea; cell 3: seated in a chair; cell 4: a statue with its scale hand rubbed bright.

items.notes: 不能像任何真实人物；账册不写字。

subject.zh: 海员纪念石：一块约 1 米高的白石碑，碑顶雕着一只小锚，碑面刻着一圈波浪纹框，框里空着，碑前放着一只贝壳与一段打结的缆绳。
subject.en: A sailor's memorial stone: a white stone about 1 m tall carved with a small anchor at its top, a frame of waves cut into its face with nothing inside it, a shell and a knotted length of rope laid before it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶纪念石；第 2 格立柱加横木的木标（顶端是船桨）；第 3 格一排小纪念石；第 4 格纪念石前放着一盏灯（亮着）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped stone; cell 2: a post-and-crossbar marker (an oar for the post); cell 3: a row of small memorial stones; cell 4: a lamp lit before the stone.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；框里不写字。

subject.zh: 堆起的渔网与绳捆：一堆约 1.8 米高的灰褐渔网与成捆的缆绳，网上挂着软木浮子，堆上压着一只倒扣的鱼篓，散发着海腥味的样子。
subject.en: Heaped nets and rope coils: a pile about 1.8 m tall of grey brown fishing nets and bundled ropes, cork floats caught in the nets, an upturned fish basket weighting the top, looking as though it smells of the sea.

extra.zh: 第 1 格网堆；第 2 格缆绳捆堆；第 3 格晾在架上的网；第 4 格一只翻倒的鱼篓与散网。
extra.en: Cell 1: a heap of nets; cell 2: a heap of rope coils; cell 3: nets hung on a frame; cell 4: an overturned basket with loose net.

items.notes: 这是海港同盟包的 haystack 种类；网眼规则但不要细到糊。

subject.zh: 货运手推车：一辆约 2.5 米长的两轮木推车，车板上捆着几只货箱与一只桶，车板边缘包着铜条，车轮是厚实的实心木轮。
subject.en: A cargo handcart: a two-wheeled wooden cart about 2.5 m long, a few crates and a barrel lashed on its bed, brass strips edging the bed, thick solid wooden wheels.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装货的推车；第 2 格空推车；第 3 格装着渔获的推车；第 4 格翻倒、货物散落的推车。
extra.en: Cell 1: loaded; cell 2: empty; cell 3: carrying a catch of fish; cell 4: tipped over, cargo spilled.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头。

subject.zh: 年轻的银皮树：笔直的银白树干 #d0d8dc，约 6 米高，树皮光滑并带着淡淡的横纹，枝条向上伸展，叶子深绿 #2e5a3a 与浅绿两阶，树冠高而透，叶间透着雾白的天光。
subject.en: A young silverbark: a straight silver white trunk #d0d8dc about 6 m tall, smooth bark with faint horizontal bands, branches reaching upward, leaves in two steps of dark green #2e5a3a and pale green, a tall airy crown with mist white light showing between the leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准银皮树；第 2 格两棵并生；第 3 格树皮上挂着一条藤的银皮树；第 4 格秋天叶子转银黄。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard silverbark; cell 2: two growing together; cell 3: one with a vine hanging on its bark; cell 4: leaves turned silver yellow in autumn.

items.notes: 巨树另由建筑外观表现；这里是普通尺寸的银皮树。

subject.zh: 垂满苔帘的古树：一棵粗短虬曲的老树，约 5 米高，每根枝条都垂下长长的灰绿苔帘，像披着破旧的长袍，树干上长着白色的小菌与蕨。
subject.en: An elder tree hung with moss curtains: a short, thick, gnarled old tree about 5 m tall, long grey green curtains of moss hanging from every branch like a ragged robe, small white fungi and ferns growing on its trunk.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准苔帘古树；第 2 格苔帘更长、几乎垂地的古树；第 3 格树干中空的古树；第 4 格半边枯死的古树。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard moss-hung elder; cell 2: one with curtains nearly reaching the ground; cell 3: one with a hollow trunk; cell 4: one half dead.

items.notes: 苔帘是竖向细色带，用灰绿 #b8c8b0。

subject.zh: 挂着淡光果实的小树：一棵约 4 米高、枝条低垂的小树，树皮青灰，枝头挂着一个个拳头大的半透明圆果，果实发着很淡的暖白微光，叶片宽而薄。
subject.en: A small tree hung with softly glowing fruit: a low-boughed tree about 4 m tall, its bark blue grey, fist-sized translucent round fruit hanging from the branch tips glowing a very faint warm white, its leaves broad and thin.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满光果的树；第 2 格只挂着几颗光果；第 3 格果实未熟、不发光；第 4 格果实落了一地。
extra.en: Cell 1: laden with glowing fruit; cell 2: only a few fruit; cell 3: unripe fruit, not glowing; cell 4: fruit fallen all around.

items.notes: 光果是暖白微光，只在果实内部，不用紫色，不画光晕。

subject.zh: 被树根包住的覆苔石：一块约 2 米高的圆石被几根粗大的树根紧紧缠住，石面盖着厚厚的银绿苔，根与石之间的缝里长出小蕨。
subject.en: A mossy stone gripped by roots: a round stone about 2 m tall wrapped tightly by a few huge roots, its surface under thick silver green moss, little ferns sprouting in the gaps between root and rock.

extra.zh: 第 1 格根缠的苔石；第 2 格被根抬起、悬在半空的石；第 3 格两块被同一根缠住的石；第 4 格苔上开着发光小花的石。
extra.en: Cell 1: a root-gripped stone; cell 2: a stone lifted into the air by roots; cell 3: two stones caught by one root; cell 4: a stone with tiny glowing flowers on its moss.

items.notes: 银绿苔 #b8c8b0 与深绿根的对比。

subject.zh: 长着微光苔的小石：几块拳头到膝盖大小的圆石，石面上斑斑点点地长着一种发着雾白微光的苔，苔光淡而冷静，石缝里夹着落叶。
subject.en: Small stones with glowmoss: a few round stones from fist to knee size, patched with a moss that gives off a faint mist white light, the glow soft and calm, fallen leaves caught between them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格一圈围成的苔石；第 3 格一块平坦的踏石；第 4 格长在倒木边的苔石。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered stones; cell 2: a ring of mossy stones; cell 3: a flat stepping stone; cell 4: mossy stones beside a fallen log.

items.notes: 微光是雾白与淡青，不用紫色；不画光晕。

subject.zh: 林冠秘境的大蕨丛：一丛比人还高（约 2 米）的巨大蕨叶，羽状叶片舒展，叶背透着银光，嫩叶卷成螺旋状，叶色从深绿到浅青绿。
subject.en: Giant ferns of the canopy forest: a clump of huge fronds taller than a person (about 2 m), feathery blades unfurled with a silver sheen beneath, young fronds curled into spirals, colors from deep green to pale teal green.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一大丛巨蕨；第 2 格两小丛；第 3 格嫩叶卷曲的新蕨；第 4 格枯黄的旧蕨。
extra.en: Cell 1: one big clump; cell 2: two small clumps; cell 3: new ferns with curled fiddleheads; cell 4: old yellowed ferns.

items.notes: 比边地野林的蕨大得多。

subject.zh: 发淡光的铃形小花：一丛齐膝高的细茎小花，花朵是倒垂的小铃铛，花色雾白与淡青 #6a8aa0，铃口里透着一点很淡的冷白光，叶子细长。
subject.en: Softly glowing bell flowers: a knee-high clump of slender-stemmed flowers, each blossom a small drooping bell in mist white and pale blue #6a8aa0, a very faint cool white light inside each bell's mouth, long narrow leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一丛白铃花；第 2 格淡青铃花；第 3 格白与青混杂；第 4 格花谢、只剩小果。
extra.en: Cell 1: a clump of white bells; cell 2: pale blue bells; cell 3: white and blue mixed; cell 4: flowers gone, only small seed pods.

items.notes: 不用紫色；铃口的光只在花里。

subject.zh: 希尔瓦的银灯：一根约 3 米高、细长弯曲的银色灯柱，像一根向上弯的枝条，柱顶垂下一只叶形的银边灯罩，灯罩是半透明的薄片，柱身缠着细藤。
subject.en: A silver lamp of Silva: a slender curving silver lamp post about 3 m tall shaped like a bough bending upward, a leaf-shaped silver-rimmed shade hanging from its tip, the shade made of thin translucent leaves, a fine vine wound around the post.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是弯枝形银灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是挂在林冠桥栏上的叶形小灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the curving bough lamp, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a small leaf lantern hung on a canopy bridge rail, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 兼作林冠秘境包的 lamp 装饰（地图 D4 的提案编号）；点亮时是暖白，不用冷紫。

subject.zh: 灵泉小石盆：一只齐膝高的圆形石钵，从旁边一根空心的木管引来泉水，水从钵沿缓缓溢下，石钵上刻着一圈叶脉纹，钵底铺着白色的小卵石。
subject.en: A small spring basin: a knee-high round stone bowl fed with spring water through a hollow wooden pipe beside it, the water slowly spilling over its rim, a band of leaf-vein carving around the bowl, small white pebbles on its bottom.

extra.zh: 第 1 格引水的石钵；第 2 格没有木管的静水石钵；第 3 格两只高低相连的石钵；第 4 格钵里漂着几片落叶。
extra.en: Cell 1: the fed stone bowl; cell 2: a still bowl without a pipe; cell 3: two bowls linked at different heights; cell 4: a few fallen leaves floating in it.

items.notes: 这是林冠秘境包的 well 装饰；灵泉取水处另有采集点条目。

subject.zh: 树皮箍的木桶：一只约 0.8 米高的银白木桶，用剥下的韧树皮条代替铁箍，桶盖是一块圆木片，桶身刻着简单的叶纹。
subject.en: A bark-hooped barrel: a silver white wooden cask about 0.8 m tall bound with strips of tough stripped bark instead of iron hoops, a round slab of wood for its lid, simple leaf patterns carved on its side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只木桶；第 2 格两只并排；第 3 格开盖、盛着泉水；第 4 格横放在树根上的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single barrel; cell 2: two side by side; cell 3: open, holding spring water; cell 4: lying on a root.

items.notes: 精灵不用铁。

subject.zh: 藤编箱：一只约 0.8 米见方的藤条编箱，编纹细密，四角用硬木条加固，箱盖用藤环扣住，箱面编出一枚叶形纹。
subject.en: A wicker chest: a box about 0.8 m square woven of cane in a fine weave, its corners stiffened with hardwood strips, its lid fastened with cane loops, a leaf motif woven into its face.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑藤带的箱；第 2 格两道交叉藤带的箱；第 3 格叠起的两只；第 4 格开盖、装着银苔与草药。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal cane strap; cell 2: two crossed cane straps; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: open, holding silver moss and herbs.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1。

subject.zh: 守护者路牌：一块约 1.6 米高的扁平灰白立石，石面刻着一条细长的叶脉纹，叶脉的主脉朝一个方向延伸，像一支箭，石脚长着一圈银苔与小蕨。
subject.en: A warden's guide stone: a flat grey white standing stone about 1.6 m tall carved with a long slender leaf vein whose midrib runs off in one direction like an arrow, a ring of silver moss and little ferns at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单向指路石；第 2 格岔口的双叶脉指路石；第 3 格被苔盖住一半的旧指路石；第 4 格石上叶脉纹亮着淡淡的白光（只在刻纹里）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a one-way guide stone; cell 2: a two-vein stone at a fork; cell 3: an old stone half covered in moss; cell 4: its vein carving glowing faint white (only in the grooves).

items.notes: 兼作林冠秘境包的 sign 装饰（地图 D4、E4 的提案编号）；只有叶脉图形，不写字。

subject.zh: 编枝矮栅：一段约 1 米高、2 米宽的柳枝编成的矮栅，竖桩之间横着编进细枝，编纹紧密，桩头长出几片新叶，像是活的。
subject.en: A woven-branch fence: a section about 1 m tall and 2 m wide of willow wattle, fine branches woven between upright stakes in a tight pattern, a few new leaves sprouting from the stake tops as if alive.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一扇小编门的一段；第 4 格缠着开花的藤的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a small woven gate; cell 4: a section wound with a flowering vine.

items.notes: 根下庭小田栅也用它；两端能接。

subject.zh: 精灵的叶棚交易台：几根带枝的细木杆撑起一片用大叶片叠成的小棚，约 2.5 米宽，台面是一段剖开的圆木，上面摆着银苔、灵泉瓶、木雕与成卷的林蚕丝。
subject.en: An elven leaf-roofed trading table: a few branching slender poles holding a small canopy of overlapping large leaves, about 2.5 m wide, a split log for the counter laid with silver moss, spring water vials, wood carvings and rolls of forestsilk.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红叶棚；第 2 格蓝灰叶棚；第 3 格绿叶棚；第 4 格雾白纱棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red leaf canopy; cell 2: a blue grey leaf canopy; cell 3: a green leaf canopy; cell 4: a mist white gauze canopy.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿（用叶色表现）；不写价签。

subject.zh: 树根长凳：一根从地里拱出、又自然弯成座面的粗树根，约 2 米长，座面被磨得光滑，两端埋进土里，旁边长着一丛小蕨。
subject.en: A root bench: a thick root arching up out of the ground and naturally bending into a seat about 2 m long, its top polished smooth, both ends sinking back into the soil, a small clump of ferns beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一根拱起的根凳；第 2 格两根并排的根凳；第 3 格带着树皮靠背的根凳；第 4 格长着苔的旧根凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single arching root seat; cell 2: two side by side; cell 3: a root seat with a bark backrest; cell 4: an old root seat covered in moss.

items.notes: 座面到膝盖。

subject.zh: 叶纹布幡：一根约 3.5 米高的弯枝杆，挂着一条雾白薄纱长幡，幡面用银线绣着一片大叶与环绕的根纹，幡尾剪成叶尖形，薄纱在空气里轻轻起伏。
subject.en: A leaf-pattern hanging: a curved branch pole about 3.5 m tall hung with a long mist white gauze pennant embroidered in silver thread with a great leaf ringed by roots, its tail cut into a leaf tip, the gauze stirring gently.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红纱幡；第 2 格蓝纱幡；第 3 格雾白银线幡；第 4 格深绿氏族幡。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red gauze pennant; cell 2: a blue gauze pennant; cell 3: mist white with silver thread; cell 4: a deep green clan pennant.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；纹样是图形。

subject.zh: 微光苔钵：一只齐腰高的石钵立在一截树桩上，钵里堆着一团会发光的苔，苔光是冷白偏青的柔光，像一小团被收起来的月光，钵沿刻着叶纹。
subject.en: A glowmoss bowl: a waist-high stone bowl set on a stump, heaped with a mound of luminous moss giving a soft cool white light tinged with blue, like a little gathered moonlight, leaf carving around the rim.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格树桩上的苔钵；第 2 格挂在藤上的苔篮；第 3 格一对中较矮的那只；第 4 格地上的一圈苔石。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the bowl on a stump; cell 2: a moss basket hung from a vine; cell 3: the shorter of a pair; cell 4: a ring of moss stones on the ground.

items.notes: 林冠秘境不点火：这里的"燃烧"是苔光，用冷白与淡青 3 阶硬边色块，不画火舌，不用紫色。

subject.zh: 树灵木雕：一段约 3 米高、仍在生长的活树干被雕成一个修长的人形，双臂化作向上伸展的枝条，枝头长着叶子，脸部只是树皮的纹理，脚下根须扎进土里。
subject.en: A tree-spirit carving: a living tree trunk about 3 m tall, still growing, carved into a slender figure whose arms become branches reaching upward with leaves at their tips, its face only bark grain, roots at its feet sinking into the soil.

extra.zh: 第 1 格双臂上举的树灵；第 2 格双手合抱一颗光果的树灵；第 3 格弯腰的树灵；第 4 格一半已长回树形的旧雕。
extra.en: Cell 1: arms raised; cell 2: cradling a glowing fruit; cell 3: bending low; cell 4: an old carving half grown back into a tree.

items.notes: 没有五官；活树的叶子与本包的树一致。

subject.zh: 树葬标：一棵刚种下的小树苗，苗旁插着一块刻着叶纹的木牌，木牌边缘系着一条银线，树苗周围用白石子围成一圈。
subject.en: A tree-burial marker: a newly planted sapling with a small wooden plaque carved with a leaf stuck beside it, a silver thread tied around the plaque's edge, a ring of white pebbles around the sapling.

extra.zh: 第 1 格小树苗与木牌；第 2 格立柱加横木的木标、上面绕着藤；第 3 格长成小树的旧葬标；第 4 格一排三株。
extra.en: Cell 1: a sapling and plaque; cell 2: a post-and-crossbar marker wound with vine; cell 3: an old marker grown into a young tree; cell 4: a row of three.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；木牌不写字。

subject.zh: 干叶捆：一堆用藤条捆起的干落叶与干苔，约 1.5 米高，颜色是银褐与灰绿，捆成圆锥形，精灵用它铺床与垫兽舍。
subject.en: Bundles of dry leaves: a pile about 1.5 m tall of dry fallen leaves and dried moss tied with vine, silver brown and grey green, bound into a cone, used by the elves for bedding and for lining animal shelters.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆锥叶捆；第 2 格几捆靠在一起；第 3 格散开的叶堆；第 4 格盖着一张大叶的叶捆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a conical bundle; cell 2: several bundles leaning together; cell 3: a loose heap of leaves; cell 4: a bundle covered with one huge leaf.

items.notes: 这是林冠秘境包的 haystack 种类。

subject.zh: 藤编小车：一辆约 2 米长的轻巧小车，车斗是藤编的，两只车轮是整块的圆木片，车把是一根弯曲的枝条，车里放着几只藤筐。
subject.en: A wicker cart: a light cart about 2 m long with a woven cane bed, two wheels cut from single round slabs of wood, a curved branch for its handle, a few cane baskets inside.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空车；第 2 格装着藤筐的车；第 3 格装着落枝的车；第 4 格翻倒的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: empty; cell 2: carrying baskets; cell 3: carrying fallen branches; cell 4: tipped over.

items.notes: 没有铁件。

subject.zh: 被风吹斜的孤榆：草原上一棵独立的榆树，约 4.5 米高，树干与树冠一起被常年的风压向一侧，枝条在下风处拖得很长，叶团是暗绿与草黄两阶，树脚有一圈被马踩秃的土。
subject.en: A wind-bent lone elm: a solitary elm on the steppe about 4.5 m tall, trunk and crown together pressed to one side by the constant wind, its branches trailing long on the lee side, leaf clusters in two steps of dark green and grass yellow, a ring of earth trampled bare by horses at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格倒向右侧的孤榆；第 2 格倒向左侧、更矮的孤榆；第 3 格树枝上系满彩色布条的孤榆；第 4 格冬天光秃、枝条全偏一侧。
extra.en: Cell 1: leaning to the right; cell 2: leaning left, shorter; cell 3: its boughs tied with many colored cloth strips; cell 4: bare in winter, every branch swept one way.

items.notes: 风向一致是辨识点；布条只是色块，不写字。

subject.zh: 季河岸的柳：一棵矮壮的柳树，约 4 米高，主干短粗分出几根粗枝，枝条半垂，叶片细长灰绿，树根一半露在河岸外，雨季时根部泡在水里。
subject.en: A willow on the seasonal river bank: a short sturdy willow about 4 m tall, a stubby main trunk splitting into a few heavy limbs, half-drooping twigs, long narrow grey green leaves, half its roots exposed on the bank and soaked in the rainy season.

extra.zh: 第 1 格夏天的河柳；第 2 格截过头、又冒出一圈新枝的河柳；第 3 格根部泡在水线下（水线用深色带）；第 4 格旱季叶子发黄的河柳。
extra.en: Cell 1: in summer; cell 2: pollarded and sprouting a crown of new shoots; cell 3: roots below the waterline (a dark band); cell 4: yellowing in the dry season.

items.notes: 比瓦伦的垂柳更矮更粗、垂得少。

subject.zh: 平顶的刺树：一棵约 3.5 米高的草原刺树，几根细而硬的树干向上分开，顶上是一片平平展开的伞状树冠，枝上长满长刺，叶子细小，树下常有牲口在躲太阳。
subject.en: A flat-topped thorn tree: a steppe thorn about 3.5 m tall, a few slender hard trunks forking upward under a flat umbrella crown spread wide, long thorns all along the branches, tiny leaves, livestock often sheltering from the sun beneath it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准平顶刺树；第 2 格更宽更矮的刺树；第 3 格树上挂着一只鸟巢；第 4 格旱季叶子掉光、只剩刺枝。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard flat-topped thorn; cell 2: a wider, lower one; cell 3: with a bird's nest in it; cell 4: leafless in the dry season, thorny branches only.

items.notes: 不画牲口；平顶是辨识点。

subject.zh: 小号的风牙岩：一块约 3 米高、像獠牙一样尖尖向上的灰岩，岩面被风削出一道道竖向沟槽，颜色灰 #6a6460 带草黄的苔斑，岩脚围着一圈长草。
subject.en: A small windfang rock: a grey rock about 3 m tall thrusting upward to a point like a fang, its surface cut by the wind into vertical grooves, grey #6a6460 with grass yellow lichen patches, a ring of long grass around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单根獠牙岩；第 2 格两根并立的獠牙岩；第 3 格弯向一侧的獠牙岩；第 4 格矮胖、顶端断掉的獠牙岩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single fang rock; cell 2: two fangs standing together; cell 3: one curving to one side; cell 4: a short stout one with its tip broken off.

items.notes: 大风牙岩是地标与远景，这里是散布在草原上的小号。

subject.zh: 草原散石：几块半埋在草里的灰褐石头，最高到膝盖，石面有风蚀的小坑，石缝里夹着枯草与一根白色鸟羽。
subject.en: Scattered steppe stones: a few grey brown stones half sunk in the grass, the tallest knee high, small wind-pitted hollows on their faces, dry grass and a white bird feather caught between them.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格一块平卧的大石；第 3 格牧人垒起的小石堆；第 4 格一圈石头围成的旧火塘。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered stones; cell 2: one large flat-lying stone; cell 3: a small cairn stacked by herders; cell 4: a ring of stones from an old hearth.

items.notes: 尺寸小。

subject.zh: 针茅与风滚草：一丛齐腰高的针茅，细长的银黄色芒穗在风里倒向一侧；或一团圆滚滚的枯黄风滚草，枝条交织成球，被风推着滚动。
subject.en: Feather grass and tumbleweed: a waist-high clump of feather grass whose long silver yellow plumes all lean one way in the wind; or a round dry tumbleweed of interwoven twigs, pushed rolling by the wind.

extra.zh: 第 1 格倒向一侧的针茅；第 2 格更矮的针茅丛；第 3 格一团风滚草；第 4 格两团卡在一起的风滚草。
extra.en: Cell 1: feather grass leaning to one side; cell 2: a shorter clump; cell 3: a single tumbleweed; cell 4: two tumbleweeds caught together.

items.notes: 倒伏方向与孤榆一致。

subject.zh: 草原野花：一丛齐膝高的草原野花，有金黄的小菊、紫红的穗状花与白色的小星花，花茎细长，花朵是几像素的色点，夹着几根草黄的长叶。
subject.en: Steppe wildflowers: a knee-high clump of steppe flowers, small golden daisies, magenta-red spikes and little white star flowers on slender stems, the blossoms dots of a few pixels among a few long grass-yellow blades.

extra.zh: 第 1 格以金黄小菊为主；第 2 格以紫红穗花为主；第 3 格以白星花为主；第 4 格三色混杂的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly golden daisies; cell 2: mostly magenta-red spikes; cell 3: mostly white stars; cell 4: all three mixed.

items.notes: 紫红偏红，避开暗紫 #4a3a62。

subject.zh: 草原的角灯：一根约 2.5 米高的木杆，顶端用皮绳绑着一只兽角磨薄做成的灯罩，灯罩是半透明的蜜黄色，杆上挂着一串骨珠，杆脚插在一堆石头里。
subject.en: A steppe horn lamp: a wooden pole about 2.5 m tall with a lamp shade made of a thinly ground beast horn lashed to its top with thongs, the shade a translucent honey yellow, a string of bone beads hanging on the pole, its foot set in a pile of stones.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是木杆角灯的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是挂在毡帐门口的小角灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the horn lamp on its pole, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a small horn lamp hung at a yurt door, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在角灯罩里发暖黄光。

subject.zh: 草原井：一个用原木框围起的方井口，约到膝盖高，旁边立着一根高木桩，桩上架着一根长长的提水杆，杆一头吊着皮水袋，另一头绑着一块配重石。
subject.en: A steppe well: a square wellhead framed with logs at about knee height, beside it a tall wooden post supporting a long sweep pole, a leather water bag hanging from one end and a counterweight stone bound to the other.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带长杆的草原井；第 2 格只有原木井框；第 3 格井边有一条长木水槽；第 4 格旱季井口盖着石板。
extra.en: Cell 1: the well with its sweep pole; cell 2: only the log wellhead; cell 3: with a long wooden watering trough beside it; cell 4: capped with a stone slab in the dry season.

items.notes: 长杆的倾斜是辨识点。

subject.zh: 奶桶与皮囊：一只约 0.9 米高的窄口木奶桶，桶身用铁丝与皮条箍着，旁边挂着一只鼓鼓的皮囊，皮囊口用木塞塞住，桶上搭着一块毡布。
subject.en: A milk churn and skin bag: a narrow-mouthed wooden churn about 0.9 m tall bound with wire and leather straps, a bulging leather skin hanging beside it stoppered with a wooden plug, a felt cloth draped over the churn.

extra.zh: 第 1 格木奶桶；第 2 格鼓鼓的皮囊；第 3 格奶桶与皮囊并排；第 4 格倒在地上的空皮囊。
extra.en: Cell 1: a wooden churn; cell 2: a bulging skin bag; cell 3: churn and skin side by side; cell 4: an empty skin bag lying on the ground.

items.notes: 这是风牙草原包的 barrel 种类。

subject.zh: 彩绘木柜：一只约 0.9 米长的矮木柜，柜面漆成红底，用白、黄、蓝画着几何花纹与马的剪影，四角包着铜片，柜盖上压着一卷毡毯。
subject.en: A painted wooden chest: a low wooden chest about 0.9 m long, its face painted red with geometric patterns and horse silhouettes in white, yellow and blue, brass plates at its corners, a rolled felt rug weighted on its lid.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑皮带的彩柜；第 2 格两道交叉皮带的彩柜；第 3 格两只叠起；第 4 格开盖、装着毡衣与银饰。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal strap; cell 2: two crossed straps; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: open, holding felt clothes and silver ornaments.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；花纹是几何图形。

subject.zh: 草原路标：一个约 1.6 米高的石堆，顶上插着一根木杆，杆上系着几条随风飘的彩布条，石堆一侧摆着一只朝向道路的兽头骨，作为指路的记号。
subject.en: A steppe waymarker: a cairn about 1.6 m tall with a wooden pole stuck in its top, a few colored cloth strips tied to the pole fluttering in the wind, a beast skull set on one side of the cairn facing the road as a sign of the way.

extra.zh: 第 1 格石堆加布条杆；第 2 格只有一根系布杆插在地上；第 3 格两个石堆夹道；第 4 格倒塌的石堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cairn with a ribboned pole; cell 2: only a ribboned pole stuck in the ground; cell 3: two cairns flanking the way; cell 4: a collapsed cairn.

items.notes: 没有字，靠形状与朝向指路。

subject.zh: 马圈木栏：一段约 1.4 米高、2 米宽的木栏，几根歪斜的木桩之间横绑着两三根长木杆，绑结用的是生皮条，木头被马啃得坑坑洼洼。
subject.en: A horse corral fence: a section about 1.4 m tall and 2 m wide, two or three long poles lashed across a few crooked stakes with rawhide, the wood gnawed pitted by horses.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一处拉杆门的一段；第 4 格一根横杆掉了的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a slip-rail gate; cell 4: a section with one rail fallen.

items.notes: 两端能接。

subject.zh: 毡毯交易摊：地上铺着一块大红毡毯，毯上摆着皮货、奶疙瘩、骨饰与一把马刀，旁边立着两根木杆撑起的一片毡篷，约 2.5 米宽，篷边挂着彩色流苏。
subject.en: A felt rug trading stall: a large red felt rug spread on the ground laid with hides, dried curd, bone ornaments and a saber, a felt awning on two wooden poles beside it, about 2.5 m wide, colored tassels along the awning's edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红毡篷；第 2 格蓝毡篷；第 3 格绿毡篷；第 4 格只有毡毯、没有篷。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red felt awning; cell 2: a blue felt awning; cell 3: a green felt awning; cell 4: only the rug, no awning.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿。

subject.zh: 原木座与毡垫：一段横放的粗原木，约 2 米长，上面铺着一块红褐毡垫，毡垫上绣着简单的角纹，原木一端放着一只木碗。
subject.en: A log seat and felt cushion: a thick log laid on its side about 2 m long with a red brown felt pad spread on it, the pad stitched with a simple horn pattern, a wooden bowl at one end of the log.

extra.zh: 第 1 格原木与毡垫；第 2 格几只叠起的毡垫（坐垫堆）；第 3 格两段原木对放；第 4 格只有原木、毡垫收起。
extra.en: Cell 1: log and felt pad; cell 2: a stack of felt cushions; cell 3: two logs set facing; cell 4: the log alone, the pad put away.

items.notes: 座面到膝盖。

subject.zh: 部族马尾旗：一根约 4 米高的长木杆，杆顶是一枚铁矛尖，矛尖下扎着一大束垂下的马尾毛，再往下挂着一面窄长的毡旗，毡旗上缝着部族的兽形纹。
subject.en: A clan horsetail standard: a long wooden pole about 4 m tall topped by an iron spearhead, a great bundle of horsetail hair bound beneath the point and hanging down, below it a narrow felt pennant stitched with the clan's beast emblem.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红毡旗、黑马尾；第 2 格蓝毡旗、白马尾；第 3 格黄毡旗、褐马尾；第 4 格只有马尾、没有毡旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: red felt, black horsetail; cell 2: blue felt, white horsetail; cell 3: yellow felt, brown horsetail; cell 4: horsetail only, no pennant.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；兽形纹是剪影。

subject.zh: 草原篝火：一堆用干牛粪饼与枯木搭起的篝火，外面围着一圈石头，约 1 米高，火焰被风吹得斜向一侧，旁边架着一只铁三脚架吊着铜壶。
subject.en: A steppe campfire: a fire built of dried dung cakes and dead wood ringed with stones, about 1 m tall, the flames leaning to one side in the wind, an iron tripod beside it hanging a copper kettle.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格石圈篝火；第 2 格吊着铜壶的篝火；第 3 格营地的大篝火；第 4 格毡帐前的小火。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: a stone-ringed fire; cell 2: a fire with a hanging kettle; cell 3: a large camp bonfire; cell 4: a small fire before a yurt.

items.notes: 火焰斜向与草原风向一致；这是风牙草原包的 brazier 种类。

subject.zh: 石刻祖灵人像：一块约 2 米高的灰石柱，正面粗粗雕出一个人形，双手捧在腹前，脸部只是两道眉弓与一道嘴线，石柱顶上压着一只兽头骨，柱脚摆着奶碗。
subject.en: A carved ancestor stone figure: a grey stone pillar about 2 m tall with a human form roughly carved on its front, hands held at the belly, the face only two brow ridges and a line for a mouth, a beast skull set on the pillar's top, bowls of milk at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格捧手的祖灵人像；第 2 格持弓的祖灵人像；第 3 格一对并立的人像；第 4 格倒在草里的旧人像。
extra.en: Cell 1: hands at the belly; cell 2: holding a bow; cell 3: a pair standing together; cell 4: an old figure fallen in the grass.

items.notes: 造型粗犷，不要像任何真实民族的文物；不写字。

subject.zh: 草原土丘墓：一个约 1.2 米高的圆形土丘，上面长着长草，丘前立着一块扁平的石标，石标顶上压着一只马头骨，丘边插着一根系着马尾的木杆。
subject.en: A steppe barrow grave: a round earth mound about 1.2 m tall grown over with long grass, a flat stone marker standing before it with a horse skull on its top, a wooden pole tied with a horsetail stuck at its side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格前立圆顶石标的土丘；第 2 格立柱加横木的木标（横木上挂马尾）；第 3 格一圈石头围着的土丘；第 4 格新堆的土丘。
extra.en: Cell 1: a mound with a round-topped stone; cell 2: a post-and-crossbar marker hung with a horsetail; cell 3: a mound ringed with stones; cell 4: a freshly heaped mound.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；祖灵冢是另一处地图，这里是普通的墓。

subject.zh: 马草垛：一个约 2 米高的长圆形干草垛，草色草黄偏灰，垛顶用几根木杆与绳网压住防风，垛脚围着一圈矮木栏挡牲口。
subject.en: A fodder stack: a long rounded haystack about 2 m tall, the hay grass yellow with a grey cast, a few poles and a rope net weighting its top against the wind, a low wooden rail around its foot to keep livestock off.

extra.zh: 第 1 格压着绳网的草垛；第 2 格没有围栏的草垛；第 3 格被风吹散一角的草垛；第 4 格一排小草捆。
extra.en: Cell 1: netted down; cell 2: without its rail; cell 3: with a corner torn away by wind; cell 4: a row of small bundles.

items.notes: 这是风牙草原包的 haystack 种类。

subject.zh: 毡篷车：一辆约 3 米长的两轮高车，车轮又大又高，车上用弓形木架撑起一片厚毡篷，毡篷是灰白与红色相拼，篷门挂着一块绣花毡帘，车辕上搭着一副马鞍。
subject.en: A felt-covered cart: a tall two-wheeled cart about 3 m long with very large high wheels, a thick felt cover over bent wooden hoops, the felt pieced in grey white and red, an embroidered felt curtain at its door, a saddle laid over the shaft.

extra.zh: 第 1 格毡篷车；第 2 格篷卷起、装着家当；第 3 格空车架；第 4 格一只轮子坏了、斜着的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: the covered cart; cell 2: cover rolled up, loaded with belongings; cell 3: an empty frame; cell 4: tilted with a broken wheel.

items.notes: 不画牲口。

subject.zh: 夜境的黑松：一棵约 5.5 米高的松树，针叶墨绿得几乎发黑，树干深灰带暗红的裂纹，枝层平而稀，像一层层摊开的黑手掌，树脚落着黑色的松针。
subject.en: A black pine of the Nightrealm: a pine about 5.5 m tall, its needles so deep green they are nearly black, its trunk dark grey with dark red cracks, its tiers of boughs flat and sparse like spread black palms, black needles fallen at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准黑松；第 2 格更高更瘦的黑松；第 3 格被火山灰覆盖、枝头发灰的黑松；第 4 格断顶的老黑松。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard black pine; cell 2: a taller leaner one; cell 3: its tips greyed by volcanic ash; cell 4: an old pine with a broken top.

items.notes: 暗红裂纹只是很细的线，不发光。

subject.zh: 冻原矮桦：一棵只有约 2.5 米高的矮桦树，几根灰白的细干从同一根部斜着长出，枝条扭曲贴地，叶子小而稀，秋天转为暗红，树下长着一层苔。
subject.en: A tundra dwarf birch: a birch only about 2.5 m tall, a few slender grey white stems leaning out from one root, twisted boughs hugging the ground, small sparse leaves that turn dark red in autumn, a layer of moss beneath it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格夏天的矮桦；第 2 格秋天暗红叶的矮桦；第 3 格被雪压弯的矮桦；第 4 格一丛三株的矮桦。
extra.en: Cell 1: in summer; cell 2: with dark red autumn leaves; cell 3: bowed under snow; cell 4: a cluster of three.

items.notes: 比边地野林的白桦矮小得多。

subject.zh: 透着余烬的枯树：一棵约 4 米高的焦黑枯树，树干的裂缝里透出暗红 #8a2a22 到橙红 #ff7a3a 的余烬光，像体内还在慢慢燃烧，枝头断口发白，树下积着火山灰。
subject.en: A dead tree with embers inside: a charred dead tree about 4 m tall, dark red #8a2a22 to orange red #ff7a3a ember light showing through the cracks in its trunk as if still slowly burning within, its broken branch tips pale, volcanic ash heaped beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格裂缝透红的枯树；第 2 格余烬更旺、裂缝更宽；第 3 格余烬熄灭、只剩焦黑；第 4 格断成两截、断面发红。
extra.en: Cell 1: cracks glowing red; cell 2: the embers brighter, the cracks wider; cell 3: the embers gone, only charred black; cell 4: broken in two, the break glowing.

items.notes: 余烬光只在裂缝里，不画光晕；不用紫色。

subject.zh: 玄武岩柱块：几根约 1.5 到 3 米高的六角形黑色玄武岩柱挤在一起，柱顶平整，柱面黑灰 #2e2a2c 带细密的横纹，缝里积着火山灰与一点苔。
subject.en: A basalt column cluster: a few hexagonal black basalt columns about 1.5 to 3 m tall crowded together, flat-topped, their faces black grey #2e2a2c with fine horizontal lines, volcanic ash and a little moss in the joints.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三根并立的岩柱；第 2 格一根高柱；第 3 格倒伏碎裂的岩柱；第 4 格阶梯状排列的岩柱。
extra.en: Cell 1: three columns together; cell 2: a single tall column; cell 3: fallen and broken columns; cell 4: columns arranged like steps.

items.notes: 六角形截面是辨识点，略带俯视看得见柱顶。

subject.zh: 黑曜石碎块：几块边缘锋利的黑曜石，大的到膝盖，表面像黑玻璃一样光亮，断口有贝壳状的弧纹，反射着一点暗红的光。
subject.en: Obsidian shards: a few sharp-edged pieces of obsidian, the largest knee high, glossy as black glass, conchoidal ripples on their broken faces, catching a little dark red light.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散落的黑曜石；第 2 格一块大黑曜石；第 3 格一堆碎片；第 4 格嵌在玄武岩里的黑曜石。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered shards; cell 2: one large piece; cell 3: a heap of fragments; cell 4: obsidian set in basalt.

items.notes: 高光只用一两像素。

subject.zh: 暗色石南丛：一丛齐膝高的低矮灌木，细小的针叶是墨绿与暗褐，枝梢开着细碎的暗红小花，长在黑岩缝与火山灰地里。
subject.en: Dark heather: a knee-high low shrub, its tiny needle leaves ink green and dark brown, minute dark red flowers at the twig tips, growing in black rock cracks and volcanic ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格开暗红花的石南；第 2 格不开花的石南；第 3 格两丛相连；第 4 格覆着薄雪的石南。
extra.en: Cell 1: flowering dark red; cell 2: without flowers; cell 3: two clumps joined; cell 4: under a thin snow.

items.notes: 暗红偏红，不要做成紫。

subject.zh: 夜里开的苍白小花：一丛细茎小花，花瓣苍白 #d8d0c8 带一点青白 #c8e8e4，只在长夜里张开，花心是浅金色，叶片窄而暗。
subject.en: Pale night-blooming flowers: a clump of slender-stemmed small flowers, their petals pale #d8d0c8 tinged with blue white #c8e8e4, opening only in the long night, pale gold hearts, narrow dark leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛开的一丛；第 2 格半开；第 3 格合拢的花苞（白天）；第 4 格长在温泉边的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: in full bloom; cell 2: half open; cell 3: closed buds (by day); cell 4: a clump beside a hot spring.

items.notes: 苍白而不发光。

subject.zh: 黑铁灯柱挂暗红灯笼：一根约 3 米高的黑铁柱，柱顶弯出一只铁钩，钩上挂着一只圆鼓鼓的暗红纱灯笼，灯笼上下是黑铁箍，柱身铸着一圈角形纹。
subject.en: A black iron post with a dark red lantern: a black iron post about 3 m tall curving into a hook at its top, a round dark red gauze lantern hanging from the hook with black iron rims at top and bottom, a band of horn shapes cast around the post.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是铁钩挂红灯笼的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是立在石座上的方形暗红灯笼的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the hooked post with its red lantern, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a square dark red lantern on a stone base, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在灯笼里，暗红偏暖 #b33a2a 到 #ff7a3a。

subject.zh: 温泉井：一口齐腰高的黑石圆井，井口不断冒出白色的热汽，井沿结着一圈青白 #8ac8c4 的矿物结晶，井上架着一副黑铁辘轳，挂着一只铜桶。
subject.en: A hot spring well: a waist-high round well of black stone, white steam rising continually from its mouth, a ring of blue white #8ac8c4 mineral crust around its rim, a black iron windlass above it holding a copper bucket.

extra.zh: 第 1 格冒汽的温泉井；第 2 格盖着石盖的井；第 3 格井边有一只引水木槽；第 4 格冬天井沿结着冰与汽。
extra.en: Cell 1: steaming; cell 2: capped with a stone lid; cell 3: with a wooden channel leading water away; cell 4: ice and steam on its rim in winter.

items.notes: 热汽只画两三缕硬边白汽。

subject.zh: 浴屋木桶：一只约 1 米高、口宽的深色木桶，用黑铁箍着，桶里盛着冒热汽的青白温泉水，桶边搭着一块白布，旁边放着一只木瓢。
subject.en: A bathhouse tub: a dark wooden tub about 1 m tall and wide-mouthed, bound with black iron hoops, holding steaming blue white spring water, a white cloth over its rim, a wooden dipper beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛着热水的木桶；第 2 格空桶；第 3 格两只并排；第 4 格盖着木盖的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of hot water; cell 2: empty; cell 3: two side by side; cell 4: covered with a wooden lid.

items.notes: 黯冠城的浴屋木桶。

subject.zh: 黑铁包角木箱：一只约 0.8 米见方的深色木箱，四角与边缘包着黑铁片，铁片上铆着小角形铆钉，箱面烙着一枚弯角纹，箱盖用铁扣扣住。
subject.en: A black-iron-cornered crate: a dark wooden box about 0.8 m square, its corners and edges sheathed in black iron riveted with small horn-shaped studs, a curved horn mark branded on its face, its lid fastened with an iron clasp.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑铁带的箱；第 2 格两道交叉铁带的箱；第 3 格叠起的两只；第 4 格开盖、装着黑市的货。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal iron band; cell 2: two crossed bands; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: open, holding black market goods.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1。

subject.zh: 角形路牌：一根约 1.8 米高的黑木柱，柱顶装着一对弯曲的铁角，角下钉着一块暗红木板，板上刻着一个箭头与一个简单的图形（塔、泉、山）。
subject.en: A horned signpost: a black wooden post about 1.8 m tall topped by a pair of curved iron horns, a dark red board nailed beneath them carved with an arrow and a simple figure (a tower, a spring, a mountain).

extra.zh: 第 1 格塔形指向牌；第 2 格泉形指向牌；第 3 格岔口的双牌；第 4 格倒下的旧牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a tower sign; cell 2: a spring sign; cell 3: a double sign at a fork; cell 4: an old fallen sign.

items.notes: 只有图形，不写字。

subject.zh: 黑铁栏杆一段：约 1.4 米高、2 米宽的黑铁栏杆，竖条顶端是向外弯的小角尖，中间有一道铸着骨形纹的横带，两端是黑石方柱。
subject.en: A black iron railing section: about 1.4 m tall and 2 m wide, its bars ending in small outward-curving horn points, a horizontal band cast with bone shapes across the middle, black stone square piers at both ends.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格带一扇小铁门的一段；第 4 格一根竖条断掉的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: a section with a small iron gate; cell 4: a section with one broken bar.

items.notes: 两端能接。

subject.zh: 黑市摊：一座约 2.5 米宽的低矮木摊，暗红布棚压得很低，台上摆着黑色瓶罐、成串的兽牙、几块黑曜石与一盏小红灯，台下垂着黑布遮挡。
subject.en: A black market stall: a low wooden stand about 2.5 m wide under a dark red awning pulled low, its counter laid with black bottles and jars, strings of beast teeth, a few obsidian pieces and a small red lamp, black cloth hanging beneath to hide what is there.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红棚；第 2 格蓝黑棚；第 3 格暗绿棚；第 4 格只有黑布、没有棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: a red awning; cell 2: a blue black awning; cell 3: a dark green awning; cell 4: only black cloth, no awning.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿；瓶子不贴标签。

subject.zh: 黑石长凳：一条约 2 米长的整块黑玄武岩长凳，凳面磨光，两端雕成向上弯的角形，凳面到膝盖高，凳上铺着一块暗红垫子。
subject.en: A black stone bench: a single block of black basalt about 2 m long, its seat polished, both ends carved into upward-curving horns, the seat at knee height, a dark red cushion laid on it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格铺着红垫的石凳；第 2 格无垫的石凳；第 3 格温泉边的长石凳；第 4 格断成两截的旧凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: with a red cushion; cell 2: bare; cell 3: a long bench by a hot spring; cell 4: an old bench broken in two.

items.notes: 座面到膝盖。

subject.zh: 深红角纹旗：一根约 4 米高的黑铁旗杆，杆顶是一对铁角，挂着一面深红长旗，旗面中央是一个黑色的弯角纹，旗尾剪成两道尖，旗边镶着黑色流苏。
subject.en: A crimson horn banner: a black iron pole about 4 m tall topped by a pair of iron horns, hanging a long deep red banner with a black curved horn emblem at its center, its tail cut into two points, black fringe along its edges.

extra.zh: 第 1 格深红角纹旗；第 2 格深蓝底角纹旗；第 3 格黑底红角的王室旗；第 4 格残破的旧旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: the crimson horn banner; cell 2: a deep blue banner with the horn; cell 3: a black royal banner with a red horn; cell 4: an old tattered banner.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；角纹是图形。

subject.zh: 熔岩火盆：一只黑铁三足大盆，约 1.2 米高，盆里不是柴火，而是一块块烧得暗红发亮的熔岩石，石缝里跳着小小的橙红火舌，盆沿铸着角形纹。
subject.en: A lava brazier: a large three-legged black iron bowl about 1.2 m tall, holding not firewood but lumps of lava stone glowing dark red, little orange red tongues of flame leaping in the cracks, horn shapes cast on its rim.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格三足熔岩盆；第 2 格方形石槽里的熔岩火；第 3 格城墙上的大熔岩盆；第 4 格挂在铁链下的熔岩吊盆。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the three-legged lava bowl; cell 2: lava fire in a square stone trough; cell 3: a great lava bowl on the walls; cell 4: a hanging lava bowl on chains.

items.notes: 熔岩用暗红到橙红 3 到 4 阶硬边色块。

subject.zh: 有角的人形石像：一尊约 3.5 米高的黑石立像，头上长着一对向后弯的大角，背后半展着一对蝠翼，双手按在一柄倒插的长剑上，脸部只雕出眉骨与下颌的轮廓。
subject.en: A horned stone figure: a black stone statue about 3.5 m tall with a pair of great backswept horns on its head, a pair of bat-like wings half spread behind it, both hands resting on a longsword planted point down, the face carved only as the outline of brow and jaw.

extra.zh: 第 1 格持剑的有角像；第 2 格展翼的有角像；第 3 格跪姿的有角像；第 4 格一只角断落的旧像。
extra.en: Cell 1: with the sword; cell 2: wings spread; cell 3: kneeling; cell 4: an old statue with one horn broken.

items.notes: 不能像任何真实人物；脸部无细节。

subject.zh: 黑石墓：一块约 1 米高的黑玄武岩墓碑，碑顶雕成一对弯角，碑面打磨光亮，只刻着一圈骨形边框，碑前一盏小红灯与一碗温泉水。
subject.en: A black stone grave: a black basalt headstone about 1 m tall carved into a pair of curved horns at its top, its face polished, cut only with a border of bone shapes, a small red lamp and a bowl of spring water before it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶黑石碑；第 2 格立柱加横木的黑铁墓标；第 3 格碑前红灯亮着；第 4 格一排三座。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round-topped black headstone; cell 2: a black iron post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: the red lamp lit before it; cell 4: a row of three.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；不写字。

subject.zh: 干苔垛：一堆约 1.6 米高、从冻原上割下晒干的灰褐长苔，用黑绳捆成圆垛，夜境的牲口吃它，人也用它铺床，垛顶压着一块黑石。
subject.en: A dried moss stack: a pile about 1.6 m tall of long grey brown moss cut from the tundra and dried, bound into a round stack with black cord, eaten by the Nightrealm's livestock and used by people for bedding, a black stone weighting its top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆垛；第 2 格几捆靠在一起；第 3 格被雪覆盖的垛；第 4 格散开的苔堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a round stack; cell 2: a few bundles leaning together; cell 3: a stack under snow; cell 4: a loose heap.

items.notes: 这是黑岩夜境包的 haystack 种类。

subject.zh: 铁箍车：一辆约 3 米长的四轮黑木车，车身用黑铁带箍得结结实实，车轮包着铁圈，车上装着黑石块或木桶，车辕前端雕成一个角形。
subject.en: An iron-bound cart: a four-wheeled black wooden cart about 3 m long, its body strapped solid with black iron bands, iron-tired wheels, loaded with black stone blocks or barrels, the front of its shaft carved into a horn.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装着黑石的车；第 2 格装着木桶的车；第 3 格空车；第 4 格缺一只轮的车。
extra.en: Cell 1: loaded with black stone; cell 2: loaded with barrels; cell 3: empty; cell 4: missing a wheel.

items.notes: 不画牲口。

subject.zh: 积雪的松树：一棵约 5.5 米高的塔形松树，每层枝条上都压着厚厚的白雪 #f6fafc，雪下露出深绿的针叶，树干深褐，树脚的雪被压出一圈凹。
subject.en: A snow-laden pine: a conical pine about 5.5 m tall, every tier of its boughs bowed under thick white snow #f6fafc, dark green needles showing beneath the snow, a dark brown trunk, a hollow pressed into the snow at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格雪压满枝的松；第 2 格雪少一些、露出更多绿；第 3 格两棵并立；第 4 格断了一根大枝、雪落在地上。
extra.en: Cell 1: laden with snow; cell 2: less snow, more green showing; cell 3: two together; cell 4: with a great bough snapped, its snow fallen.

items.notes: 雪用冷白分 3 阶，暗面带冰蓝 #a8c8e4。

subject.zh: 崖边的云海松：一棵约 4 米高、被山风塑成平展枝条的松树，树干扭曲斜伸出崖外，枝条一层层水平展开像托着云，针叶簇是一团团深绿，树根紧紧抓着岩缝。
subject.en: A cloud pine on the cliff edge: a pine about 4 m tall shaped by mountain wind into flat outspread boughs, its trunk twisting out over the drop, its branches spreading in level tiers as if holding up the clouds, its needle tufts dark green clumps, its roots gripping the rock cracks.

extra.zh: 第 1 格伸向右侧的云海松；第 2 格伸向左侧的云海松；第 3 格枝上积雪的云海松；第 4 格枯了一半的老松。
extra.en: Cell 1: reaching right; cell 2: reaching left; cell 3: with snow on its boughs; cell 4: an old pine half dead.

items.notes: 平展的枝层是辨识点；根部贴格底。

subject.zh: 挂霜的枯树：一棵约 4 米高的枯死老树，枝条光秃，每根枝上都结着厚厚的白霜与细小的冰凌，整棵树像是用冰雕成的，树皮是灰 #8a9aa8。
subject.en: A frost-hung dead tree: a dead old tree about 4 m tall, its branches bare, each twig coated in thick white rime and tiny icicles, the whole tree looking carved from ice, its bark grey #8a9aa8.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满霜的枯树；第 2 格霜少、露出灰皮；第 3 格倒伏在雪里的枯树；第 4 格只剩一截挂冰的树桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: heavy with rime; cell 2: less rime, grey bark showing; cell 3: fallen in the snow; cell 4: only an ice-hung stump left.

items.notes: 霜用冷白，冰凌一两像素。

subject.zh: 顶上积雪的岩石：一块约 1.5 到 3 米高的深灰岩石，顶面盖着一层厚雪，侧面露出冰蓝的冰壳与灰色的岩面，岩脚被风吹出一道雪檐。
subject.en: A snow-capped rock: a dark grey rock about 1.5 to 3 m tall with a thick layer of snow on its top, ice blue crusts and grey rock showing on its sides, a snow cornice blown against its foot by the wind.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆顶雪石；第 2 格尖顶雪石；第 3 格两块相依的雪石；第 4 格雪化了一半的岩石。
extra.en: Cell 1: a dome-topped snowy rock; cell 2: a pointed one; cell 3: two leaning together; cell 4: half thawed.

items.notes: 冰蓝只在冰壳，岩面仍是灰。

subject.zh: 碎岩坡的石块：几块棱角锋利的灰色碎岩，最大的到膝盖，表面结着薄冰，缝里积着雪，是从山坡上滚下来的碎石。
subject.en: Scree stones: a few sharp-edged grey rocks, the largest knee high, thin ice on their surfaces and snow packed in the gaps, rubble rolled down from the slopes.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三块散石；第 2 格一小堆碎岩；第 3 格一块冻在冰里的石；第 4 格围成一圈的石头（旧营地）。
extra.en: Cell 1: three scattered rocks; cell 2: a small heap of scree; cell 3: a rock frozen into ice; cell 4: a ring of stones (an old camp).

items.notes: 尺寸小。

subject.zh: 半埋雪中的矮灌：一丛约 0.8 米高的高山灌木，大半截埋在雪里，只露出深绿的叶簇与几根灰褐的枝梢，枝上挂着红色的小浆果。
subject.en: A shrub half buried in snow: an alpine shrub about 0.8 m tall, most of it buried in snow, only dark green leaf tufts and a few grey brown twig tips showing, small red berries on the twigs.

extra.zh: 第 1 格露出叶簇的矮灌；第 2 格只露出几根枝梢；第 3 格夏天无雪的矮灌；第 4 格结满红果的一丛。
extra.en: Cell 1: leaf tufts showing; cell 2: only a few twig tips showing; cell 3: snowless in summer; cell 4: heavy with red berries.

items.notes: 红果是小点。

subject.zh: 高山草甸小花：一丛贴地的小花，有白色的星形花与淡黄的杯形花，花茎短，叶片银绿带绒毛，开在雪线以下的草甸上。
subject.en: Alpine meadow flowers: a low clump of small flowers, white star-shaped and pale yellow cup-shaped, short stems, silver green woolly leaves, blooming on the meadows below the snow line.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白星花为主；第 2 格淡黄杯花为主；第 3 格两色混杂；第 4 格刚从雪里冒出的花苞。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly white stars; cell 2: mostly pale yellow cups; cell 3: both mixed; cell 4: buds just pushing up through the snow.

items.notes: 颜色清淡，与雪莲采集点区分。

subject.zh: 方石灯笼：一座约 2 米高的灰石灯笼，下面是方石柱，中间是开着四面方窗的灯室，顶上是一块四角微翘的石盖，石盖上积着雪。
subject.en: A square stone lantern: a grey stone lantern about 2 m tall, a square stone shaft below, a lamp chamber with square windows on four sides in the middle, a stone cap with slightly upturned corners on top carrying snow.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是方柱石灯笼的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是驿站门口的矮石灯的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the square column lantern, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a low stone lamp at a waystation door, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在灯室窗里有暖光；不写字。

subject.zh: 冰井：一口齐腰高的圆形石井，井口结着一层厚冰，冰上凿开一个小洞，洞边放着一把冰镐与一只木桶，井沿挂着冰凌。
subject.en: An ice well: a waist-high round stone well whose mouth is sealed by a thick sheet of ice, a small hole chopped through it, an ice pick and a wooden bucket beside the hole, icicles hanging from the rim.

extra.zh: 第 1 格凿开小洞的冰井；第 2 格整个冻住的冰井；第 3 格夏天化冻、能打水的井；第 4 格井上搭着小木棚的井。
extra.en: Cell 1: with a hole chopped; cell 2: frozen solid; cell 3: thawed in summer, water to be drawn; cell 4: with a small wooden shelter over it.

items.notes: 井口略带俯视。

subject.zh: 挂霜木桶：一只约 0.9 米高的木桶，桶身结着一层白霜，铁箍上挂着细小冰凌，桶盖上积着一小堆雪，驿站门口常摆着几只。
subject.en: A frosted barrel: a wooden cask about 0.9 m tall coated in white frost, tiny icicles hanging from its iron hoops, a little heap of snow on its lid, often a few standing at waystation doors.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单只挂霜桶；第 2 格两只并排；第 3 格开盖、装着雪水；第 4 格半埋在雪里的桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single frosted barrel; cell 2: two side by side; cell 3: open, holding snowmelt; cell 4: half buried in snow.

items.notes: 霜在木色之上，不要把桶画成全白。

subject.zh: 驿站木箱：一只约 0.8 米见方的厚木箱，箱面被冻得发灰，角上包着铁皮，箱盖上压着一卷毛毡与一根登山绳，箱面烙着一枚山形记号。
subject.en: A waystation crate: a thick wooden box about 0.8 m square, its face greyed by frost, iron-sheathed corners, a roll of felt and a climbing rope on its lid, a mountain mark branded on its face.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一道斜绑绳的箱；第 2 格两道交叉绳的箱；第 3 格叠起的两只；第 4 格开盖、装着干肉与毛皮。
extra.en: Cell 1: one diagonal rope; cell 2: two crossed ropes; cell 3: two stacked; cell 4: open, holding dried meat and furs.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1。

subject.zh: 石堆路标：一个约 1.8 米高的碎石堆，石块层层垒起，顶上立着一根木杆，杆上系着一块被风撕成条的布，石堆朝路的一面嵌着一块刻着箭头的扁石。
subject.en: A cairn waymark: a stack of broken stones about 1.8 m tall built up layer by layer, a wooden pole standing on top with a cloth tied to it shredded into strips by the wind, a flat stone carved with an arrow set into the side facing the path.

extra.zh: 第 1 格带布杆的石堆；第 2 格没有杆的石堆；第 3 格被雪埋了一半的石堆；第 4 格倒塌的石堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: with its cloth pole; cell 2: without a pole; cell 3: half buried in snow; cell 4: collapsed.

items.notes: 只有箭头图形。

subject.zh: 防雪木栅：一段约 1.5 米高、2 米宽的木板栅，木板之间留着缝，用来挡住风吹来的雪，栅脚积起一道雪堆，木板上结着白霜。
subject.en: A snow fence: a section of slatted wooden fence about 1.5 m tall and 2 m wide, gaps left between the boards to break wind-driven snow, a drift built up along its foot, white frost on the slats.

extra.zh: 第 1 格直线一段；第 2 格转角一段；第 3 格被雪埋了一半的一段；第 4 格倒了的一段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a straight section; cell 2: a corner section; cell 3: half buried in snow; cell 4: a fallen section.

items.notes: 两端能接。

subject.zh: 山间行商的木棚摊：一座约 2.5 米宽的小木棚，棚顶是积雪的木板斜顶，摊台上摆着毛皮、干肉、冰镐与几只装热汤的陶罐，棚边挂着一串铃铛。
subject.en: A mountain trader's shed stall: a small wooden shed about 2.5 m wide with a snow-laden sloping plank roof, its counter laid with furs, dried meat, ice picks and a few clay pots of hot soup, a string of bells hanging at its side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红布门帘的棚；第 2 格蓝布门帘的棚；第 3 格绿布门帘的棚；第 4 格关着、木板挡住的棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: with a red cloth curtain; cell 2: a blue cloth curtain; cell 3: a green cloth curtain; cell 4: closed, boarded up.

items.notes: 第 1 到 3 格以门帘色对应变体 0 红、1 蓝、2 绿。

subject.zh: 石凳：一块约 1.6 米长的平整灰石架在两块方石上，凳面积着一层薄雪，凳上铺着一张毛皮，凳面到膝盖高。
subject.en: A stone bench: a flat grey slab about 1.6 m long set on two square stones, a thin layer of snow on its seat, a fur spread on it, the seat at knee height.

extra.zh: 第 1 格铺着毛皮的石凳；第 2 格积雪的石凳；第 3 格驿站门口的木凳；第 4 格一截倒木当凳。
extra.en: Cell 1: with a fur on it; cell 2: snow-covered; cell 3: a wooden bench at a waystation door; cell 4: a fallen log used as a seat.

items.notes: 座面到膝盖。

subject.zh: 挂满布条的长杆幡：一根约 4 米高的木杆，从上到下挂满了一条条白、蓝、黄的窄布条，布条被风吹得向同一个方向飘，杆顶插着一枚龙鳞形的铁片。
subject.en: A tall pole hung with cloth strips: a wooden pole about 4 m tall hung from top to bottom with narrow strips of white, blue and yellow cloth all streaming the same way in the wind, a dragon-scale-shaped iron plate fixed at its tip.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红黄布条为主；第 2 格蓝白布条为主；第 3 格全白布条；第 4 格被风撕得只剩几条。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly red and yellow strips; cell 2: mostly blue and white; cell 3: all white; cell 4: torn by wind to only a few strips.

items.notes: 第 1 格红、第 2 格蓝对应变体 0、1；单杆，与两杆之间拉绳的风绳不同。

subject.zh: 石砌火塘：一圈齐膝高的灰石矮墙围成的方形火塘，塘里烧着松木与干牛粪，火焰被风压低，塘边架着一只铁吊锅，石头上结着一圈融雪的水痕。
subject.en: A stone fire pit: a square pit walled by a knee-high ring of grey stones, burning pine and dried dung, the flames pressed low by the wind, an iron pot hanging beside it, a ring of meltwater marks on the stones.

extra.zh: 四格都在燃烧（一直点着），火焰用 3 到 4 阶暖色硬边色块：第 1 格方形石火塘；第 2 格挂着吊锅的火塘；第 3 格会盟用的大火盆；第 4 格驿站里的小火塘。
extra.en: All four cells are burning (always lit), flames in 3 to 4 hard-edged warm color steps. Cell 1: the square stone pit; cell 2: with a hanging pot; cell 3: a great brazier for the conclave; cell 4: a small hearth in a waystation.

items.notes: 七席石会盟用 7 盆；火是暖色。

subject.zh: 龙形石像：一尊约 3.5 米高的灰石龙像，盘着长尾坐在一块岩石上，双翼收在身侧，长颈微微低垂，龙鳞雕得粗犷，眼睛是两个浅浅的凹坑，身上积着雪。
subject.en: A dragon statue: a grey stone dragon about 3.5 m tall sitting coiled on a rock with its long tail curled around, wings folded at its sides, its long neck slightly bowed, scales carved roughly, its eyes two shallow hollows, snow resting on its body.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盘坐的龙像；第 2 格昂首的龙像；第 3 格被冰封住一半的龙像；第 4 格断了一只翼的旧像。
extra.en: Cell 1: seated and coiled; cell 2: head raised; cell 3: half sealed in ice; cell 4: an old statue missing a wing.

items.notes: 原创龙形，不要像任何知名作品里的龙；不写字。

subject.zh: 雪中石堆墓：一个约 1 米高的灰石堆，顶上插着一根冰镐，石堆上压着一顶旧毛帽，周围的雪被风吹成波纹，石缝里结着冰。
subject.en: A cairn grave in the snow: a grey stone heap about 1 m tall with an ice pick planted on top, an old fur hat weighted on the stones, the snow around it rippled by the wind, ice in the gaps.

extra.zh: 第 1 格前立圆顶扁石的石堆墓；第 2 格立柱加横木的木标（顶上挂霜）；第 3 格插着冰镐的石堆墓；第 4 格被雪埋得只露出顶的墓。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cairn with a round-topped flat stone; cell 2: a frosted post-and-crossbar marker; cell 3: a cairn with an ice pick; cell 4: buried in snow but for its top.

items.notes: 第 1、2 格对应变体 0、1；不写字。

subject.zh: 牲口草料垛：一堆约 1.8 米高的干草与干苔捆在木架上，架顶盖着一张油布防雪，草色灰黄，架脚围着几块挡风的石头。
subject.en: A fodder stack: hay and dried moss bundled about 1.8 m high on a wooden rack, an oilcloth over its top against the snow, the hay greyish yellow, a few windbreak stones around the rack's foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盖着油布的草垛；第 2 格积着雪的草垛；第 3 格几捆散放的草；第 4 格被扒开一半的草垛。
extra.en: Cell 1: covered with oilcloth; cell 2: under snow; cell 3: a few loose bundles; cell 4: half pulled apart.

items.notes: 这是眠鳞雪岭包的 haystack 种类。

subject.zh: 货橇：一辆约 2.5 米长、带滑板的木货橇，滑板前端高高翘起，橇上捆着货包与毛皮，橇头拴着一根拉绳，木头上结着白霜。
subject.en: A cargo sledge: a wooden sledge about 2.5 m long on runners curling high at the front, bundles and furs lashed on top, a pull rope tied at its head, white frost on the wood.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装货的货橇；第 2 格空橇；第 3 格翻倒在雪里的货橇；第 4 格装着木柴的货橇。
extra.en: Cell 1: loaded; cell 2: empty; cell 3: overturned in the snow; cell 4: carrying firewood.

items.notes: 与桦村的木雪橇区分：更大、装货。

subject.zh: 边石镇广场中央的边石：一块半人高（约 0.9 米）的灰色立石，粗糙、上窄下宽，顶部被千百只手摸得圆滑发亮，侧面嵌着几点白色石英，根部围着一圈小卵石。
subject.en: The edgestone in the middle of the Edgestone square: a waist-high (about 0.9 m) grey standing stone, rough, narrower at the top, the crown worn smooth and glossy by countless hands, a few white quartz flecks on the side, a ring of pebbles around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日的边石；第 2 格系着几条彩色祈福布条的边石；第 3 格顶上积着雪的边石；第 4 格石脚放着一盏小油灯与野花的边石（油灯亮着）。
extra.en: Cell 1: the edgestone on an ordinary day; cell 2: the edgestone tied with a few colored ribbons of good wishes; cell 3: the edgestone capped with snow; cell 4: the edgestone with a small oil lamp and wildflowers at its foot (the lamp lit).

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类立石（standing_stone）；它很矮，别画成纪念碑；石面不刻字。

subject.zh: 东坡兽人的熏肉棚：原木搭成的敞棚，约 3.5 米宽、3 米高，草皮与树皮盖的斜顶，棚下横杆挂满深红褐的肉条与整条鱼，地上一圈石砌火塘冒着细烟，旁边堆着劈好的柴。
subject.en: The orc smoke shed on the east slope: an open shed of logs about 3.5 m wide and 3 m tall, a sloped roof of turf and bark, crossbars underneath hung with dark red brown strips of meat and whole fish, a stone fire ring on the ground giving off thin smoke, split firewood stacked beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满肉条、火塘冒烟的熏棚；第 2 格肉条已收走、只剩空杆与余烬的熏棚；第 3 格挂着鱼与兽皮的熏棚；第 4 格一侧棚顶塌下、经过修补的熏棚。
extra.en: Cell 1: the shed full of meat strips with the fire ring smoking; cell 2: the shed emptied, bare poles and embers only; cell 3: the shed hung with fish and hides; cell 4: the shed with one side of the roof collapsed and patched.

items.notes: 烟只画两三缕细的硬边灰烟，不画大团烟雾；兽人的木作粗大，绑结用皮绳。

subject.zh: 边石广场的审判台：约 3.5 米宽的粗木平台，离地齐胸高，正面有五级木阶，台后立着一根带铁环的木柱，台边围着低木栏，木板颜色深浅不一，像是临时钉起来的。
subject.en: The judgement stage in the Edgestone square: a rough wooden platform about 3.5 m wide, chest high off the ground, five wooden steps on the front, a wooden post with an iron ring standing at the back, a low wooden rail around the edge, planks of mismatched shades as if nailed up in haste.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日空着的审判台；第 2 格台上堆着柴捆、柱上缠着绳的审判台；第 3 格围上布幔、摆着一张木桌与长椅的公审台；第 4 格被拆掉一半、木板堆在一旁的审判台。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stage standing empty on an ordinary day; cell 2: the stage with bundles of firewood heaped on it and rope wound on the post; cell 3: the hearing stage draped with cloth, a wooden table and bench on it; cell 4: the stage half dismantled, planks piled beside it.

items.notes: 不画任何人；第 2 格的柴捆只是堆着，不点火；台面略带俯视，看得见平台上表面。

subject.zh: 梅尔卡的小神龛：齐胸高的灰石龛座，上面一个带双坡小顶的木龛，龛里供着一枚浮雕的大硬币纹，龛前横着一只黄铜投币匣，匣顶有一道窄投币口，匣身被摸得发亮。
subject.en: A small shrine of Merca: a chest-high grey stone pedestal topped by a wooden niche with a little gabled roof, a large relief coin emblem enshrined inside, a brass offering box set before it with a narrow coin slot on top, the box rubbed bright.

extra.zh: 第 1 格干净的新神龛；第 2 格龛前摆着几枚硬币与一小束麦穗；第 3 格木顶褪色、投币匣有凹痕的旧神龛；第 4 格挂着一串小铜铃的神龛。
extra.en: Cell 1: a clean new shrine; cell 2: a shrine with a few coins and a small sheaf of wheat laid before it; cell 3: an old shrine with a faded roof and a dented coin box; cell 4: a shrine hung with a string of small brass bells.

items.notes: 硬币纹是梅尔卡的徽记，只画圆形与内圈纹，不刻数字与字；黄铜不要用门扉金。

subject.zh: 墓园西南小坡上一座孩子的新坟：一小堆新翻的深褐泥土，比成人坟矮小，前面插着一块刚削好的浅色小木墓标，土堆上放着几朵野花和一只木雕小鸟。
subject.en: A child's new grave on the little southwest slope of the graveyard: a small heap of freshly turned dark brown soil, smaller and lower than an adult's, a newly whittled pale wooden marker planted before it, a few wildflowers and a small carved wooden bird resting on the mound.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚下葬时的新坟，泥土湿润；第 2 格几天后，土堆上多了野花与小石子；第 3 格夜里的新坟，墓标旁点着一小截蜡烛（亮着）；第 4 格一个月后，土上冒出短草。
extra.en: Cell 1: the grave just after burial, the soil damp; cell 2: a few days later, more wildflowers and pebbles on the mound; cell 3: the grave at night with a stub of candle burning beside the marker; cell 4: a month later, short grass sprouting on the soil.

items.notes: 不写名字，墓标空白；不画坟上的灰色"鬼火"（那是特效另出）。

subject.zh: 旧哨村的枯井：灰石砌的井圈塌了小半边，井口黑洞洞看不到水，上面歪着一根断掉的木辘轳架，绳早已烂掉，井圈缝里长满干草与荆棘，石面有烟熏的黑痕。
subject.en: The dry well of Oldwatch: a grey stone wellhead with a small part of the rim collapsed, the mouth a black hole with no water to be seen, a broken wooden windlass frame leaning over it, the rope long rotted away, dry grass and brambles in the joints, soot marks on the stones.

extra.zh: 第 1 格废村时期的枯井，井架倒在一旁；第 2 格井口盖着几块木板的枯井；第 3 格村子重建后清理过、围了一圈木栏的枯井；第 4 格井口重新搭起新木架、挂着新绳桶的井。
extra.en: Cell 1: the dry well of the ruined village, its frame fallen aside; cell 2: the dry well covered with a few planks; cell 3: the dry well cleaned up after the village is rebuilt, a wooden rail around it; cell 4: the well with a new wooden frame and a new rope and bucket.

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类枯井（dry_well）；第 1 到 4 格按旧哨村从废墟到重建的顺序排。

subject.zh: 旧哨村被砸毁的村祠：齐胸高的灰石龛座，上面的小石龛被砸裂，龛顶的三角石掉在地上，龛里本来供奉的小像只剩底座，石面有斧凿的白痕与烟熏黑斑。
subject.en: The smashed village shrine of Oldwatch: a chest-high grey stone pedestal whose little stone niche has been cracked open, the triangular capstone fallen to the ground, the small figure once enshrined reduced to its base, white axe and chisel scars and soot stains on the stone.

extra.zh: 第 1 格被砸毁的村祠，碎石散落；第 2 格碎石被拾起堆在一旁的村祠；第 3 格龛前有人放了一束野花的残祠；第 4 格用木板临时搭了小顶遮雨的残祠。
extra.en: Cell 1: the smashed shrine with rubble scattered; cell 2: the shrine with its broken pieces gathered into a pile beside it; cell 3: the ruined shrine with a bunch of wildflowers someone left before it; cell 4: the ruined shrine with a makeshift plank roof against the rain.

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类砸毁的神龛（shrine_ruin）；与 art_prop_wayside_shrine 是同一种石龛，这里是砸毁的版本；不画任何女神的完整徽记。

subject.zh: 旧哨村村中心的火堆：一圈大块灰石围成的火塘，直径约 1.5 米，塘里架着粗柴，火塘边散着几截原木当座位，石头被烟熏得发黑。
subject.en: The fire at the center of Oldwatch: a fire pit ringed by large grey stones about 1.5 m across, heavy logs laid in it, a few log sections scattered around as seats, the stones blackened by smoke.

extra.zh: 第 1 格匪帮的火：乱堆的柴烧得很旺，旁边扔着一只空酒罐；第 2 格难民的火：小而节省的火，架着一口吊锅；第 3 格村子的火：整齐的石圈与铁架，火势稳定，旁边是一摞柴；第 4 格熄灭的火坑：只剩灰与一缕细烟。
extra.en: Cell 1: the bandits' fire: a careless heap of logs burning hard, an empty jug tossed beside it; cell 2: the refugees' fire: a small frugal fire with a hanging pot; cell 3: the village fire: a neat stone ring and iron frame, a steady flame, a stack of firewood beside it; cell 4: the cold pit: only ash and a thin wisp of smoke.

items.notes: 前三格对应地图的三态（匪火、难民火、村火），由剧情切换变体；火焰用暖色硬边色块。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡北门外的阵亡碑：一块约 2.5 米高的灰白石碑立在三级石台上，碑身上窄下宽，正面密密刻着一列列短刻线（看不出是字），顶部刻着一圈交叉的长枪纹，石台缝里长着青苔。
subject.en: The war memorial outside the north gate of Valenburg: a grey white stele about 2.5 m tall on three stone steps, tapering upward, its face densely carved with columns of short incised lines that do not read as writing, a ring of crossed spear motifs carved at the top, moss in the joints of the steps.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日的阵亡碑；第 2 格碑前摆着花环与几支残蜡烛；第 3 格碑身有一道裂缝、经过修补的阵亡碑；第 4 格覆着薄雪的阵亡碑。
extra.en: Cell 1: the memorial on an ordinary day; cell 2: the memorial with a wreath and a few burnt-down candles before it; cell 3: the memorial with a crack in the stele that has been repaired; cell 4: the memorial under a thin layer of snow.

items.notes: 属于立石变体；碑面只是成列的刻线，不写任何字与数字。

subject.zh: 静钟墓园的钟架：两根粗黑木柱架着一根横梁，梁下吊着一口约 1 米高的青铜钟，钟身发暗带绿锈，钟舌用布包着，木柱上刻着简单的家族纹章（盾形），整体约 4 米高。
subject.en: The bell frame of the Silent Bell graveyard: two thick dark wooden posts carrying a crossbeam, under which hangs a bronze bell about 1 m tall, dull with green patina, its clapper wrapped in cloth, a simple shield-shaped family crest carved on the posts, about 4 m tall overall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格静止的钟；第 2 格钟舌包布被解开、钟微微倾斜（正在敲响）；第 3 格钟架顶上加了小木顶的样子；第 4 格挂着黑色丧布的钟架。
extra.en: Cell 1: the bell hanging still; cell 2: the clapper unwrapped and the bell tilting slightly (being rung); cell 3: the frame with a small wooden roof added on top; cell 4: the frame draped with black mourning cloth.

items.notes: 钟是青铜绿锈色，不要用门扉金；纹章只用盾形图案，不写字。

subject.zh: 红沙场的练兵木桩：一根约 1.8 米高的粗木桩，上部缠着几圈旧麻绳，桩身布满刀剑砍出的白色切口，顶上套着一只破旧的皮盔，桩脚埋在红褐色沙土堆里。
subject.en: A training post of the Red Sand Field: a thick wooden post about 1.8 m tall, its upper part wrapped in several turns of old rope, its body covered in pale cuts from swords and axes, a battered leather helmet set on top, its foot buried in a mound of reddish brown sand.

extra.zh: 第 1 格标准木桩；第 2 格桩上横绑一根木臂、像人张开手臂的桩；第 3 格桩上挂着一面破木盾；第 4 格被砍得只剩半截的旧桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a standard post; cell 2: a post with a wooden crossarm lashed on like outstretched arms; cell 3: a post hung with a broken wooden shield; cell 4: an old post hacked down to half its height.

items.notes: 桩脚的红沙只画一小堆，不画大片地面；切口用浅木色短线。

subject.zh: 鹿角林里的出水暗渠口：一段半埋在土坡里的灰石拱口，约 2 米宽，拱口装着锈蚀的铁栅，栅后一片漆黑，口下流出一道暗绿发浊的细水，石面长满青苔与蕨。
subject.en: A drain outlet in the Antler Wood: a grey stone arch mouth about 2 m wide half buried in an earth bank, fitted with a rusted iron grate, pitch black behind the bars, a thin murky dark green trickle running out beneath, the stones overgrown with moss and ferns.

extra.zh: 第 1 格铁栅完好的暗渠口；第 2 格铁栅被撬弯、能钻过一人的暗渠口；第 3 格被枝叶半掩的暗渠口；第 4 格水流变大、带着灰沫的暗渠口。
extra.en: Cell 1: the outlet with an intact grate; cell 2: the outlet with the grate pried apart wide enough for a person; cell 3: the outlet half hidden by branches and leaves; cell 4: the outlet with a stronger flow carrying grey foam.

items.notes: 水是浑浊的暗绿灰色，不要用澱紫；拱口是正面立牌，后面的土坡只画一点轮廓。

subject.zh: 门前渡南岸半没在水中的古拱门：一座约 6 米宽、7 米高的冷灰石拱，下半截没在河水里，拱石上刻着磨损的门形浮雕，拱顶的拱心石缺了一角，石面挂着水草与苔，水线以下颜色更深。
subject.en: The ancient arch half sunk in the water on the south bank of Gatefront Ferry: a cold grey stone arch about 6 m wide and 7 m tall, its lower half under the river, worn door-shaped reliefs carved on the voussoirs, a corner missing from the keystone, waterweed and moss hanging from the stones, darker below the waterline.

extra.zh: 只画拱门本身与水线以上的部分，水线处用一条平直的深色带表示，水面由渲染层另画；拱洞内留暗，不画门后的景物。
extra.en: Draw only the arch itself and the part above the waterline, marking the waterline with a straight dark band; the water surface is drawn by the renderer; keep the opening dark and draw nothing behind it.

items.notes: 门形浮雕是磨损的浅刻，不用门扉金；不画水面与倒影。

subject.zh: 渔网架：两根约 2.5 米高的木杆之间架着横杆，挂着几张灰褐色的渔网，网上系着木浮子与石坠，网眼用规则的细格表示，杆脚堆着一只鱼篓。
subject.en: A fishing net rack: a crossbar between two wooden poles about 2.5 m tall, hung with a few grey brown nets, wooden floats and stone sinkers tied on, the mesh shown as a regular fine grid, a fish basket at the foot of a pole.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂着两张网的网架；第 2 格挂满网、正在晾晒的网架；第 3 格网上缠着水草、有破洞待补的网架；第 4 格收了网、只剩空杆与一卷绳的网架。
extra.en: Cell 1: the rack with two nets; cell 2: the rack fully hung with nets drying; cell 3: the rack with waterweed caught in the nets and holes waiting to be mended; cell 4: the rack with the nets taken in, only bare poles and a coil of rope.

items.notes: 网眼要规则但不要细到缩小后糊成一片，大约每格 2 到 3 像素；门前渡、苇桥村、苇塘村共用。

subject.zh: 岸边的小船：一条约 3 米长的平底木舢板，船身浅灰褐，船头微翘，船里放着一支木桨与一捆芦苇，船尾系着麻绳，木板接缝处抹着深色的沥青。
