subject.en: A small boat at the bank: a flat-bottomed wooden skiff about 3 m long, pale grey brown hull, slightly raised bow, an oar and a bundle of reeds lying inside, hemp rope tied at the stern, the plank seams smeared with dark pitch.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空的木舢板；第 2 格装着鱼篓与渔网的舢板；第 3 格芦苇扎成的小筏；第 4 格翻扣在岸上晾干的舢板。
extra.en: Cell 1: an empty skiff; cell 2: a skiff loaded with fish baskets and nets; cell 3: a small raft bound from reeds; cell 4: a skiff turned upside down to dry on the bank.

items.notes: 船侧面朝镜头、船头朝画面右侧；不画水面，船底贴格底。

subject.zh: 苇桥村的三拱石桥：灰褐石块砌成，桥面两侧有齐腰高的石栏，桥头是一座方石墩，墩顶立着一根铁灯柱，拱圈用整齐的楔形石，石缝里长着草，桥身有水渍的深色带。
subject.en: The three-arched stone bridge of Reedbridge: built of grey brown stone blocks, waist-high stone parapets on both sides of the deck, a square stone pier at the bridgehead topped by an iron lamp post, arches of neat wedge stones, grass growing in the joints, dark water stains along the body.

extra.zh: 只画一端：左侧的桥头石墩加第一个拱与半个第二拱，桥身向画面右侧截断，截面平直，方便与相邻的桥面拼接。
extra.en: Draw one end only: the bridgehead pier on the left plus the first arch and half of the second, the span cut off straight toward the right so it can join the adjoining deck.

items.notes: 灯柱的灯是熄灭的样子（夜里由渲染层加光）；不画河水。

subject.zh: 路边小祠：齐胸高的灰石龛座，上面一个带三角石顶的小石龛，龛里供着一尊小小的袍像（只表现袍纹与光轮），龛前一只石碗，碗里有水与几朵花，龛顶长着一点苔。
subject.en: A wayside shrine: a chest-high grey stone pedestal topped by a small stone niche with a triangular capstone, a tiny robed figure enshrined inside (only robe folds and a halo wheel), a stone bowl before it holding water and a few flowers, a little moss on the capstone.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完好的小祠；第 2 格龛前点着一盏小油灯的小祠（亮着）；第 3 格挂着麦穗与布条的小祠；第 4 格石顶歪斜、龛里空了的旧祠。
extra.en: Cell 1: the intact shrine; cell 2: the shrine with a small oil lamp lit before it; cell 3: the shrine hung with wheat ears and ribbons; cell 4: an old shrine with a crooked capstone and an empty niche.

items.notes: 与 art_prop_smashed_shrine 是同一种石龛（shrine_ruin 的完好变体）；袍像不画五官。

subject.zh: 客栈旁的换马栏：原木横栏围成的一小片马栏，约 4 米宽，栏边有一只长木马槽、一根拴马桩与挂在栏上的鞍具，栏角堆着干草，木栏被马啃出缺口。
subject.en: The horse-change pen beside the inn: a small paddock fenced with log rails about 4 m wide, a long wooden trough, a hitching post and tack hung on the rail, hay heaped in a corner, notches gnawed into the rails by horses.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空马栏；第 2 格马槽里有草料、栏上搭着两副鞍的马栏；第 3 格加了一段小草顶棚的马栏；第 4 格一段栏杆倒下、待修的马栏。
extra.en: Cell 1: an empty pen; cell 2: the pen with fodder in the trough and two saddles over the rail; cell 3: the pen with a small thatched shelter added; cell 4: the pen with one rail section fallen and awaiting repair.

items.notes: 不画马（马是生灵立牌）；栏杆高到胸口。

subject.zh: 曙光圣柱：一根约 2.5 米长、双手才举得起的白石金饰圣柱，柱身刻着螺旋光纹，柱顶是一枚镂空的光轮，柱脚包着金箍，立在一座白布覆盖的木架上。
subject.en: The Dawnpillar: a white stone pillar trimmed in gold, about 2.5 m long and needing both hands to lift, its shaft carved with spiraling rays, a pierced halo wheel at the top, a gold band around its foot, standing in a wooden stand draped with white cloth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格立在木架上的圣柱；第 2 格斜倚在架上、白布滑落一半的圣柱；第 3 格被铁链缚在架上的圣柱；第 4 格横放在地上的圣柱。
extra.en: Cell 1: the pillar upright in its stand; cell 2: the pillar leaning in the stand, the white cloth half slipped off; cell 3: the pillar chained to the stand; cell 4: the pillar lying on the ground.

items.notes: 光轮与金饰用暖金 #ffd58a 一类，不用门扉金；神光由特效另出，素材本身不发光。

subject.zh: 曙光圣柱：一根约 2.5 米长、双手才举得起的白石金饰圣柱，柱身刻着螺旋光纹，柱顶是一枚镂空的光轮，柱脚包着金箍，立在一座白布覆盖的木架上。
subject.en: The Dawnpillar: a white stone pillar trimmed in gold, about 2.5 m long and needing both hands to lift, its shaft carved with spiraling rays, a pierced halo wheel at the top, a gold band around its foot, standing in a wooden stand draped with white cloth.

extra.zh: 这一张是圣柱在首领战里的四档损毁，四格都立在木架上，白布已经落下：第 1 格完好的圣柱；第 2 格柱身一道斜裂纹，光轮缺了一角；第 3 格裂纹爬满柱身，柱顶的光轮断落一半；第 4 格只剩木架上的一截残柱与散落在架脚的白石碎块。
extra.en: This sheet shows the four damage stages of the pillar in the boss fight, all four upright in the stand with the white cloth already fallen: cell 1, the intact pillar; cell 2, one slanting crack down the shaft and a chip missing from the halo wheel; cell 3, cracks all over the shaft and half of the halo wheel broken off; cell 4, only a stump of the pillar left in the stand with white stone fragments scattered at its foot.

items.notes: 首领战 archbishop_dawnpillar 里圣柱有独立血量、可被击碎：四格按血量从满到碎依次切换。裂纹是石面的裂，素材本身不发光；神光与灼痕由特效 art_vfx_cut_dawnpillar 与 art_vfx_boss_archbishop_dawnpillar_pillar_sweep 另画。光轮与金饰用暖金 #ffd58a 一类，不用门扉金。附 art_prop_dawnpillar_relic 作参照，圣柱的外形、刻纹与配色一致。

subject.zh: 圣战军的木投石机：粗木框架约 4 米长、3.5 米高，中间立着一根长投臂，臂端挂着皮兜，底座有两对实心木轮与绞盘，框架上钉着白底金光轮的小三角旗。
subject.en: A crusade army wooden catapult: a heavy timber frame about 4 m long and 3.5 m tall, a long throwing arm in the middle with a leather sling at its end, two pairs of solid wooden wheels and a winch on the base, a small white pennant with a gold halo wheel nailed to the frame.

extra.zh: 第 1 格投臂收起、待发的投石机；第 2 格投臂扬起、刚投出的投石机；第 3 格旁边堆着石弹的投石机；第 4 格被烧坏、投臂折断的投石机。
extra.en: Cell 1: the catapult with its arm cocked, ready to loose; cell 2: the catapult with its arm raised just after a throw; cell 3: the catapult with a pile of stone shot beside it; cell 4: a burnt catapult with a broken arm.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头、投臂朝画面左上扬；光轮旗很小，不要喧宾夺主。

subject.zh: 界石线上的界石：一根约 2 米高的灰白方石柱，顶部微圆，四面刻着一行行已经磨平的刻痕，看得出曾经是字但完全不可读，柱身北面带着灰白的风蚀，脚下压着一圈碎石。
subject.en: A boundary stone on the Boundary Line: a grey white square stone pillar about 2 m tall with a slightly rounded top, its four faces carved with rows of marks worn smooth, clearly once an inscription but completely unreadable, grey white weathering on its north face, a ring of rubble around its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的界石；第 2 格向北倾斜的界石；第 3 格上半截断落的界石；第 4 格根部积着灰、北面发灰的界石。
extra.en: Cell 1: an intact boundary stone; cell 2: a stone leaning north; cell 3: a stone with its upper half broken off; cell 4: a stone with ash gathered at its foot and a greyed north face.

items.notes: 属于立石（standing_stone）；刻痕要像磨平的旧字而绝不可读，导入的文字检测会拦下像字的图。

subject.zh: 残阶坡脚圣教的禁行告示牌：一块白漆木板钉在木桩上，约 1.8 米高，板面画着一枚金色光轮与一只张开的手掌（意思是止步），四角钉着铁钉，白漆已经起皮发灰。
subject.en: The church's no-entry board at the foot of the Broken Stair slope: a white-painted board nailed to a stake about 1.8 m tall, painted with a golden halo wheel and an open raised palm meaning stop, iron nails at the four corners, the white paint peeling and greying.

extra.zh: 第 1 格新立的告示牌；第 2 格风吹日晒、漆面剥落的旧牌；第 3 格被人用泥抹花了的告示牌；第 4 格倒在地上的告示牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a freshly posted board; cell 2: an old board with peeling paint; cell 3: a board smeared with mud by someone; cell 4: a board knocked down on the ground.

items.notes: 只用图形（光轮、手掌），不写任何字；光轮用暖金，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 林约界线上的约树：一棵孤立的巨大老橡，约 9 米高，树干粗得要三人合抱，树皮上刻着一圈圈新旧不一的刻痕与几道兽爪印，树冠宽阔，最低的粗枝上系着几条褪色布条。
subject.en: The Pact Oak on the line of the forest pact: a solitary huge old oak about 9 m tall, its trunk so thick it takes three people to circle it, rings of old and new notches carved in the bark along with a few claw marks, a broad crown, faded cloth strips tied to its lowest heavy limb.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：整棵树居中，树干正对镜头，刻痕集中在齐胸高的位置，清楚可辨；树冠比普通橡树更宽更高，一眼看得出它是地标。
extra.en: A single standee: the whole tree centered, the trunk facing the camera, the notches concentrated at chest height and clearly visible; the crown wider and taller than an ordinary oak so it reads at once as a landmark.

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类地标树（landmark_tree）；刻痕是刻线不是字；比林中普通老橡大一号，否则玩家认不出约树。

subject.zh: 两棵树之间的大蛛网：一张约 3 米宽的灰白蛛网，从放射状主丝向外一圈圈织开，网上粘着落叶、小虫壳与一只被缠成白茧的小兽，网角挂在两根粗枝上。
subject.en: A great spider web between two trees: a grey white web about 3 m wide spun in rings outward from radial threads, fallen leaves, small husks and a little animal wrapped into a white cocoon stuck in it, its corners anchored on two thick branches.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的大网；第 2 格破了一个大洞的网；第 3 格缠着白茧的网；第 4 格只剩几根主丝的残网。
extra.en: Cell 1: a complete large web; cell 2: a web torn with a big hole; cell 3: a web holding white cocoons; cell 4: a ruined web of only a few main threads.

items.notes: 蛛丝用 1 像素的浅灰线，画出两段树枝作挂点即可，不画整棵树；背景洋红要能从网眼里透出。

subject.zh: 狼穴岩：一块约 3 米高的灰岩斜倚在土坡上，下面压出一个半人高的黑洞口，洞口周围的土被踩得光秃，散着几根白骨与一撮灰毛，岩顶长着灌木。
subject.en: The wolf den rock: a grey rock about 3 m tall leaning against an earth bank, beneath it a black opening half a person high, the ground around the mouth trampled bare, a few white bones and a tuft of grey fur scattered there, shrubs growing on top of the rock.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有狼出没的狼穴；第 2 格洞口堆着枯枝、已废弃的狼穴；第 3 格冬天洞口积雪的狼穴；第 4 格被人用石块堵住的狼穴。
extra.en: Cell 1: an inhabited den; cell 2: an abandoned den with dead branches piled at the mouth; cell 3: the den in winter with snow at the mouth; cell 4: the den blocked up with stones.

items.notes: 不画狼（魔物另出）；洞口是纯暗色。

subject.zh: 伐区原木堆：七八根去了枝的铁杉原木横着码成金字塔形，约 3 米长、1.5 米高，截面露出浅黄年轮，两端用木楔卡住防滚，原木上落着松针与锯末。
subject.en: A felling-area log pile: seven or eight trimmed ironhemlock logs stacked crosswise into a pyramid about 3 m long and 1.5 m tall, pale yellow growth rings showing on the cut ends, wooden chocks at both ends to keep them from rolling, pine needles and sawdust on top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格码好的原木堆；第 2 格只剩三根的小堆；第 3 格旁边插着一把伐木斧的原木堆；第 4 格有几根滚落散开的原木堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a neatly stacked pile; cell 2: a small pile of only three logs; cell 3: a pile with a felling axe stuck beside it; cell 4: a pile with a few logs rolled loose.

items.notes: 原木截面朝镜头一侧，年轮是同心圈；伐区界桩与林约有关，这里只是普通原木。

subject.zh: 伐木桩：齐膝高的铁杉树桩，截面平整、浅黄年轮清楚，外圈是深褐树皮，桩边冒出一两根新芽，根部向四周伸进土里。
subject.en: Felled stumps: knee-high ironhemlock stumps with flat cut tops showing clear pale yellow growth rings, an outer ring of dark brown bark, one or two new shoots sprouting at the side, roots spreading out into the soil.

extra.zh: 第 1 格新伐的树桩，截面浅黄；第 2 格旧伐的树桩，截面发灰开裂；第 3 格截面上插着一把斧子的树桩；第 4 格长满苔与蘑菇的老树桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a freshly cut stump, the face pale yellow; cell 2: an old stump, the face grey and cracked; cell 3: a stump with an axe stuck in its top; cell 4: an old stump covered in moss and mushrooms.

items.notes: 截面略带俯视，看得见年轮；新旧对比是伐区的线索。

subject.zh: 铁杉林深处盘根下的魔物巢：一棵倒树翻起的巨大根盘，根须像笼子一样拱出地面，约 3.5 米宽，下面挖出一个黑暗的巢穴，穴口铺着撕碎的毛皮与骨片，根上沾着暗色黏液。
subject.en: A monster nest under tangled roots deep in the Ironhemlock: the huge root plate of a fallen tree torn up out of the ground, roots arching like a cage about 3.5 m wide, a dark burrow dug beneath, the mouth lined with shredded fur and bone chips, dark slime on the roots.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有魔物盘踞的巢；第 2 格被清理过、巢口塌下的巢；第 3 格巢口长着几颗发淡紫光的磷光菌；第 4 格被焚烧过的焦黑空巢。
extra.en: Cell 1: an occupied nest; cell 2: a cleared nest with its mouth caved in; cell 3: a nest with a few faintly purple glowing glowcaps at the mouth; cell 4: a burnt empty nest, charred black.

items.notes: 澱紫只在第 3 格的菌上，用很小的面积；不画魔物本体。

subject.zh: 倒木：一根粗大的倒伏树干，直径约 1 米、长约 4 米，斜躺着，一端是断裂的参差木茬，另一端连着翻起的根，树干上长满苔、蕨与一排排层叠的木菌。
subject.en: A fallen log: a massive downed trunk about 1 m across and 4 m long lying at an angle, one end a jagged broken stub, the other attached to an upturned root, its length covered in moss, ferns and rows of stacked shelf fungi.

extra.zh: 第 1 格长满苔的倒木；第 2 格中间被掏空、能钻过去的空心倒木；第 3 格刚倒不久、树皮完整的倒木；第 4 格朽烂塌陷、半埋进土里的倒木。
extra.en: Cell 1: a moss-covered log; cell 2: a hollow log with a hole one could crawl through; cell 3: a recently fallen log with its bark intact; cell 4: a rotten log collapsed and half buried in the soil.

items.notes: 倒木横向占满格宽，底边贴格底；木菌是普通菌，不发光。

subject.zh: 林中的兽骨堆：一堆被啃干净的鹿与野猪骨头，最大的是一只带獠牙的头骨与一副鹿角，骨色象牙白带黄褐斑，间杂着灰毛与落叶，约到小腿高。
subject.en: A pile of animal bones in the woods: gnawed-clean bones of deer and boar, the largest a tusked skull and a set of antlers, the bones ivory with yellow brown stains, mixed with grey fur and fallen leaves, about shin high.

extra.zh: 第 1 格鹿骨与鹿角；第 2 格野猪头骨与肋骨；第 3 格混着毛皮的一大堆；第 4 格散开的几根骨头。
extra.en: Cell 1: deer bones and antlers; cell 2: a boar skull and ribs; cell 3: a large heap mixed with fur; cell 4: a few scattered bones.

items.notes: 都是兽骨，不出现人骨；骨色不用纯白。

subject.zh: 熊穴：一道长着树根的土坡下挖出的大洞口，约 3 米宽、2 米高，洞口上方横着一根粗树根，洞边的树干上有深深的熊爪抓痕，地上铺着压扁的干草与落叶。
subject.en: A bear den: a large opening dug under an earth bank laced with roots, about 3 m wide and 2 m tall, a thick root crossing above the mouth, deep claw scores on a tree trunk beside it, flattened hay and leaves spread on the ground.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有熊的熊穴；第 2 格冬眠中、洞口被雪与落叶半掩的熊穴；第 3 格洞口旁堆着鱼骨与蜂巢碎片的熊穴；第 4 格坍了半边的空熊穴。
extra.en: Cell 1: an occupied den; cell 2: a den in hibernation, its mouth half hidden by snow and leaves; cell 3: a den with fish bones and broken honeycomb beside the mouth; cell 4: an empty den half collapsed.

items.notes: 不画熊；洞口纯暗色，立牌只画土坡正面。

subject.zh: 皮架：两根木杆与两根横木绑成的方框，约 2 米高，框里用皮绳绷着一张剥好的鹿皮或狼皮，皮面朝外、毛面朝内，框脚插在土里，旁边放着刮皮刀与木盆。
subject.en: A hide rack: a square frame of two poles and two crossbars lashed together, about 2 m tall, a skinned deer or wolf hide stretched inside it with leather thongs, flesh side out and fur side in, the frame legs stuck in the ground, a scraping knife and wooden tub beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格绷着鹿皮；第 2 格绷着灰狼皮；第 3 格并排两个小框绷着兔皮与狐皮；第 4 格空框，只剩皮绳。
extra.en: Cell 1: stretching a deer hide; cell 2: stretching a grey wolf hide; cell 3: two small frames side by side with rabbit and fox pelts; cell 4: an empty frame with only the thongs left.

items.notes: 皮面是浅黄褐，不画血；兽人东坡、榆集与林中营地共用。

subject.zh: 猎人陷阱：埋在落叶下的铁兽夹、系在弯树苗上的绳套、盖着枝叶的陷坑口，约到膝盖高，铁夹是暗灰带锈，绳是麻色，周围插着一根系红布的小木棍作记号。
subject.en: Hunters' traps: an iron jaw trap buried under leaves, a rope snare tied to a bent sapling, a pit mouth covered with branches and leaves, about knee high, the iron dark grey with rust, the rope hemp colored, a small stick with a red cloth stuck nearby as a marker.

extra.zh: 第 1 格张开的铁兽夹；第 2 格弯树苗上的绳套；第 3 格盖着枝叶的陷坑口；第 4 格已经合上、夹住一截树枝的铁夹。
extra.en: Cell 1: an open iron jaw trap; cell 2: a snare on a bent sapling; cell 3: a pit mouth hidden under branches; cell 4: a sprung trap clamped on a stick.

items.notes: 红布记号很小；不画被夹住的动物。

subject.zh: 烧毁的木哨塔：四根粗木柱撑起的高台，约 5 米高，台顶的小屋已经烧塌，只剩焦黑的框架与半截木栏，柱身下半截还是原木色、上半截焦黑，梯子断了几级。
subject.en: A burnt wooden watchtower: a tall platform on four heavy timber posts about 5 m high, the little hut on top burnt down to a charred frame and half a railing, the posts still natural wood below and scorched black above, several rungs missing from the ladder.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚烧过、还冒着细烟的哨塔；第 2 格冷却后的焦黑残塔；第 3 格倒向一侧、斜靠在树上的残塔；第 4 格用新木料补了平台的哨塔。
extra.en: Cell 1: just burnt, still giving off thin smoke; cell 2: a cold blackened ruin; cell 3: a ruin toppled sideways and leaning on a tree; cell 4: the tower with its platform patched with new timber.

items.notes: 焦黑用暗褐与深灰，不用纯黑；烟只画两缕。

subject.zh: 拒马：一根约 2.5 米长的横木上交叉穿着六根削尖的木桩，像一排张开的剪刀，尖端朝外斜指，木色浅褐、尖头被火烤过发黑，脚下用石块压住。
subject.en: A cheval-de-frise: a beam about 2.5 m long pierced crosswise by six sharpened stakes like a row of open scissors, the points slanting outward, the wood light brown with fire-hardened blackened tips, stones holding its feet down.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一段完整的拒马；第 2 格两段连在一起的拒马；第 3 格尖桩上缠着带刺铁丝似的荆棘；第 4 格被冲倒、断了两根桩的拒马。
extra.en: Cell 1: a complete cheval-de-frise; cell 2: two sections linked together; cell 3: stakes wound with thorny brambles; cell 4: one knocked over with two stakes broken.

items.notes: 战场装饰，不放在战线上；横向占满格宽。

subject.zh: 苇塘村的门纹小祠：齐胸高的木柱上钉着一个小木龛，龛里没有神像，只有一块刻着门形纹的小木牌，龛前挂着一盏小灯与一串打着绳结的彩绳，木头被水汽浸得发黑。
subject.en: The door-sigil shrine of Reedpond: a small wooden niche on a chest-high post, no figure inside, only a little wooden plaque carved with a door shape, a small lamp and a string of knotted colored cords hanging before it, the wood darkened by damp.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日的门纹小祠；第 2 格龛前小灯点亮的小祠；第 3 格挂满新绳结的小祠；第 4 格屠村后被焚、只剩焦柱的小祠。
extra.en: Cell 1: the shrine on an ordinary day; cell 2: the shrine with its little lamp lit; cell 3: the shrine hung with many new knots; cell 4: the shrine burnt after the massacre, only a charred post left.

items.notes: 门形纹是暗金色的小刻纹，可以带一点门扉金 #f0d890 的点缀，但面积很小；不画任何女神的徽记。

subject.zh: 苇塘村的栈道油灯杆：一根约 2.2 米高的细木杆插在栈道边，顶端的小木钩上挂着一只陶罩油灯，杆身缠着防潮的麻绳，杆脚绑在栈道桩上。
subject.en: A boardwalk oil-lamp pole of Reedpond: a slender wooden pole about 2.2 m tall set at the edge of the boardwalk, a small wooden hook at the top holding a clay-shaded oil lamp, the pole wrapped in hemp against the damp, its foot lashed to a boardwalk pile.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是陶罩油灯杆的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是挂一串两盏小纸灯的灯杆的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the clay-shaded oil lamp pole, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a pole hung with two small paper lanterns, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 屠村前家家点灯、屠村后只剩一盏，渲染层按剧情切换；点亮格的光只在灯罩里。

subject.zh: 夜风走廊的座狼穴口：雪坡下一道低矮宽阔的岩洞，约 3.5 米宽，洞口挂着冰凌，雪地被踩出一圈脏污的足印，洞边散落着咬碎的骨头与一只破马鞍。
subject.en: A warg den mouth in the Nightwind Corridor: a low wide cave under a snowy slope about 3.5 m across, icicles hanging at its lip, a ring of dirty trampled prints in the snow, crushed bones and a torn saddle scattered beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有座狼出没的穴口；第 2 格风雪掩了一半的穴口；第 3 格被火把与木桩封住的穴口；第 4 格春天雪化、露出泥与骨的穴口。
extra.en: Cell 1: an inhabited den mouth; cell 2: the mouth half buried by drifting snow; cell 3: the mouth sealed with torches and stakes; cell 4: the mouth in spring thaw showing mud and bones.

items.notes: 冰凌用冷白与浅灰，不用冰蓝大面积；不画座狼。

subject.zh: 桦村的晾鱼架：三根木杆搭成的长 A 字架，约 2.5 米宽、2 米高，横杆上一排排挂着去了内脏的银灰色鱼，鱼身被风干得发硬，架下放着一只木桶与刀。
subject.en: A fish-drying rack of the birch villages: a long A-frame of three poles about 2.5 m wide and 2 m tall, rows of gutted silver grey fish hanging from the crossbars, wind-dried stiff, a wooden tub and a knife beneath.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满鱼的晾架；第 2 格只挂了一半的晾架；第 3 格积着雪、鱼冻成硬条的晾架；第 4 格空架。
extra.en: Cell 1: a rack full of fish; cell 2: a rack half filled; cell 3: a snow-covered rack with the fish frozen stiff; cell 4: an empty rack.

items.notes: 鱼是简单的银灰色梭形，成排重复但大小略有不同。

subject.zh: 桦村的木雪橇：两根上翘的弯木滑板托着一块木板车身，约 2.5 米长，车身上用皮绳捆着兽皮包与柴捆，前端拴着拉绳，滑板底部磨得发亮。
subject.en: A wooden sled of the birch villages: two upturned bent-wood runners under a plank bed about 2.5 m long, hide bundles and firewood lashed on with thongs, a pull rope tied at the front, the runner bottoms worn shiny.

extra.zh: 第 1 格装着柴捆的雪橇；第 2 格装着兽皮包与鱼篓的雪橇；第 3 格空雪橇；第 4 格翻倒在雪里的雪橇。
extra.en: Cell 1: loaded with firewood; cell 2: loaded with hide bundles and fish baskets; cell 3: empty; cell 4: overturned in the snow.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头，滑板前端朝画面右上翘；不画拉橇的牲口。

subject.zh: 霜脊堡外开裂翘起的冰面：几块约 1 到 2 米宽的厚冰板被挤得翘起、互相叠压，冰面浅灰白带一点冷青，断面能看到层层冻纹，冰缝间露出黑色的水。
subject.en: Cracked heaving ice outside Frostridge: several thick ice slabs about 1 to 2 m across pushed up and overlapping each other, pale grey white with a touch of cold cyan, layered frozen bands visible on the broken edges, black water showing in the cracks.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两块翘起的冰板；第 2 格三块堆叠的冰板；第 3 格刚裂开、冰缝里冒着水的冰面；第 4 格被撞碎成小块的冰。
extra.en: Cell 1: two heaved slabs; cell 2: three stacked slabs; cell 3: freshly cracked ice with water welling in the gaps; cell 4: ice smashed into small pieces.

items.notes: 冰是浅灰白，冷青只在断面，不要整块涂成冰蓝；不画水面大片。

subject.zh: 难民与百帐营的帐篷：几根木杆撑起一顶粗麻布帐，约 2.5 米宽、2 米高，布面打着各色补丁，门帘卷起一角，帐边压着石块，门口放着一口锅与一卷铺盖。
subject.en: A tent of refugees and the Hundred Tents camp: a coarse sackcloth tent on a few poles, about 2.5 m wide and 2 m tall, patched in many colors, one corner of the door flap rolled up, stones weighting the edges, a pot and a rolled bedroll at the entrance.

extra.zh: 第 1 格补丁麻布帐；第 2 格兽人移民的毛毡圆帐，门帘上缝着部族纹；第 3 格只用一块油布斜搭的窝棚；第 4 格被风掀翻一半的帐。
extra.en: Cell 1: a patched sackcloth tent; cell 2: a round felt tent of orc settlers with a clan pattern stitched on the flap; cell 3: a lean-to of one oilcloth sheet; cell 4: a tent half blown over by wind.

items.notes: 鹿渡之战与榆集共用；部族纹只用几何图形，不写字。

subject.zh: 鹿渡渡口的木桩：一排粗细不一的削尖木桩斜插在浅滩泥里，约 1.5 到 2 米高，桩上缠着绳索与水草，水线以下颜色发黑，用来拦马与标出浅水路。
subject.en: Stakes at Deer Ford: a row of sharpened stakes of uneven thickness driven at a slant into the shallows, about 1.5 to 2 m tall, wrapped with ropes and waterweed, darkened below the waterline, used to stop horses and mark the shallow crossing.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三根一组的木桩；第 2 格五根一排的木桩；第 3 格桩顶系着白布条的路标桩；第 4 格被冲歪、断了两根的桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a group of three stakes; cell 2: a row of five; cell 3: marker stakes with white cloth strips at their tops; cell 4: stakes knocked askew with two broken.

items.notes: 水线用一条平直的深色带表示，不画水面。

subject.zh: 榆集的原木蜂箱：一段掏空的榆木，约 1 米高，竖立在石块上，顶上盖着一块树皮板压着石头，侧面开着一个小圆孔，孔边有几只小蜂（点状），木身被蜂蜡染得发黄。
subject.en: A log beehive of Elmfair: a hollowed elm log about 1 m tall standing upright on stones, a slab of bark weighted with a stone as its lid, a small round hole on the side with a few tiny bees as dots around it, the wood yellowed by beeswax.

extra.zh: 第 1 格竖立的单个蜂桶；第 2 格横放在木架上的两只蜂桶；第 3 格挂在树干上的蜂桶；第 4 格被熊扒开、蜂巢露出的蜂桶。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single upright log hive; cell 2: two log hives lying on a wooden rack; cell 3: a log hive hung on a tree trunk; cell 4: a hive torn open by a bear with comb exposed.

items.notes: 蜜蜂只是 1 像素的点，不要画大；蜂巢是暖黄色。

subject.zh: 兽人的小祖灵石圈：七块齐腰到一人高的粗糙立石围成一圈，直径约 3.5 米，石面涂着赭红手印与爪纹，圈中央一只石盆里燃着火，石脚挂着骨串与羽毛。
subject.en: A small orc ancestor circle: seven rough standing stones from waist to head height forming a ring about 3.5 m across, ochre red handprints and claw marks painted on them, a stone basin burning in the middle, strings of bone and feathers hanging at the stones' feet.

extra.zh: 第 1 格火盆燃着的石圈；第 2 格火盆熄灭的石圈；第 3 格石上挂满新献的骨串与布条；第 4 格倒了两块石头的旧石圈。
extra.en: Cell 1: the ring with its basin burning; cell 2: the ring with the basin cold; cell 3: stones hung with many new bone strings and ribbons; cell 4: an old ring with two stones fallen.

items.notes: 石圈略带俯视，后排的石头比前排小一点；赭红手印不是文字。

subject.zh: 兽人的小图腾柱：一根约 2.5 米高的木柱，从下到上雕着三层兽首（熊、狼、鸦），涂着赭红、黑与白，柱顶插着两根大羽毛，柱身挂着骨铃，柱脚压着石块。
subject.en: A small orc totem pole: a wooden post about 2.5 m tall carved from bottom to top with three animal heads (bear, wolf, raven), painted ochre red, black and white, two large feathers set at the top, bone bells hanging on it, stones packed at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格熊、狼、鸦三层的图腾柱；第 2 格鹿与野猪的图腾柱；第 3 格新漆、挂满祭物的图腾柱；第 4 格褪色开裂、向一侧倾斜的旧柱。
extra.en: Cell 1: bear, wolf and raven; cell 2: deer and boar; cell 3: freshly painted and hung with offerings; cell 4: faded, cracked and leaning.

items.notes: 兽首造型粗犷、几何化；与风牙草原的高图腾柱是不同部族，配色不同。

subject.zh: 无字碑林的拓碑纸：一张贴在灰石碑面上的米白宣纸，约 1 米高，纸面用墨包拍出灰黑的斑驳拓痕，只有不成形的纹理，纸角压着小石子，旁边放着一只布墨包与一碗清水。
subject.en: Rubbing paper at the Field of Blank Steles: a cream sheet about 1 m tall pressed onto a grey stone stele face, dabbed with an ink pad into mottled grey black rubbing marks that form only shapeless texture, small pebbles holding its corners, a cloth ink pad and a bowl of water beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚贴上、还没拓的白纸；第 2 格拓了一半的纸；第 3 格拓完、显出一片斑驳纹理的纸；第 4 格揭下来卷成一卷放在碑脚的拓纸。
extra.en: Cell 1: freshly pasted blank paper; cell 2: half rubbed; cell 3: fully rubbed showing mottled texture; cell 4: peeled off and rolled up at the foot of the stele.

items.notes: 拓痕绝不能像字，只是纹理与斑块；只画一段碑面作底，不画整座碑（碑由建筑外观批量生成）。

subject.zh: 凿着编号的铺路石：几块约 0.6 米见方的灰石板，表面被车轮磨得光滑，每块的角上凿着一组短刻线与小圆点（古城的编号方式，看不出是字），石缝长草。
subject.en: Numbered paving stones: a few grey flagstones about 0.6 m square, worn smooth by wheels, each carved at one corner with a group of short notches and small dots (an ancient numbering scheme that does not read as writing), grass in the joints.

extra.zh: 第 1 格两块并排的铺路石；第 2 格一块翘起、露出下面土层的石板；第 3 格半埋在草里的三块；第 4 格一块碎成两半的石板。
extra.en: Cell 1: two stones side by side; cell 2: one flagstone tilted up showing the soil beneath; cell 3: three half buried in grass; cell 4: one flagstone broken in two.

items.notes: 编号只是刻线与点的组合，不能像数字或字母；画面略带俯视，看得见石面。

subject.zh: 界石垒：一人高（约 1.8 米）的石垒，由各族带来的石头垒成，石头的颜色与质地各不相同：灰白界石、赭红砂岩、黑玄武岩、带银苔的林石、冰蓝碎岩，顶上立着一块扁石。
subject.en: A boundary cairn: a head-high (about 1.8 m) stone stack built from stones brought by every people, each stone of a different color and texture: grey white boundary stone, ochre sandstone, black basalt, forest stone with silver moss, ice blue rock, a flat stone set upright on top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格以灰白与赭红石为主的石垒；第 2 格以黑石与银苔石为主的石垒；第 3 格以冰蓝碎岩与白石为主的石垒；第 4 格混着各色石头、顶上压着一枚门形小石的石垒。
extra.en: Cell 1: mostly grey white and ochre stones; cell 2: mostly black stone and silver-mossed stone; cell 3: mostly ice blue rock and white stone; cell 4: mixed stones of all colors topped by a small door-shaped stone.

items.notes: 九座各不相同：四个变体加镜像与配色就能摆出九座；不刻字。

subject.zh: 立国当夜各族代表的帐篷：一顶约 3 米宽的方顶帐，帐布厚实，门帘两侧挂着本族的布幡，帐前立着一根插着族旗的短杆与一只火盆，帐顶边缘缀着流苏。
subject.en: A delegate's tent on the night of founding: a square-topped tent about 3 m wide of heavy canvas, the clan's cloth pennants hung on both sides of the door flap, a short pole with the people's flag and a brazier before it, tassels along the roof edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格人族代表的米白帐；第 2 格兽人代表的赭红毛毡帐；第 3 格精灵代表的雾白与银灰帐；第 4 格矮人代表的铁灰帐，门前一块方石。
extra.en: Cell 1: a cream tent of the human delegate; cell 2: an ochre felt tent of the orc delegate; cell 3: a mist white and silver grey tent of the elf delegate; cell 4: an iron grey tent of the dwarf delegate with a square stone at the door.

items.notes: 族旗只用图形纹章，不写字；火盆不必点燃（夜里另加光）。

subject.zh: 折桥驿得名的断桥：一座灰褐石拱桥从中间断成两截，画面里是其中一截：一座方石桥墩托着一拱半桥身，桥栏残缺，断口参差，碎石从断口挂下来，石缝里长着灰草。
subject.en: The broken bridge that gave Brokenspan Post its name: a grey brown stone arch bridge snapped in two, the image showing one of the halves: a square stone pier carrying an arch and a half of the span, the parapet broken, the break jagged with rubble hanging from it, grey grass in the joints.

extra.zh: 桥墩在画面左侧，桥身向右伸出后在断口处截断，断口朝画面右侧；桥下留空不画水。
extra.en: The pier at the left, the span reaching right and ending at the jagged break facing right; leave the space beneath empty, no water.

items.notes: 另一截可以把这张图水平翻转使用；不画灰溪的水。

subject.zh: 绳桥：两根约 2 米高的粗木桩，桩顶系着两根粗麻绳扶手，绳间铺着一段用绳串起的木板桥面，木板灰白、有几块缺失，桩脚用石块与木楔加固。
subject.en: A rope bridge: two thick wooden posts about 2 m tall with heavy hemp handrails tied at their tops, a stretch of plank deck strung on ropes between them, the planks grey white with a few missing, the posts braced with stones and wedges.

extra.zh: 第 1 格桥头的一对木桩与第一段桥板；第 2 格中段桥板（只有绳与板，没有桩）；第 3 格一侧扶手断了、垂下来的桥段；第 4 格新补了木板与绳的桥头。
extra.en: Cell 1: the bridgehead pair of posts with the first stretch of planks; cell 2: a middle stretch (ropes and planks, no posts); cell 3: a stretch with one handrail broken and hanging; cell 4: a bridgehead newly repaired with planks and rope.

items.notes: 桥段左右两端要能与相邻一段拼接；不画桥下的沟。

subject.zh: 折桥驿的木瞭望台：四根粗木柱撑起约 5 米高的平台，平台有木栏与一个小草顶，柱间斜钉着交叉支撑，一架木梯靠在一侧，台上放着一只火盆。
subject.en: The wooden watchtower of Brokenspan Post: four thick posts holding a platform about 5 m high with a wooden rail and a small thatched roof, crossed braces nailed between the posts, a wooden ladder against one side, a brazier on the platform.

extra.zh: 第 1 格第一幕敌营的瞭望台：挂着破烂的匪帮旗，台上火盆燃着；第 2 格敌营瞭望台夜里火盆熄了；第 3 格收编后的驿站瞭望台：新钉的木栏、挂着驿站的马蹄纹小旗，火盆燃着；第 4 格驿站瞭望台火盆熄灭。
extra.en: Cell 1: the bandit camp tower in Act One: a ragged gang banner hung, the brazier burning; cell 2: the bandit tower at night with the brazier out; cell 3: the post station tower after it is taken over: newly nailed rails, a small flag with a horseshoe emblem, the brazier burning; cell 4: the post station tower with the brazier out.

items.notes: 敌营与驿站两态各两格，由剧情切换；旗面只有图形不写字。

subject.zh: 断里程碑：一根约 1.2 米高、顶部断掉的灰石方柱，柱身刻着一道道横刻线与一个箭头形凹槽（古路的里程记号，看不出是字），断口参差，脚下散着断下来的那截碎石。
subject.en: A broken milestone: a grey stone square post about 1.2 m tall with its top snapped off, its shaft carved with horizontal notches and an arrow-shaped groove (an old road's distance mark that does not read as writing), the break jagged, the fallen piece lying at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格断了顶的里程碑；第 2 格整根倒在地上的里程碑；第 3 格被扶正、用石块垫着的里程碑；第 4 格只剩齐膝高一截的里程碑。
extra.en: Cell 1: a milestone with its top broken off; cell 2: a whole milestone fallen on the ground; cell 3: one set back upright, propped with stones; cell 4: only a knee-high stub remaining.

items.notes: 属于立石变体；刻线不能像数字。

subject.zh: 碎门坡的倒伏拱石群：几块门框形的灰石拱圈与门柱倒伏在坡上，互相叠压，每块都看得出是一扇门的门框，最大的拱圈约 3 米宽，石面刻着磨损的门形纹，缝里积灰。
subject.en: The fallen arch stones of the Shattered Door Slope: several grey stone arches and door posts lying toppled on the slope, piled on one another, each recognizably the frame of a door, the largest arch about 3 m wide, worn door-shaped carving on the stones, ash in the cracks.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一座侧倒的拱门；第 2 格两座交叠倒下的拱门；第 3 格一座拱门倒下、拱心石摔落一旁；第 4 格三四根门柱横七竖八地躺着。
extra.en: Cell 1: one arch fallen on its side; cell 2: two arches fallen across each other; cell 3: an arch fallen with its keystone flung aside; cell 4: three or four door posts lying every which way.

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类门框（doorframe）的变体 1：倒伏的拱门；画面要让人一眼看出"这是无数扇倒下的门"；不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 地缝里长出的小澱晶簇：从黑岩裂缝中冒出的一簇六棱柱状晶体，最高到膝盖，晶体是淡紫 #c6b5e0 透到深紫 #5a3a48，尖端微亮，根部的岩缝四周发灰。
subject.en: A small dian crystal cluster growing from a crack: a spray of hexagonal prism crystals rising from a fissure in black rock, the tallest knee high, the crystals pale violet #c6b5e0 deepening to dark purple #5a3a48, their tips faintly bright, the rock around the crack greyed.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三根小晶柱；第 2 格五六根的晶簇；第 3 格一根被敲断、只剩断茬的晶簇；第 4 格长在一截石化树根上的晶簇。
extra.en: Cell 1: three small prisms; cell 2: a cluster of five or six; cell 3: a cluster with one prism knocked off, leaving a stub; cell 4: a cluster growing on a petrified root.

items.notes: 澱晶是保留语义色（澱紫），只用在晶体上；晶体的亮只在尖端一两像素，不画光晕。

subject.zh: 晶沟深处的大澱晶：一根从沟底斜刺出来的巨大澱晶柱，约 7 米高，周围簇拥着几十根小晶柱，晶体由淡紫 #c6b5e0 到暗紫 #4a3a62，内部有层层裂纹，晶根处的岩石被侵蚀成灰白。
subject.en: The great dian crystal deep in the Crystal Gully: a massive crystal pillar thrusting at an angle from the gully floor, about 7 m tall, surrounded by dozens of smaller prisms, the crystal running from pale violet #c6b5e0 to dark purple #4a3a62 with layered internal fractures, the rock at its root eaten away to grey white.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：主晶柱略向左倾、尖端在画面上部偏左，底部的小晶簇铺满画面宽度的一半；晶体只在尖端与棱线有一两像素的亮，不画外溢的光。
extra.en: A single standee: the main pillar leaning slightly left with its tip in the upper left, small clusters at its base spanning half the image width; the crystal brightens only by a pixel or two at tips and edges, no light spilling outward.

items.notes: 这是澱的地标，澱紫只用在晶体上；不画晶沟的岩壁全景，底部贴画面底边。

subject.zh: 灰豺的穴：灰坡下一个半人高的扁洞口，约 2.5 米宽，洞口被刨出一圈松灰，散着啃碎的小骨与几撮灰褐毛，洞口上方压着一块黑石，旁边长着一丛枯刺灌。
subject.en: A grey jackal den: a flat opening half a person high under an ash slope, about 2.5 m wide, a ring of loose ash scraped out around the mouth, gnawed small bones and tufts of grey brown fur scattered there, a black rock pressing over the mouth, a dead thornbush beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格有灰豺出没的穴；第 2 格洞口被灰暴半埋的穴；第 3 格被人用石块堵上的穴；第 4 格夜里洞口有两点反光的眼（只是两个小亮点）。
extra.en: Cell 1: an inhabited den; cell 2: the mouth half buried by an ash storm; cell 3: the den blocked with stones; cell 4: the den at night with two small glints of eyes in the mouth.

items.notes: 不画豺本体；第 4 格只画两个暖黄小点，不用紫色。

subject.zh: 拾遗营的帐篷：几根木杆与一根横梁撑起的灰褐油布帐，约 2.5 米宽、2 米高，布面打着补丁、落着灰，帐脚压着石头，门口放着一只铁锅与一卷铺盖。
subject.en: A tent of the scavenging camp: a grey brown oilcloth tent on a few poles and a ridge beam, about 2.5 m wide and 2 m tall, the cloth patched and dusted with ash, stones weighting its edges, an iron pot and a bedroll at the entrance.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完好的油布帐；第 2 格门帘卷起、里面透出暖光的帐（夜里有人）；第 3 格只剩木杆骨架的旧帐；第 4 格骨架上挂着几条破布的帐。
extra.en: Cell 1: an intact oilcloth tent; cell 2: the flap rolled up showing warm light inside (occupied at night); cell 3: an old tent with only its pole skeleton left; cell 4: a skeleton with a few rags hanging on it.

items.notes: 骨里营地与拾门者营地共用，第 3、4 格是拾门者营地的帐篷骨架。

subject.zh: 骨原的分层骨堆：一堆约 1.5 米高的骨头，看得出分成几层：底层发黑发褐，中层灰白，顶层还算洁白，夹杂着锈烂的甲片与断矛头，像是几百年里一层层堆上去的。
subject.en: A layered bone heap of the Bone Plain: a pile of bones about 1.5 m tall visibly in strata: blackened brown at the bottom, grey white in the middle, still fairly clean at the top, mixed with rusted armor plates and broken spearheads, as if heaped up layer upon layer over centuries.

extra.zh: 第 1 格矮宽的骨堆；第 2 格高而尖的骨堆；第 3 格被风吹塌了一侧的骨堆；第 4 格一侧插着一面破旗的骨堆。
extra.en: Cell 1: a low wide heap; cell 2: a tall pointed heap; cell 3: a heap with one side slumped by the wind; cell 4: a heap with a torn flag stuck in one side.

items.notes: 骨堆不写实血腥，用简洁的骨形；层次靠颜色从下暗到上亮。

subject.zh: 插在地上的旧兵器：几把式样各异的旧兵器斜插在灰土里：宽刃短剑、长枪、单刃弯刀、带钩的戟，最高约 2 米，锈色从橙褐到黑褐不等，有的柄上还缠着烂布。
subject.en: Old weapons planted in the ground: several weapons of different eras stuck at angles in the ash soil: a broad short sword, a spear, a single-edged curved blade, a hooked halberd, the tallest about 2 m, rust ranging from orange brown to black brown, rotten cloth still wrapped on some hafts.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三把剑一组；第 2 格两支长枪与一面破盾；第 3 格一把巨大的双手剑独插；第 4 格一圈插成环的兵器。
extra.en: Cell 1: a group of three swords; cell 2: two spears and a broken shield; cell 3: a single huge two-handed sword; cell 4: weapons planted in a ring.

items.notes: 式样要明显来自不同年代（宽刃、细刃、弯刃），这是"跨越几百年"的线索；不画尸体。

subject.zh: 骨原中央的巨大骨丘：一座约 6 米高的骨头山，由无数骨骸、头骨与锈甲堆成，顶部插着一根折断的旗杆，丘体中段有一个凹进去的黑洞，像王座又像巢，骨色灰白到焦褐。
subject.en: The great mound at the center of the Bone Plain: a hill of bones about 6 m tall built from countless skeletons, skulls and rusted armor, a snapped flagpole stuck in its top, a dark hollow sunk into its middle like a throne or a nest, the bones grey white to scorched brown.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：骨丘居中，正面的黑洞朝镜头，两侧有骨头滑落形成的缓坡；颜色由下暗到上亮。
extra.en: A single standee: the mound centered, its dark hollow facing the camera, gentle slopes of slid bones on both sides; colors darker at the bottom and lighter at the top.

items.notes: 首领场地的地标，不画首领本体；骨头用简洁形状，避免写实恐怖。

subject.zh: 玻璃原上熔化的门框残迹：一座门框像蜡一样被熔塌，门柱弯曲下垂，门楣淌成一滩凝固的青铜熔痕，约 3 米宽，熔痕表面发出玻璃般的反光，周围的地面熔成黑亮的玻璃。
subject.en: A melted doorframe scar on the Glass Plain: a doorframe slumped as if made of wax, its posts bent and drooping, its lintel run down into a puddle of solidified bronze, about 3 m wide, the melted surfaces glinting like glass, the ground around fused into glossy black glass.

extra.zh: 第 1 格一侧门柱还立着、另一侧熔塌的门框；第 2 格整座熔成一个低矮弧形的门框；第 3 格只剩门槛与一滩熔铜；第 4 格两座熔在一起的门框。
extra.en: Cell 1: one post still standing, the other slumped; cell 2: a whole frame melted into a low arc; cell 3: only the threshold and a puddle of bronze; cell 4: two frames melted together.

items.notes: 属于门框（doorframe）的熔化变体；门铜是暗青铜色，不发门扉金的光。

subject.zh: 玻璃原的熔碎片：一片散落在地上的黑亮玻璃碎块，大的像盘子，小的像指甲，边缘锋利，表面反射着天光的小亮点，夹着几粒烧红后冷却的赭色石子。
subject.en: Glass shards of the Glass Plain: a scatter of glossy black glass fragments on the ground, the large ones plate-sized and the small ones fingernail-sized, sharp-edged, their surfaces catching small points of sky light, mixed with a few ochre pebbles once red-hot and now cooled.

extra.zh: 第 1 格稀疏的一片；第 2 格密集的一片；第 3 格一块竖起的大碎片；第 4 格围成一圈的碎片。
extra.en: Cell 1: a sparse scatter; cell 2: a dense scatter; cell 3: one large shard standing upright; cell 4: shards in a ring.

items.notes: 反光只用 1 到 2 像素的白点；碎片很低矮，画面略带俯视。

subject.zh: 红牙斥候的旗：一根约 3 米高的黑木杆，杆顶绑着一颗兽牙装饰，挂着一面窄长的暗红布旗，旗面用白色涂着一枚向上的獠牙纹，旗尾剪成锯齿，杆脚插在石堆里。
subject.en: A Redfang scout banner: a black wooden pole about 3 m tall with a beast fang bound at its tip, a narrow dark red cloth banner hanging from it painted with an upward fang emblem in white, the tail cut into saw teeth, its foot planted in a stone pile.

extra.zh: 第 1 格新插的旗；第 2 格被风撕破一角的旗；第 3 格倒在地上的旗；第 4 格杆上挂着一串兽骨的旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a newly planted banner; cell 2: a banner with a torn corner; cell 3: a banner fallen on the ground; cell 4: a banner with a string of beast bones on its pole.

items.notes: 红牙丘营地的可见标记；纹章只是图形。

subject.zh: 灰海中的亚龙脊岩：一道从灰丘里拱出来的长岩脊，约 8 米长、4 米高，岩脊上一排向后弯的尖石像亚龙的背鳍，岩体是黑褐色带灰白风蚀纹，灰从脊背两侧流下。
subject.en: The wyrm-back ridge in the Ash Sea: a long rock ridge arching out of the ash dunes, about 8 m long and 4 m tall, a row of backward-curving spikes along its crest like a wyrm's dorsal fins, the rock dark brown with grey white wind-carved streaks, ash pouring down both flanks.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：岩脊横贯画面，左低右高，最高的背鳍在右侧三分之一处；底部被灰丘掩住，贴画面底边。
extra.en: A single standee: the ridge spanning the image, low on the left and high on the right, the tallest spike a third of the way from the right; its base hidden in ash dunes, resting on the bottom edge.

items.notes: 它是岩石，不是活的亚龙，不画眼睛与肉质；灰色系为主。

subject.zh: 半埋在灰里的屋顶：一座古屋的双坡屋顶只露出上半截，约 4 米宽，屋脊略塌，瓦片残缺、露出灰白的椽子，一扇老虎窗还在，窗洞里是黑的，灰从屋坡上流下来。
subject.en: A roof half buried in ash: the gabled roof of an ancient house with only its upper half showing, about 4 m wide, the ridge sagging, tiles missing and grey white rafters exposed, one dormer window still intact with blackness inside, ash pouring down the slopes.

extra.zh: 第 1 格露出一半的屋顶；第 2 格只露出屋脊与老虎窗；第 3 格一侧坍塌、能钻进去的屋顶；第 4 格屋顶上立着一根拾荒者插的木杆标记。
extra.en: Cell 1: half a roof showing; cell 2: only the ridge and dormer showing; cell 3: one side caved in, an opening to crawl into; cell 4: a roof with a scavenger's marker pole stuck in it.

items.notes: 灰海共有 4 处，用变体区分；瓦色是褪色的灰赭，不是新瓦。

subject.zh: 门站的站立大门框：一座约 8 米高、6 米宽的古青铜门框，两根门柱上刻满层层门形纹与看不懂的刻线，门楣厚重，框里空无一物，门铜本色是暗青铜 #6e6054 带绿锈。
subject.en: The standing great doorframe of a gate station: an ancient bronze frame about 8 m tall and 6 m wide, its two posts carved with tier upon tier of door-shaped motifs and incomprehensible incised lines, a massive lintel, nothing at all inside the frame, the gatebronze in its natural dark bronze #6e6054 with green patina.

extra.zh: 复原前：门柱有裂缝、一角缺损，表面暗沉发绿，框内透出洋红背景，门纹不发光。
extra.en: Before restoration: cracks in the posts, one corner missing, the surface dull and greenish, the magenta background showing through the frame, the door motifs unlit.

items.notes: 与 art_prop_standing_great_gateframe_restored 是同一座门框，subject 逐字相同，只靠 extra 区分前后两态；刻线不能像字。

subject.zh: 门站的站立大门框：一座约 8 米高、6 米宽的古青铜门框，两根门柱上刻满层层门形纹与看不懂的刻线，门楣厚重，框里空无一物，门铜本色是暗青铜 #6e6054 带绿锈。
subject.en: The standing great doorframe of a gate station: an ancient bronze frame about 8 m tall and 6 m wide, its two posts carved with tier upon tier of door-shaped motifs and incomprehensible incised lines, a massive lintel, nothing at all inside the frame, the gatebronze in its natural dark bronze #6e6054 with green patina.

extra.zh: 复原后：裂缝合上、缺角补齐，门形纹的刻槽里亮起门扉金 #f0d890，框内仍是空的（透出洋红背景），只在刻槽里发光，不画外溢光晕。
extra.en: After restoration: the cracks closed and the missing corner made whole, the grooves of the door motifs glowing door gold #f0d890, the frame still empty inside (magenta background showing through), light only within the grooves with no halo spilling out.

items.notes: 与复原前的条目同一 subject；门扉金只在门纹刻槽里，这是保留语义色的正当用法。

subject.zh: 门站东北站停住的时刻牌：一块约 1.5 米宽的青铜圆盘装在两根短石柱之间，盘面刻着一圈等分的刻度与几根放射状的指针，指针都停在同一个位置，表面落满灰，边缘有绿锈。
subject.en: The stopped time board of the northeast gate station: a bronze disc about 1.5 m across mounted between two short stone posts, its face engraved with a ring of evenly spaced ticks and a few radial hands all stopped at the same position, dust lying on it, green patina at the rim.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的时刻牌；第 2 格一根指针脱落、掉在地上的时刻牌；第 3 格盘面裂了一道缝的时刻牌；第 4 格被擦去灰、露出暗铜光泽的时刻牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: the intact board; cell 2: one hand fallen to the ground; cell 3: a crack across the face; cell 4: wiped clean of dust showing a dull bronze sheen.

items.notes: 刻度只是短线，不写数字；不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 放门石的石座槽：一块约 0.8 米见方、到膝盖高的灰石墩，顶面凿出一个嵌门石用的方形凹槽，槽沿刻着一圈门形小纹，槽底空着，石墩侧面有磨损的门铜包边。
subject.en: A gatestone socket: a grey stone block about 0.8 m square and knee high, a square recess cut into its top for seating a gatestone, a ring of small door motifs carved around the rim, the socket empty, worn gatebronze edging on its sides.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空的石座槽；第 2 格槽里嵌着一块暗灰门石的石座；第 3 格石座裂成两半；第 4 格被灰埋了一半的石座。
extra.en: Cell 1: an empty socket; cell 2: a socket with a dark grey gatestone seated in it; cell 3: a socket split in two; cell 4: a socket half buried in ash.

items.notes: 门石是暗灰石块，不发光；顶面要略带俯视看得见凹槽。

subject.zh: 拾门者营地的探坑木架：一个四根木杆搭成的方架立在坑口，约 2.5 米高，顶上横着一根装着木滑轮的横梁，绳上吊着一只装土的木筐，坑沿堆着翻出的灰土与几块碎门石。
subject.en: A test-pit frame of the Gatepicker camp: a square frame of four poles over a pit mouth, about 2.5 m tall, a crossbeam with a wooden pulley on top, a basket of soil hanging from its rope, spoil of grey earth and a few broken gatestone fragments heaped at the rim.

extra.zh: 第 1 格吊着土筐的木架；第 2 格筐放下、绳垂入坑里的木架；第 3 格一根木杆断了、歪斜的木架；第 4 格坑被填平、只剩架子的木架。
extra.en: Cell 1: the frame with a basket hoisted; cell 2: the basket lowered with the rope into the pit; cell 3: a frame with one broken pole, leaning; cell 4: the pit filled in, only the frame left.

items.notes: 坑口只画一圈暗色，不画坑内；四世纪的式样，木头灰白老旧。

subject.zh: 四世纪式样的教会旧甲片：一堆锈蚀的铁甲片与一顶圆顶头盔，胸甲上残留着一枚白漆光轮纹，甲片边缘是古式的扇形，皮带早已烂掉，堆在一块灰白布上。
subject.en: Old church armor of a fourth-century pattern: a heap of rusted iron plates and a round-topped helmet, a white-painted halo wheel still faintly visible on the breastplate, the plates edged in an archaic scalloped style, the leather straps long rotted, piled on a grey white cloth.

extra.zh: 第 1 格堆在布上的甲片与头盔；第 2 格架在木桩上的整副胸甲；第 3 格半埋在灰里的头盔与臂甲；第 4 格分类摆好、准备熔炼的甲片。
extra.en: Cell 1: plates and helmet piled on cloth; cell 2: a whole breastplate set on a stake; cell 3: a helmet and vambrace half buried in ash; cell 4: plates sorted and laid out for smelting.

items.notes: 光轮纹是教会的旧式样，白漆褪成灰白；不画穿着它的亡灵。

subject.zh: 拾门者营地的账桌：一张约 1.2 米宽的折叠木桌，桌上摊着一本厚账本，旁边是墨水瓶、羽毛笔、一盏小油灯与一只装碎门石的小木盒，账页上只有一行行灰色短线。
subject.en: The ledger desk of the Gatepicker camp: a folding wooden table about 1.2 m wide, a thick ledger open on it beside an inkwell, a quill, a small oil lamp and a little wooden box of broken gatestone, the pages showing only rows of grey dashes.

extra.zh: 第 1 格摊着账本的账桌；第 2 格账本合上、油灯点亮的账桌（夜里）；第 3 格被翻倒、纸页散落的账桌；第 4 格桌旁加了一只木凳与一只钱箱。
extra.en: Cell 1: the desk with the ledger open; cell 2: the ledger closed and the lamp lit (night); cell 3: the desk overturned with pages scattered; cell 4: a stool and a money chest added beside it.

items.notes: 不写任何字，账页只有灰色短线；油灯点亮时只在灯芯有暖光。

subject.zh: 外环门框街区的晾衣绳：两根木杆之间拉着一根绳，约 3 米宽，绳上挂着几件褪成灰色的旧衣：小孩的短衫、长裙、一块床单，衣角被灰染得发白，绳上还夹着木夹。
subject.en: A laundry line in the doorframe wards of the Outer Rings: a rope stretched between two poles about 3 m apart, a few old clothes faded to grey hanging on it: a child's short tunic, a long skirt, a bedsheet, their hems whitened by ash, wooden pegs still on the line.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂着三件衣物的绳；第 2 格只挂着一件童衣的绳；第 3 格绳断了一头、衣物落在地上；第 4 格挂满衣物、被风吹起的绳。
extra.en: Cell 1: a line with three garments; cell 2: a line with only a child's tunic; cell 3: the line broken at one end, clothes fallen to the ground; cell 4: a full line lifting in the wind.

items.notes: 衣服颜色都褪得发灰，只留一点原色；这是"有人在这里生活过"的物证，安静不恐怖。

subject.zh: 古城的门牌：一块手掌大到书本大的青铜或陶片门牌，椭圆或方形，边缘有钉孔，牌面只有一组刻出来的短线与圆点（古城编号的样子，不是字），有的钉在残墙上，有的掉在灰里。
subject.en: Door plates of the ancient city: bronze or ceramic plates from palm to book size, oval or square, nail holes at the edges, the faces bearing only a group of incised short lines and dots (the look of the old city's numbering, not writing), some nailed to broken walls, some fallen in the ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格钉在一截残墙上的青铜门牌；第 2 格掉在灰里的陶门牌；第 3 格一排三块并列的门牌；第 4 格被拾起、用绳串起来的几块门牌。
extra.en: Cell 1: a bronze plate nailed to a stub of wall; cell 2: a ceramic plate fallen in the ash; cell 3: three plates in a row; cell 4: a few plates picked up and strung on a cord.

items.notes: 既是墙上装饰也是地面记号（ground_mark）；刻纹绝不能像数字或字母；不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一段残墙上孩子的涂鸦：约 2 米宽、1.5 米高的灰泥残墙，墙面用炭笔与白垩画着简笔的房子、门、太阳与手拉手的小人，线条歪歪扭扭，有一部分被灰盖住。
subject.en: A child's drawing on a broken wall: a grey plaster wall stub about 2 m wide and 1.5 m tall, its face drawn in charcoal and chalk with stick-figure houses, doors, a sun and little people holding hands, wobbly lines, part of it covered by ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格画着房子与小人；第 2 格画着一扇很大的门与一个太阳；第 3 格画着一排手拉手的小人；第 4 格墙塌了一半、只剩半幅画。
extra.en: Cell 1: houses and little people; cell 2: a very large door and a sun; cell 3: a row of little people holding hands; cell 4: the wall half collapsed, only half the drawing left.

items.notes: 涂鸦里没有字母与字，只有图；线条要像孩子画的，粗细不匀。

subject.zh: 外环的护符石：一块约 1.5 米高的灰白扁平立石，正面刻着一个嵌套的圆环与门形纹，石脚压着一圈小石子与几根打结的绳，石面有被手摸得发亮的一块。
subject.en: A ward stone of the Outer Rings: a flat grey white standing stone about 1.5 m tall, its face carved with nested rings and a door-shaped motif, a ring of pebbles and a few knotted cords at its foot, a patch of the face polished by touching hands.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的护符石；第 2 格一圈五块中较矮的一块；第 3 格刻纹被凿去一半的护符石；第 4 格倒在地上的护符石。
extra.en: Cell 1: an intact ward stone; cell 2: a shorter one from the ring of five; cell 3: one with half its carving chiseled away; cell 4: one fallen on the ground.

items.notes: 属于立石（standing_stone）；阿什的冷火在石圈中间由特效另出。

subject.zh: 没寄出的信：一只小木信匣半开着，里面与旁边散着一叠折好的信，信纸发黄卷边，有的用细绳扎着，有的封着褪色的蜡印（只有圆形图案），落满了灰。
subject.en: Unsent letters: a small wooden letter box half open, a stack of folded letters inside and scattered beside it, the paper yellowed and curling, some tied with string, some sealed with faded wax seals bearing only round motifs, all covered in dust.

extra.zh: 第 1 格半开的信匣与一叠信；第 2 格散落在桌角的几封信；第 3 格用细绳扎成一捆的信；第 4 格一封摊开、只有灰线的信与一支断笔。
extra.en: Cell 1: a half-open letter box with a stack of letters; cell 2: a few letters scattered on a table corner; cell 3: letters tied in a bundle with string; cell 4: one letter opened showing only grey lines, with a broken pen.

items.notes: 信纸上不写字，只有灰色短线；这是万户街的逻辑层物件外观。

subject.zh: 停在当时的饭桌：一张约 1.6 米长的木饭桌，桌上摆着几只碗碟、一只陶壶与半块干硬的面包，一把椅子被推开，桌面与碗里都落着厚厚的灰，像所有人突然起身离开。
subject.en: The table stopped in time: a wooden dining table about 1.6 m long set with a few bowls and plates, a clay jug and half a loaf gone hard, one chair pushed back, thick dust on the tabletop and in the bowls, as if everyone had suddenly stood up and left.

extra.zh: 第 1 格四人份摆好的饭桌；第 2 格两人份、一只碗倒扣的饭桌；第 3 格一把椅子翻倒在地的饭桌；第 4 格桌上点着一根蜡烛的饭桌（回放时的样子，蜡烛亮着）。
extra.en: Cell 1: a table set for four; cell 2: a table for two with one bowl upturned; cell 3: a table with a chair overturned on the floor; cell 4: a table with a lit candle (as seen in the replay).

items.notes: 安静、有生活感，不画任何骨骸；第 4 格的烛光只在烛芯。

subject.zh: 门巷里的方井：一口灰石砌的方形井，井圈齐腰高，四面各刻着一扇小门的浮雕，井上架着一副铁辘轳，绳早已断了，井沿放着一只倒扣的木桶。
subject.en: The square well of the door alleys: a square well of grey stone with a waist-high curb, each of its four sides carved with a little door in relief, an iron windlass over it whose rope has long since snapped, an upturned wooden bucket on the rim.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的方井；第 2 格井上盖着石板的方井；第 3 格一面浮雕碎掉的方井；第 4 格井沿挂着新绳与新桶的方井（有人修过）。
extra.en: Cell 1: the intact square well; cell 2: the well capped with a stone slab; cell 3: one relief side broken; cell 4: the well with a new rope and bucket (someone has repaired it).

items.notes: 浮雕小门是石色，不用门扉金；井口略带俯视。

subject.zh: 千门都核心的门框林：一座座立着的石与门铜门框，高矮不一，框里都是空的，门柱上刻着磨损的门形纹，表面蒙着黑灰，边角残缺，成片站着像一片没有叶子的树林。
subject.en: The doorframe forest at the core of the Thousand Gates: free-standing frames of stone and gatebronze of differing heights, all empty inside, worn door-shaped carving on their posts, coated in black ash, corners broken, standing in rows like a forest without leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格矮门框，约 2.5 米；第 2 格中等门框，约 3.5 米；第 3 格高门框，约 5 米；第 4 格最高的一座，约 6 米，门楣歪斜。
extra.en: Cell 1: a low frame about 2.5 m; cell 2: a medium frame about 3.5 m; cell 3: a tall frame about 5 m; cell 4: the tallest about 6 m with a tilted lintel.

items.notes: 简报写"五种高度"：四个变体加第 3 格水平翻转与缩放即可凑出五种；框内透出洋红背景；不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 无貌者一方的军旗：一根约 3.5 米高的黑铁旗杆，挂着一面灰黑长旗，旗面中央是一个空白的椭圆面形纹（没有五官），四周围着一圈锯齿状的暗边，旗尾烧焦。
subject.en: A banner of the Faceless One's side: a black iron pole about 3.5 m tall hung with a long grey black banner, a blank oval face shape in the center (no features), ringed by a jagged dark border, the tail scorched.

extra.zh: 第 1 格新立的军旗；第 2 格被风撕裂的军旗；第 3 格倒在地上的军旗；第 4 格被砍断旗杆、斜插在地里的军旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a newly raised banner; cell 2: a banner torn by wind; cell 3: a banner fallen on the ground; cell 4: a banner with its pole hacked through, stuck slantwise in the ground.

items.notes: 空白面形是唯一图案；整面旗只用灰黑与暗边，澱紫只能在边缘一线，面积极小。

subject.zh: 联军前哨：一段约 4 米宽的尖木桩栅围出的小营，栅内立着一顶方帐与一座小望台，栅门旁并排插着几面不同颜色的族旗，栅脚堆着补给箱与沙袋。
subject.en: A coalition outpost: a small camp enclosed by a sharpened stake palisade about 4 m wide, a square tent and a small lookout inside, several clan flags of different colors planted side by side by the gate, supply crates and sandbags piled at the foot of the palisade.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的前哨；第 2 格旗帜被换上新旗的前哨；第 3 格栅栏被冲破一段的前哨；第 4 格夜里望台火盆亮着的前哨。
extra.en: Cell 1: an intact outpost; cell 2: an outpost with fresh flags raised; cell 3: an outpost with a section of palisade broken through; cell 4: an outpost at night with the lookout brazier lit.

items.notes: 族旗只用纹章图形；第 4 格的火只在火盆里。

subject.zh: 主门坑的号令石：一块约 2 米高、顶面平整的深灰巨石，正面刻着一圈放射状的线纹，中心是一个手掌大的凹坑，石脚嵌着几道门铜箍，石面布满裂纹与灰。
subject.en: The command stone of the Main Gate Crater: a dark grey boulder about 2 m tall with a flat top, its front carved with a ring of radiating lines around a palm-sized hollow at the center, gatebronze bands set into its foot, the surface crazed with cracks and ash.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平时的号令石；第 2 格凹坑里放着一枚门石的号令石；第 3 格有人站上去后石面裂纹更深的号令石；第 4 格被灰暴半埋的号令石。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stone at rest; cell 2: with a gatestone set in the hollow; cell 3: with deeper cracks after someone has stood upon it; cell 4: half buried by an ash storm.

items.notes: 线纹是几何图案，不写字；门铜箍是暗青铜，不发光。

subject.zh: 嵌在主门断面上的剑尖：一段断裂的巨大门框石面，约 2.5 米宽，断面中央深深插着一截宽刃剑尖，剑尖周围的石面上放射着一圈烧蚀出来的白色光蚀纹，像被强光灼过。
subject.en: The sword tip lodged in the Main Gate's broken face: a section of the shattered gateframe stone about 2.5 m wide, a broad blade's tip driven deep into the center of the break, a ring of white radiating burn marks etched into the stone around it as if scorched by intense light.

extra.zh: 第 1 格剑尖完整嵌在石里；第 2 格剑尖周围被凿出一圈发掘痕；第 3 格剑尖已被取走、只剩一个剑形空洞与光蚀纹；第 4 格石面落满灰、只露出剑尖的一点寒光。
extra.en: Cell 1: the tip fully embedded in the stone; cell 2: an excavation groove chiseled around the tip; cell 3: the tip removed, only a blade-shaped hole and the burn marks left; cell 4: the face buried in ash with only a glint of the tip showing.

items.notes: 光蚀纹是灰白的烧痕，不是发光；剑尖是钢灰，不用金色。

subject.zh: 凿碑台上被凿毁的第六块碑：一块约 4 米高的灰石碑，碑面被整片凿平，只剩一道道凿痕与边框上残留的一角门形纹，碑顶断了一角，碑脚堆着凿下来的碎石。
subject.en: The sixth stele, defaced, on the Chiseled Stele Terrace: a grey stone stele about 4 m tall whose face has been chiseled flat across its whole surface, leaving only chisel scars and one corner of a door motif on the border, a corner of its top broken off, the chiseled chips heaped at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格凿平的碑面与碎石堆；第 2 格碑面上能看到更深的一道长凿痕；第 3 格碑身从中部裂开；第 4 格碑脚放着一束枯花与一盏熄灭的灯。
extra.en: Cell 1: the chiseled face and the heap of chips; cell 2: a deeper long gouge visible across the face; cell 3: the stele cracked through its middle; cell 4: a bunch of dead flowers and an unlit lamp at its foot.

items.notes: 碑面绝对不能出现任何可读的字或像字的笔画，只有凿痕；残留的门形纹是石色。

subject.zh: 战线旗标：一根约 1.8 米高的细木杆，顶上挂着一面三角形的醒目小旗，旗面是纯色加一道白色斜条，杆脚插在一小堆石块里，造型简单，远远一眼就能认出。
subject.en: A frontline marker: a slender wooden pole about 1.8 m tall with a bold triangular pennant at its top, the pennant a solid color with one white diagonal stripe, its foot set in a small pile of stones, simple in form and recognizable at a glance from far away.

extra.zh: 第 1 格红底白条旗；第 2 格蓝底白条旗；第 3 格黄底白条旗；第 4 格绿底白条旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: red with a white stripe; cell 2: blue with a white stripe; cell 3: yellow with a white stripe; cell 4: green with a white stripe.

items.notes: 可行动信息：不受画质档影响，四色区分战线段；旗色用沉一阶的布色，不用界面状态色（敌对、友方、中立、选中）那组纯色；轮廓要在 32 像素下清楚，不加多余装饰。

subject.zh: 候见厅的号码板：一块约 2 米宽、立在两根白石柱之间的白色木板，板面整齐排着几行空着的长方形插槽，每个插槽有一圈淡金细边，板顶是一条白石横檐。
subject.en: The number board of the Antechamber: a white wooden board about 2 m wide standing between two white stone posts, its face lined with neat rows of empty rectangular slots each edged in fine pale gold, a white stone cornice along its top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格插槽全空的号码板；第 2 格有几个插槽插着空白小牌的号码板；第 3 格最下一排一个插槽亮着淡金细光（只在槽边）；第 4 格板面落着一层光尘的号码板。
extra.en: Cell 1: all slots empty; cell 2: a few slots holding blank tiles; cell 3: one slot in the bottom row glowing with a thin pale gold line (only at its edge); cell 4: a fine layer of shining dust on the board.

items.notes: 号码由界面层绘制，素材里所有插槽与小牌都空白，不写任何数字。

subject.zh: 灵镜：一面约 2.2 米高的椭圆立镜，镜框是白石雕成的卷叶纹，镶着淡金细线，镜面是带一点银灰的柔光面，只映出模糊的白色光影，下面是一座三足白石底座。
subject.en: The spirit mirror: an oval standing mirror about 2.2 m tall, its frame white stone carved with curling leaves and inlaid with fine pale gold lines, the glass a soft silver grey glow showing only blurred white light, set on a three-footed white stone base.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平静的灵镜；第 2 格镜面泛起一圈细波纹；第 3 格镜面亮起一层暖白；第 4 格镜面覆着一层薄雾。
extra.en: Cell 1: the mirror at rest; cell 2: a ring of fine ripples across the glass; cell 3: the glass brightening to warm white; cell 4: a thin mist over the glass.

items.notes: 镜里不画任何人；外貌定制在界面里完成，这里只是镜子本身。

subject.zh: 面试厅的白色长桌：一张约 3 米长的纯白长桌，桌面平整，桌腿是简洁的方柱，桌面上整齐放着一叠白纸与一只白瓷水杯，整张桌子白得几乎与地面相融。
subject.en: The white long table of the interview hall: a pure white table about 3 m long with a flat top and plain square legs, a neat stack of white paper and a white porcelain cup on it, so white it nearly merges with the floor.

extra.zh: 第 1 格桌上一叠纸与一只杯；第 2 格空桌；第 3 格桌上纸页摊开（纸面空白）；第 4 格第六幕审庭用：桌面铺着一条淡金桌旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a stack of paper and a cup on it; cell 2: empty; cell 3: papers spread open (blank); cell 4: for the Act Six court: a pale gold runner laid along it.

items.notes: 用暖白分阶，靠浅灰描边显形；纸面空白；与空白层的长桌是不同的桌子。

subject.zh: 面试厅的白椅：一把约 1 米高的白色高背木椅，椅背是一整块弧形白板，椅面方正，四条细直腿，与面试厅里其他椅子一模一样。
subject.en: A white chair of the interview hall: a white high-backed wooden chair about 1 m tall, its back a single curved white panel, a square seat, four slender straight legs, exactly like every other chair in the hall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格摆正的椅子；第 2 格被稍稍拉出、斜着的椅子；第 3 格并排的两把；第 4 格空着、椅面上放着一张空白小牌的椅子。
extra.en: Cell 1: set straight; cell 2: pulled out slightly at an angle; cell 3: two side by side; cell 4: empty, a blank little card resting on the seat.

items.notes: 第六把椅子和别的椅子看起来完全一样，这是要点；不要加任何特别标记。

subject.zh: 门内庭院的门影：一座约 3 米高的独立石门框立在草地上，框里没有门板，门框石面刻着门形纹，纹路里透出门扉金 #f0d890 的微光，框内的空气微微发亮。
subject.en: The Door Shadow of the Inner Court: a free-standing stone doorframe about 3 m tall in the grass, with no leaf in it, door motifs carved on the frame and glowing faintly with door gold #f0d890 in their grooves, the air within the frame faintly shimmering.

extra.zh: 第 1 格门影：门纹亮着门扉金；第 2 格门影在白天，光较淡；第 3 格第四幕"从未开过的回廊"的门框：同样的门框，门纹暗着、框上落灰；第 4 格回廊门框的另一种：框里能看到更远处一列门框的淡影。
extra.en: Cell 1: the Door Shadow: motifs lit in door gold; cell 2: the Door Shadow by day, the glow fainter; cell 3: the never-opened corridor frame of Act Four: the same frame with dark motifs and dust on it; cell 4: another corridor frame: faint shadows of a row of farther frames visible within.

items.notes: 属于新装饰种类门框（doorframe），是进出庭院的唯一地标；门扉金只在刻纹里，框内"发亮"用浅暖白一两阶，不画光晕。

subject.zh: 审庭的庭之席：一把由门木长成的椅子，从白石地板的裂纹里长出来，木纹天然，椅背的纹理是一扇半开的门，新木色带一点暖金微光，约 1.2 米高。
subject.en: The Garden's Seat of the tribunal: a chair grown from door wood, rising out of a crack in the white stone floor, its grain natural, the grain of its back forming a half open door, fresh wood color with a faint warm gold glow, about 1.2 m tall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格：白石地板裂开一道细纹，纹里刚露出几节门木的嫩芽；第 2 格：门木一节一节往上长，长到半人高，已看得出椅子的形状；第 3 格：长成的椅子，椅背的木纹是一扇半开的门；第 4 格：同一把椅子，椅背的木纹里新长出一圈更亮的年轮。
extra.en: Cell 1: a fine crack opens in the white stone floor, a few buds of door wood just showing in it; cell 2: the door wood growing upward joint by joint to half a person's height, the shape of a chair already showing; cell 3: the finished chair, the grain of its back forming a half open door; cell 4: the same chair with a new, brighter growth ring in the grain of its back.

items.notes: 庭之席是箱庭自己的座位，由千门时代的门木长成：新木色带门扉金 #f0d890 的微光，不是白石高座，不刻任何神纹；四格依次是长出的过程与终局的年轮，由渲染层按剧情换格；座底的地板裂纹画到格底为止。

subject.zh: 审庭的证人台：一座齐胸高的白石半围栏台，三面围着刻卷叶纹的石栏，正面开口，台内铺着一块圆形白石，台角立着一根细柱，柱顶是一盏小金灯。
subject.en: The witness stand of the tribunal: a chest-high white stone half-enclosure railed on three sides with leaf-carved balustrades, open at the front, a round white stone underfoot inside, a slender post at one corner topped by a small gold lamp.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空着的证人台；第 2 格小金灯亮着的证人台；第 3 格台前铺着一条淡金长毯；第 4 格台栏上搭着一块白布。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stand empty; cell 2: its small gold lamp lit; cell 3: a long pale gold rug laid before it; cell 4: a white cloth draped over the rail.

items.notes: 不画证人；灯光只在灯罩里。

subject.zh: 审庭的证物台：一座齐腰高的白石方台，台面铺着一块深色绒布，四角立着四根细金柱撑起一个空的金框罩，证物放上去时由界面与特效呈现，台身刻着一圈细纹。
subject.en: The evidence stand of the tribunal: a waist-high square white stone table, its top spread with a dark velvet cloth, four slender gold posts at its corners holding up an empty gold frame canopy, items placed on it shown by the interface and effects, a band of fine carving around its body.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空的证物台；第 2 格台上放着一只合着的木匣；第 3 格台上放着一卷合着的卷轴；第 4 格台上放着一块碎石片。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stand empty; cell 2: a closed wooden box on it; cell 3: a closed scroll on it; cell 4: a broken stone fragment on it.

items.notes: 台上的物件都不写字；深色绒布用 #2a2438 一类的深色，不用澱紫。

subject.zh: 审庭中轴的庭镜：一面约 8 米高的巨大圆拱形镜，镜框是层层叠叠的白石与金线门形纹，镜面是深沉的银灰，映着模糊的白光，下面是一座三级白石基座，基座正面刻着一扇小门。
subject.en: The Court Mirror on the tribunal's axis: an enormous round-arched mirror about 8 m tall, its frame layer upon layer of white stone and gold-lined door motifs, the glass a deep silver grey reflecting blurred white light, set on a three-tiered white stone base with a small door carved on its front.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：镜子与基座居中正对镜头，镜面占画面大半；镜框的门形纹可以带极少量门扉金（庭镜也是下庭之门），镜里不画任何人与景。
extra.en: A single standee: mirror and base centered facing the camera, the glass filling most of the image; the frame's door motifs may carry a very little door gold (the mirror is also the door down to the world), no figures or scenes in the glass.

items.notes: 证据展示与"下庭门"的特效另出；镜面不画倒影。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡广场的刑台：一座约 4 米宽、齐胸高的石砌平台，四角是方石墩，正面一道石阶，台上立着一根粗木柱与一座木架，台沿围着低矮的铁链，石面颜色发暗。
subject.en: The execution stage of the Valenburg square: a stone platform about 4 m wide and chest high, square stone piers at its corners, a flight of steps in front, a thick wooden post and a wooden frame standing on it, a low iron chain around its edge, the stone darkened.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日空着的刑台；第 2 格台上围着黑布幔；第 3 格台前挤着围观用的木栅栏；第 4 格台上的木架被拆下、只剩石台。
extra.en: Cell 1: empty on an ordinary day; cell 2: hung with black cloth; cell 3: wooden barriers set up before it for the crowd; cell 4: the frame taken down, only the stone platform left.

items.notes: 不画任何刑具细节与血迹，只有柱与架；不画人。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡河港的木吊车：一座约 10 米高的木结构码头吊车，粗木塔身上伸出一根斜臂，臂端挂着滑轮与粗缆，缆下吊着一只装货的网兜，塔脚是一个人力踏车大木轮。
subject.en: The wooden harbor crane of Valenburg: a timber dock crane about 10 m tall, a slanting jib reaching from its heavy wooden tower, pulleys and a thick cable at the jib's end lifting a cargo net, a great wooden treadwheel at the tower's foot.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：塔身在画面左侧，斜臂伸向右上，货网吊在右侧半空；踏车大轮在塔脚正对镜头。
extra.en: A single standee: the tower at the left, the jib reaching up to the right, the cargo net hanging in midair on the right; the treadwheel at the tower's foot facing the camera.

items.notes: 码头上有两座，可水平翻转；不画水。

subject.zh: 门前渡的渡船：一条约 5 米长的平底宽渡船，船身是深褐木板，船中有一根撑篙与系在两岸绳索上的铁环，船舷上放着几只木箱与一只木桶，船头挂着一盏提灯。
subject.en: The ferry of Gatefront: a wide flat-bottomed boat about 5 m long, dark brown planked hull, a punting pole and iron rings for the rope stretched between the banks amidships, a few crates and a barrel along the gunwales, a lantern hung at the bow.

extra.zh: 第 1 格停靠的渡船；第 2 格载着货的渡船；第 3 格提灯亮着的夜渡船；第 4 格翻扣在岸上修补的渡船。
extra.en: Cell 1: moored; cell 2: carrying cargo; cell 3: at night with its lantern lit; cell 4: turned over on the bank for repair.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头、船头朝右；不画水面；提灯的光只在灯罩里。

subject.zh: 下城鱼摊：一张约 2.5 米宽、斜着的木摊台，台面铺着碎冰与湿麻布，摆着一排排银灰与青褐的河鱼、一筐虾与一只大鲤，摊顶撑着一片灰蓝帆布，摊边挂着一杆秤。
subject.en: A Lower Town fish stall: a slanted wooden counter about 2.5 m wide spread with crushed ice and wet sacking, rows of silver grey and olive brown river fish laid out with a basket of shrimp and a large carp, a grey blue canvas shade above, a steelyard hanging at the side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格摆满鱼的鱼摊；第 2 格只剩几条鱼的鱼摊；第 3 格收摊盖着帆布；第 4 格摊前放着两只装活鱼的木盆。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of fish; cell 2: only a few fish left; cell 3: closed under canvas; cell 4: two wooden tubs of live fish before it.

items.notes: 鱼是简单的梭形色块，不画写实鳞片；不写价签。

subject.zh: 公会沙环的围桩：一根约 1.2 米高的粗木桩，桩顶包铁，桩上穿着一根粗麻绳，绳子连到下一根桩，桩脚埋在一圈黄沙里，桩身被靠背与剑鞘磨得发亮。
subject.en: A ring post of the Guild's sand ring: a thick wooden post about 1.2 m tall with an iron cap, a heavy hemp rope running through it to the next post, its foot buried in a ring of yellow sand, its body polished by leaning backs and scabbards.

extra.zh: 第 1 格穿着绳的围桩；第 2 格绳上挂着一面小三角旗；第 3 格转角处的双绳围桩；第 4 格绳被解下的围桩。
extra.en: Cell 1: a post with rope through it; cell 2: a small pennant hung on the rope; cell 3: a corner post with two ropes; cell 4: a post with the rope taken off.

items.notes: 沙环是公会考核场；成排摆放围成一圈。

subject.zh: 灰鼠的粉笔记号：画在墙脚与石板地上的白色粉笔简笔记号，有圆圈、箭头、一只简笔的老鼠头与几道短划，大小约一个手掌到一臂，线条歪斜，有的被雨水冲淡。
subject.en: Greyrat chalk marks: simple white chalk signs drawn at the foot of walls and on flagstones: circles, arrows, a stick-drawn rat's head and a few short dashes, from a palm to an arm's length across, lines crooked, some washed faint by rain.

extra.zh: 第 1 格圆圈加箭头；第 2 格简笔鼠头；第 3 格三道短划与一个叉；第 4 格被冲淡的旧记号。
extra.en: Cell 1: a circle with an arrow; cell 2: a stick rat's head; cell 3: three dashes and a cross mark; cell 4: an old mark washed faint.

items.notes: 属于地面记号（ground_mark），代替路牌立牌；只画记号本身，像贴在地上与墙脚的贴花，略带俯视；记号是图形不是字母。

subject.zh: 码头缆桩：一根约 0.8 米高的粗矮铁桩，桩头向外翻卷，桩身缠着几圈湿漉漉的粗缆绳，桩脚嵌在码头石沿里，铁面有锈与盐痕。
subject.en: A dock bollard: a stout short iron post about 0.8 m tall with an outward-curling head, several turns of wet heavy rope wound about it, its foot set into the stone quay edge, rust and salt marks on the iron.

extra.zh: 第 1 格缠着缆的铁缆桩；第 2 格空缆桩；第 3 格木缆桩；第 4 格一对缆桩之间拉着缆。
extra.en: Cell 1: an iron bollard wound with rope; cell 2: an empty bollard; cell 3: a wooden bollard; cell 4: a rope stretched between a pair of bollards.

items.notes: 码头一线成排摆放。

subject.zh: 下城街垒车：一辆翻倒的四轮货车横在路上，车底朝外，车板上又钉了几块门板与木箱，车轮朝天，车前堆着麻袋，像一道临时的墙，约 3 米宽、2 米高。
subject.en: A Lower Town barricade cart: a four-wheeled wagon tipped over across the street, its underside facing out, doors and crates nailed onto its bed, wheels in the air, sacks piled before it like a makeshift wall, about 3 m wide and 2 m tall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格完整的街垒车；第 2 格钉着尖木桩的街垒车；第 3 格被冲开一个缺口的街垒车；第 4 格着火后焦黑的街垒车。
extra.en: Cell 1: an intact barricade; cell 2: bristling with sharpened stakes; cell 3: with a gap broken through; cell 4: charred after burning.

items.notes: 战场装饰，不放在战线上；不画人。

subject.zh: 喷澱的排水口：一个嵌在石沿下的方形铁栅排水口，约 1 米宽，铁栅被冲得扭曲，口里涌出一股带紫色细粒的灰雾，石面被染出一圈暗色污痕。
subject.en: A drain bursting with dian: a square iron-grated drain set beneath a stone curb, about 1 m wide, its grate twisted by the force, a grey fog flecked with fine purple motes welling out of it, a ring of dark stain spread across the stone.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚开始喷涌的排水口；第 2 格雾最浓的时候；第 3 格雾散去、只留污痕的排水口；第 4 格被木板与石块堵上的排水口。
extra.en: Cell 1: just starting to gush; cell 2: at its thickest; cell 3: the fog gone, only the stain left; cell 4: blocked with planks and stones.

items.notes: 澱紫只在雾里的细粒，雾本身是灰色；第 3、4 格不带紫色。

subject.zh: 王岛的七锁库门：一扇约 3 米高的厚重铁包木门，嵌在灰白石门框里，门板上横竖排着七把大小不一的铁锁，每把锁上方有一个不同的小纹章，门框顶刻着王冠石的纹。
subject.en: The seven-lock vault door of the Royal Isle: a massive iron-bound wooden door about 3 m tall set in a grey white stone frame, seven iron locks of different sizes arranged across its leaf, a different small emblem above each lock, the crown-stone emblem carved atop the frame.

extra.zh: 第 1 格七把锁都锁着；第 2 格开了三把锁；第 3 格七把锁都开、门微启；第 4 格门被强行撬开、锁散落。
extra.en: Cell 1: all seven locked; cell 2: three locks open; cell 3: all seven open, the door ajar; cell 4: forced open, locks scattered.

items.notes: 纹章与王冠石纹都是图形；铁色不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 长桌厅的三十人长桌：一段深色橡木长桌，桌面宽厚，铺着一条暗红桌旗，两侧摆着高背椅，桌上放着银烛台、酒杯与一排空着的座签，这一段约 4 米长，可以首尾相接成整张桌。
subject.en: The thirty-seat table of the Long Table Hall: a section of dark oak table with a broad thick top, a dark red runner laid along it, high-backed chairs on both sides, silver candlesticks, goblets and a row of blank place cards on it, this section about 4 m long and joinable end to end into the whole table.

extra.zh: 第 1 格桌子中段；第 2 格桌首（主座的高背椅更高）；第 3 格桌尾；第 4 格撤了餐具、只铺桌旗的中段。
extra.en: Cell 1: a middle section; cell 2: the head (the high seat taller); cell 3: the foot; cell 4: a middle section cleared of tableware, only the runner.

items.notes: 首尾两端能接中段；座签空白不写字。

subject.zh: 奥瑞恩的桥头门楼：一座约 9 米高的方形石门楼，下面是一条拱形门洞，门洞里挂着半升起的铁闸，上层有垛口与两扇小窗，楼顶是蓝灰石板瓦的四坡顶，墙上挂着两面旗。
subject.en: A bridge gatehouse of Orien: a square stone gatehouse about 9 m tall over an arched passage where a half-raised portcullis hangs, an upper story with crenellations and two small windows, a hipped roof of blue grey slate, two banners hung on the wall.

extra.zh: 单张立牌：门楼正对镜头，门洞居中，两侧各留出一小段桥栏起头，方便接到桥面。
extra.en: A single standee: the gatehouse facing the camera with the passage centered, a short start of bridge parapet on each side so it can join the deck.

items.notes: 南北两座桥头各一座，可共用；旗面只有纹章。

subject.zh: 奥瑞恩的债券告示板：一块约 2.5 米宽的木告示板，带小雨檐，板上贴满层层叠叠的告示纸，纸上只有灰色横线与红色印章圈，有的纸被撕掉一半，板脚堆着撕下来的纸。
subject.en: The debt notice board of Orien: a wooden notice board about 2.5 m wide with a small rain hood, layered thick with posted notices that bear only grey lines and red seal circles, some half torn away, torn paper heaped at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格贴满告示的板；第 2 格新贴一张大告示、盖住旧纸；第 3 格被撕得斑驳的板；第 4 格夜里板前挂着一盏提灯（亮着）。
extra.en: Cell 1: covered in notices; cell 2: a large new notice posted over the old ones; cell 3: torn into a patchwork; cell 4: a lantern lit before it at night.

items.notes: 纸上不写字，只有灰线与红印圈；不画看告示的人。

subject.zh: 起火的档案架：一座约 3 米高的木档案架，格子里塞满卷宗与书匣，架子的一半已经烧着，火舌从格子里窜出，纸页在火中卷曲飞起，架脚落着烧黑的碎纸。
subject.en: A burning archive shelf: a wooden archive rack about 3 m tall packed with files and book boxes, half the rack already alight, flames leaping from the compartments, pages curling and lifting in the fire, blackened scraps fallen at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格刚烧着一角；第 2 格烧着一半；第 3 格烧到顶、火最旺；第 4 格烧完的焦黑空架。
extra.en: Cell 1: just catching at one corner; cell 2: half ablaze; cell 3: burning to the top at its fiercest; cell 4: a burnt-out blackened frame.

items.notes: 朝阳门之夜全图最亮处；火用暖色硬边色块；卷宗不写字。

subject.zh: 河上小艇：一条约 4 米长的窄木艇，船身漆成暗绿，船头尖而翘，船里放着两支桨与一捆油布，船舷挂着一只小锚与一盏熄灭的提灯。
subject.en: A river skiff: a narrow wooden boat about 4 m long, its hull painted dark green, a sharp raised bow, two oars and a bundle of oilcloth inside, a small anchor and an unlit lantern hanging at the gunwale.

extra.zh: 第 1 格空艇；第 2 格装着几只木箱的艇；第 3 格盖着油布的艇；第 4 格提灯亮着的夜艇。
extra.en: Cell 1: empty; cell 2: carrying a few crates; cell 3: covered with oilcloth; cell 4: at night with its lantern lit.

items.notes: 侧面朝镜头、船头朝右；不画水。

subject.zh: 黑橡堡北门内的阵亡碑：一块约 3 米高的北境灰石碑，碑身宽厚，正面密密排着三百道短刻线（像名字的位置，但不可读），碑顶刻着北境军团的交叉长枪与山形纹，碑脚有一圈石栏。
subject.en: The war memorial inside Blackoak's north gate: a broad northern grey stone stele about 3 m tall, its face densely ranked with three hundred short incised lines (where names would be, but unreadable), the northern legion's crossed spears and mountain carved at its top, a ring of stone railing at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日的阵亡碑；第 2 格碑前摆着花环与蜡烛；第 3 格碑上覆着雪；第 4 格碑前插着一面北境军旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: the memorial as it stands; cell 2: wreaths and candles before it; cell 3: snow on the stele; cell 4: a northern banner planted before it.

items.notes: 史料 S11；短刻线绝不能成字，也不写年份数字。

subject.zh: 北境军团军旗：一根约 4 米高的黑木旗杆，顶上一枚铁矛尖，挂着一面深蓝方旗，旗面是银白的交叉长枪与一座三峰山形，旗边镶着灰白毛边，布面厚重不飘。
subject.en: A northern legion banner: a black wooden pole about 4 m tall with an iron spearhead, hanging a square dark blue banner bearing silver white crossed spears over a three-peaked mountain, edged with grey white fur, the heavy cloth hardly stirring.

extra.zh: 第 1 格新旗；第 2 格风雪里结了霜的旗；第 3 格破了一个洞的旗；第 4 格旗杆折断、斜插的旗。
extra.en: Cell 1: a new banner; cell 2: frosted in a snowstorm; cell 3: pierced with a hole; cell 4: its pole snapped, planted at a slant.

items.notes: 与旗厅冻在冰里的 909 年军旗是同一种纹章；不写字。

subject.zh: 军营兵器架：一座约 2 米宽、齐胸高的木架，上排横杆挂着几把长剑与斧，下排斜靠着一排长枪，架脚放着两面圆盾，木头被手磨得发亮。
subject.en: A barracks weapon rack: a wooden rack about 2 m wide and chest high, swords and axes hanging from its upper bar, a row of spears leaning in its lower slots, two round shields at its foot, the wood polished by hands.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满兵器的架子；第 2 格只剩长枪的架子；第 3 格空架；第 4 格倒下、兵器散落的架子。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of weapons; cell 2: only spears left; cell 3: empty; cell 4: knocked over, weapons scattered.

items.notes: 兵器只画通用轮廓。

subject.zh: 银鞍桥关卡的收费亭：一座约 3 米宽的小石亭，单坡石板瓦顶，正面开着一扇窗口与一张伸出的木台，台上放着一只铁钱箱与一杆秤，亭旁立着一根红白相间的横杆闸。
subject.en: The toll hut at the Silversaddle bridge checkpoint: a small stone booth about 3 m wide with a lean-to slate roof, a window in its front with a wooden counter jutting out bearing an iron cash box and a steelyard, a red and white striped barrier pole beside it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格横杆放下的收费亭；第 2 格横杆抬起；第 3 格窗口挂着一盏灯（亮着）；第 4 格关闭、窗口钉着木板。
extra.en: Cell 1: with the barrier lowered; cell 2: barrier raised; cell 3: a lamp lit at the window; cell 4: closed, the window boarded.

items.notes: 不画人；横杆的红白条是关卡的辨识点。

subject.zh: 碑庭的艾琉恩之碑：一块约 5 米高的白石主碑，碑身修长，碑顶是一枚镂空的大光轮，碑面刻着层层放射的光芒纹，中间一片平整的碑心没有任何字，碑座是三层白石台阶。
subject.en: Eluen's Stele in the Court of Steles: a tall white stone stele about 5 m high, slender, crowned by a large pierced halo wheel, its face carved with tier upon tier of radiating rays around a smooth central field bearing no writing at all, its base three white stone steps.

extra.zh: 第 1 格白天的碑；第 2 格碑前摆满蜡烛与白花；第 3 格碑顶光轮的镂空里透出暖金（只在镂空里）；第 4 格碑面有一道新的裂痕。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stele by day; cell 2: candles and white flowers heaped before it; cell 3: warm gold glowing through the pierced halo (only within the openwork); cell 4: a fresh crack across its face.

items.notes: 碑心不写字；光轮是暖金，不是神光白金；神迹光效另出。

subject.zh: 勇者院内的召唤阵：地面上一圈约 4 米宽的白石嵌金阵纹，由同心圆与六道放射线组成，阵纹的六个端点各立着一根齐腰高的白石阵眼柱，柱顶嵌着一颗圆晶。
subject.en: The summoning array of the Hero Academy: a ring of gold-inlaid white stone patterning about 4 m wide set into the floor, made of concentric circles and six radiating lines, a waist-high white stone focus pillar standing at each of the six line ends, a round crystal set in each pillar top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格阵纹暗着；第 2 格阵眼柱的圆晶亮起（只在晶内）；第 3 格阵纹被一道裂缝切断；第 4 格阵心放着一只空的白石台。
extra.en: Cell 1: the array dark; cell 2: the pillars' crystals lit (inside the crystals only); cell 3: the pattern cut by a crack; cell 4: an empty white stone table at the array's center.

items.notes: 画面略带俯视，看得见地面阵纹；阵纹是几何图形不写字；圆晶是清透的白，不用澱紫。

subject.zh: 露天钟架：两根白石柱架着一根橡木横梁，梁下并排吊着三口大小不一的青铜钟，钟身铸着一圈光芒纹，柱顶各雕一只小光轮，整体约 5 米高。
subject.en: An open-air bell frame: two white stone pillars carrying an oak crossbeam from which three bronze bells of different sizes hang side by side, a band of rays cast on each bell, a small halo wheel carved atop each pillar, about 5 m tall overall.

extra.zh: 第 1 格三口钟静止；第 2 格中间那口钟在摇响（倾斜）；第 3 格只有一口大钟的钟架；第 4 格一口钟被取下、绳空垂着。
extra.en: Cell 1: three bells at rest; cell 2: the middle bell ringing (tilted); cell 3: a frame with a single great bell; cell 4: one bell taken down, its rope hanging empty.

items.notes: 青铜用暖褐带绿锈，不用金色；七钟修院一带用。

subject.zh: 立式大香炉：一只约 2 米高的青铜香炉，三足圆腹，炉盖是镂空的穹顶，从镂空里飘出几缕细细的白烟，炉身刻着橄榄枝与光芒纹，立在一块白石垫上。
subject.en: A standing censer: a bronze censer about 2 m tall, three-legged with a round belly, its lid a pierced dome from which a few thin wisps of white smoke drift, olive branches and rays engraved on its body, standing on a white stone pad.

extra.zh: 第 1 格冒烟的香炉；第 2 格不冒烟的香炉；第 3 格一对中较矮的那只；第 4 格吊在铁链下的悬炉。
extra.en: Cell 1: smoking; cell 2: not smoking; cell 3: the shorter of a pair; cell 4: a censer hung on an iron chain.

items.notes: 烟只画两三缕硬边细烟；乳香来自崖乳香采集点。

subject.zh: 许愿蜡烛架：一只约 1.2 米高的铁架，分三层排着几十根细白蜡烛，烛泪在铁架上积成一层白蜡，架前放着一只投钱的小木箱。
subject.en: A votive candle rack: an iron stand about 1.2 m tall with three tiers holding dozens of slim white candles, wax drips built up into a white crust on the iron, a small wooden offering box before it.

extra.zh: 第 1 格与第 3 格是三层烛架的熄灭与点亮，第 2 格与第 4 格是圆形转台烛架的熄灭与点亮；点亮格只在灯罩、灯芯或炉膛里画暖色亮光，不画外溢的光晕。
extra.en: Cells 1 and 3 are the three-tier rack, unlit and lit; cells 2 and 4 are a round turning candle stand, unlit and lit; lit cells glow warm only inside the shade, wick or firebox, with no halo spilling outward.

items.notes: 点亮格只在烛芯画小火苗；投钱箱上不写字。

subject.zh: 圣水盆：一只齐腰高的白石圆盆，盆柱雕成一束交缠的橄榄枝，盆沿刻着一圈光芒纹，盆里是清水，水面映着一点天光，盆边放着一只小铜杓。
subject.en: A holy water font: a waist-high round white stone basin on a stem carved as a bundle of intertwined olive branches, a band of rays on its rim, clear water inside catching a little sky light, a small brass dipper at its edge.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛满水的圣水盆；第 2 格水只剩一半；第 3 格壁龛里的小圣水盆；第 4 格盆里漂着几片花瓣。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of water; cell 2: half full; cell 3: a small font in a wall niche; cell 4: a few petals floating in it.

items.notes: 水面只画浅色平面与一点高光，不发光。

subject.zh: 葡萄架：几根白石柱与木横杆搭成的约 3 米宽、2.5 米高的棚架，上面爬满葡萄藤，宽叶间挂着一串串紫红葡萄，架下投着斑驳的阴影。
subject.en: A vine trellis: a pergola about 3 m wide and 2.5 m tall of white stone posts and wooden crossbars, covered in grapevine, bunches of purple red grapes hanging among the broad leaves.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满葡萄的架；第 2 格只有绿叶的架；第 3 格秋天叶子转黄、葡萄已摘；第 4 格冬天只剩枯藤的架。
extra.en: Cell 1: heavy with grapes; cell 2: green leaves only; cell 3: autumn, leaves yellowing and grapes picked; cell 4: winter, bare dry vines.

items.notes: 葡萄的紫红偏红，避开澱紫；不画投影（模板规定）。

subject.zh: 石碾橄榄压榨机：一只圆形石槽里立着一只竖放的大石碾轮，碾轮中心穿着一根长木杆，石槽边有一道出油口接着陶罐，槽里堆着压碎的橄榄。
subject.en: A stone olive press: a round stone trough with a great millstone standing upright in it, a long wooden pole through the stone's center, a spout at the trough's edge draining into a clay jar, crushed olives heaped in the trough.

extra.zh: 第 1 格工作中的压榨机；第 2 格空槽；第 3 格碾轮倒在槽边；第 4 格旁边叠着压油用的草编垫。
extra.en: Cell 1: in use; cell 2: an empty trough; cell 3: the millstone toppled beside the trough; cell 4: woven pressing mats stacked beside it.

items.notes: 侧面略带俯视，看得见槽里的橄榄。

subject.zh: 帝都暗处的祭坛：一面约 4 米宽的赭石墙，墙上密密麻麻刻满短刻痕（像无数个名字的位置，但不可读），墙前一张石祭台，台上放着一柄断剑、一只铜碗与几支残烛。
subject.en: A hidden altar in the capital: an ochre stone wall about 4 m wide densely covered with short incised marks (like the places of countless names, but unreadable), a stone altar table before it bearing a broken sword, a bronze bowl and a few burnt-down candles.

extra.zh: 第 1 格烛台熄着的祭坛；第 2 格残烛点亮的祭坛（只在烛芯）；第 3 格台上摆满新献的断兵器；第 4 格墙上新添了一片刻痕。
extra.en: Cell 1: the altar with candles out; cell 2: the candle stubs lit (only at the wicks); cell 3: covered with newly offered broken weapons; cell 4: a fresh patch of marks added to the wall.

items.notes: 刻痕绝不能成字；断剑是瓦尔妲的意象，不写说明。

subject.zh: 无冠厅的空王座台：一座三级赭石台阶上的高台，台上放着一把宽大的石座，座背刻着一圈月桂，但座上没有王冠，也没有坐垫，座后的墙上留着一个曾挂过东西的空钩。
subject.en: The empty dais of the Crownless Hall: a raised platform on three ochre stone steps holding a broad stone throne whose back is carved with a ring of laurel, yet no crown rests on it and it has no cushion, an empty hook on the wall behind where something once hung.

extra.zh: 第 1 格宴会时的空王座台；第 2 格一剑问时只有一束光照在座上（光只在座面一块）；第 3 格座前插着一柄剑；第 4 格座上放着一顶铁月桂冠。
extra.en: Cell 1: the empty dais during a feast; cell 2: at the sword trial, a single beam on the seat (light only on a patch of the seat); cell 3: a sword planted before the throne; cell 4: an iron laurel crown set on the seat.

items.notes: 光束只是座面上一块亮色，不画光柱；不画人。

subject.zh: 铁钩座签架：一根约 2 米宽的铁横杆架在两根铁柱上，杆上一排铁钩挂着十几块小木座签，每块座签都是空白的，有的钩空着，有的座签被翻过来挂。
subject.en: An iron hook rack of name tags: an iron bar about 2 m wide on two iron posts, a row of iron hooks along it holding a dozen small wooden place tags, every tag blank, some hooks empty, some tags hung back to front.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满空白座签；第 2 格一半钩子空着；第 3 格座签全被摘下、散在地上；第 4 格一块座签被钉在架顶。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of blank tags; cell 2: half the hooks empty; cell 3: all the tags taken down and scattered; cell 4: one tag nailed to the top.

items.notes: 座签上的名字由界面绘制，素材里全部空白。

subject.zh: 无冠厅的宴会长桌：一段约 4 米长的深色硬木长桌，铺着赭红桌布，桌上摆着铜酒杯、烤肉盘、面包与成排的烛台，两侧是十二把高背椅中的几把，可以首尾相接。
subject.en: The feast table of the Crownless Hall: a section of dark hardwood table about 4 m long spread with an ochre red cloth, set with bronze cups, platters of roast meat, bread and rows of candlesticks, a few of the twelve high-backed chairs along its sides, joinable end to end.

extra.zh: 第 1 格摆满宴席的中段；第 2 格桌首（主位的椅子更高）；第 3 格宴后杯盘狼藉；第 4 格撤席、只留烛台。
extra.en: Cell 1: a middle section laid for the feast; cell 2: the head (the chief seat taller); cell 3: after the feast, cups and plates in disarray; cell 4: cleared, only the candlesticks left.

items.notes: 烛台点亮时只在烛芯有火；首尾能接中段。

subject.zh: 斯克里瓦学城的莫伊拉之碑：一块约 4.5 米高的灰石碑，碑形像一卷半展开的书卷，碑顶刻着一枚书卷纹，碑面是一行行整齐的刻线框格，格子里都是空的，碑脚堆着学生放的笔与纸。
subject.en: Moira's Stele in the scholars' city of Scriva: a grey stone stele about 4.5 m tall shaped like a half-unrolled scroll, a scroll sigil carved at its top, its face ruled in neat rows of incised boxes that are all empty, pens and papers left by students heaped at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格平日的碑；第 2 格碑脚堆满纸笔；第 3 格碑面一格里多了一道浅刻痕；第 4 格碑上积着薄雪。
extra.en: Cell 1: the stele as usual; cell 2: papers and pens heaped at its foot; cell 3: a faint new mark in one of the boxes; cell 4: a thin layer of snow on it.

items.notes: 框格里绝对不写字；纸上空白。

subject.zh: 学城的书肆货摊：一座约 2.8 米宽的木摊，青灰布棚下摆着几排斜放的书架，书一本本立着或摊开，书脊与书页没有字，摊边挂着一串卷轴与一盏油灯。
subject.en: A bookseller's stall of the academy city: a wooden stand about 2.8 m wide under a blue grey awning, a few slanted shelves of books standing upright or lying open, no lettering on any spine or page, a string of scrolls and an oil lamp hanging at its side.

extra.zh: 第 1 格摆满书的摊；第 2 格卷轴为主的摊；第 3 格收摊、书用油布盖着；第 4 格摊前放着一只装旧书的木箱。
extra.en: Cell 1: crowded with books; cell 2: mostly scrolls; cell 3: closed, the books under oilcloth; cell 4: a crate of old books before it.

items.notes: 书脊与书页一律不写字，只用色块与灰线。

subject.zh: 地下斗场的铁链桩：一根约 1.5 米高的粗铁桩，桩顶是一只铁环，环上系着一根垂到地上的粗铁链，链端是一只铁镣铐（空着），桩脚嵌在红砾地里，铁面锈红。
subject.en: An arena chain post of the undercroft: a thick iron post about 1.5 m tall topped by an iron ring with a heavy chain hanging to the ground, an empty iron shackle at the chain's end, its foot sunk in red gravel, the iron rusted red.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂着铁链的桩；第 2 格两根桩之间拉着铁链；第 3 格铁链被斩断的桩；第 4 格桩上缠着一条红布（挑战标记）。
extra.en: Cell 1: with its chain hanging; cell 2: a chain stretched between two posts; cell 3: with the chain cut; cell 4: a red cloth wound on it (a challenge mark).

items.notes: 镣铐空着，不画人。

subject.zh: 铁月桂冠：一顶用黑铁锻成的月桂叶冠，叶片锋利，放在一只齐腰高的赭石小台上，台面铺着一块暗红布，冠上有几处被打出的凹痕。
subject.en: The iron laurel crown: a wreath of laurel leaves forged from black iron, its leaves sharp-edged, resting on a waist-high ochre stone pedestal spread with a dark red cloth, a few dents hammered into the crown.

extra.zh: 第 1 格放在石台上的铁冠；第 2 格石台空着、只剩红布；第 3 格铁冠被挂在一柄插地的剑柄上；第 4 格两顶铁冠并排（历届）。
extra.en: Cell 1: the crown on its pedestal; cell 2: the pedestal empty, only the red cloth; cell 3: the crown hung on the hilt of a planted sword; cell 4: two crowns side by side (past champions).

items.notes: 黑铁色，不用金色。

subject.zh: "无名战士"木牌：一根齐胸高的木桩上钉着一块空白的长方木牌，木牌边缘被烧焦，桩上挂着一只破皮手套与一串小铁片，桩脚堆着红砾。
subject.en: A nameless fighter's tag: a blank rectangular wooden board nailed to a chest-high stake, its edges scorched, a torn leather glove and a string of small iron tags hanging on the stake, red gravel heaped at its foot.

extra.zh: 第 1 格单根木牌桩；第 2 格一排三根；第 3 格木牌被翻转、背面朝外；第 4 格桩上系着一束干花。
extra.en: Cell 1: a single tag stake; cell 2: a row of three; cell 3: the board turned back side out; cell 4: a bunch of dried flowers tied to the stake.

items.notes: 木牌永远空白，这就是"无名"；地下斗场与去红砾城的路上用。

subject.zh: 军团兵器架：一座约 2 米宽的赭漆木架，上排横挂着几柄短剑，中间立着一排长枪，下面靠着两面长方大盾，架顶钉着一块刻着连队记号的木板。
subject.en: A legion weapon rack: an ochre-painted wooden rack about 2 m wide, short swords hung across its upper bar, a row of spears standing in its middle, two tall rectangular shields leaning at its foot, a board carved with a company mark nailed at the top.

extra.zh: 第 1 格挂满兵器的架；第 2 格只有长枪；第 3 格空架；第 4 格架上挂着训练用的木剑。
extra.en: Cell 1: full of weapons; cell 2: only spears; cell 3: empty; cell 4: hung with wooden training swords.

items.notes: 与瓦伦城邑的兵器架区分：帝国式样是短剑与长方盾。

subject.zh: 石马槽：一只约 2.5 米长、到大腿高的长方赭石槽，槽里盛着水或草料，槽边磨出马嘴蹭过的凹痕，槽头立着一根拴马的石桩，石桩上挂着铁环。
subject.en: A stone horse trough: a rectangular ochre stone trough about 2.5 m long and thigh high, holding water or fodder, its rim worn hollow where horses have nuzzled, a stone hitching post at its head with an iron ring.

extra.zh: 第 1 格盛水的马槽；第 2 格盛着草料的马槽；第 3 格空槽；第 4 格一排两只马槽。
