extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。照片框是干净的空白矩形，玩家头像由引擎嵌入；卡面与挂绳上不画任何字、数字与标志。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The photo frame is a clean blank rectangle where the engine embeds the player portrait; no letters, numbers or logos on the card or the lanyard.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。照片框必须留空且边缘清楚，便于嵌入头像；这张工牌在第一幕落门时作为口袋里的遗物再次出现（art_prop_cut_wake_pocket 第 1 帧），外形要一致。

subject.zh: 一张皱巴巴的便利店小票和一颗没拆封的水果糖：小票是窄长的热敏纸，两头卷着边，纸上只有几行浅灰的细线；糖用透明糖纸包着，里面是一颗橙红色的硬糖，两头拧成小翅。
subject.en: A crumpled convenience store receipt and an unopened fruit candy: the receipt a narrow strip of thermal paper curling at both ends with only a few pale gray lines on it; the candy an orange red hard drop in clear wrapping twisted into little wings at both ends.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。小票与糖放在一起，像刚从口袋里掏出来；小票上只有灰线，不画任何字。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The receipt and the candy lie together as if just taken out of a pocket; only gray lines on the receipt, no writing.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。小票上不得出现可读的字与商标；第一幕落门时作为遗物再次出现（wake_pocket 第 2 帧）。

subject.zh: 医院的探视证与半盒薄荷糖：探视证是一张塑封的浅绿卡片，一角打孔穿着细绳，卡面只有色块与空框；旁边一只被捏扁的白色小纸盒，开口里露出几粒白色的薄荷糖。
subject.en: A hospital visitor pass and half a box of mints: the pass a laminated pale green card with a punched corner on a thin cord, only color blocks and empty frames on its face; beside it a small white paper box squeezed flat, a few white mints showing at its open end.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。探视证与纸盒上不画任何字与标志。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. No writing or logos on the pass or the box.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。纸盒要看得出被手捏扁过；第一幕落门时作为遗物再次出现（wake_pocket 第 3 帧）。

subject.zh: 一把老房子的铜色旧钥匙：齿口磨得发圆，钥匙柄上一圈铜锈，用一只小铁圈挂着一块褪色的浅黄塑料小牌，小牌边缘发白开裂。
subject.en: An old copper colored key to an old house: its teeth worn round, a ring of verdigris on the bow, hung by a small iron ring with a faded pale yellow plastic tag whose edges have whitened and cracked.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。塑料小牌上不写字。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Nothing written on the plastic tag.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。第一幕落门时作为遗物再次出现（wake_pocket 第 4 帧）；铜色偏暗，不要画成金钥匙。

subject.zh: 握在手里的一部智能手机：黑色窄边机身套着一只磨旧的透明壳，屏幕亮着一片空白的冷白光，握着它的手只露出拇指与几根手指，指节微微发红。
subject.en: A smartphone held in a hand: a black narrow-bezel body in a worn clear case, its screen lit with a blank cold white glow; only the thumb and a few fingers of the holding hand show, the knuckles slightly red.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。屏幕整片留空，消息、"发送中"的小圈与无信号的图标都由引擎叠加；机身上不画任何品牌标志。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Leave the whole screen blank; the message, the "sending" spinner and the no-signal icon are overlaid by the engine; no brand logo anywhere on the phone.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。屏幕必须是一块干净的亮面，便于叠加界面；与 art_prop_cut_phone_message 是同一部手机。

subject.zh: 纯黑里一只手握住另一只手的手腕：两只手都只露到腕上，握人的那只手指节修长、握得很稳，被握的那只手指张开；只有一圈极淡的暖金微光勾出两只手的轮廓。
subject.en: In pure black one hand grips the wrist of another: both hands shown only to the wrist, the gripping hand long fingered and steady, the held hand with its fingers spread; only a faint ring of warm gold glow traces their outlines.

No keys, rings, cuff patterns or any clothing or ornament that could identify whose hands these are.

subject.zh: 遗迹第六龛里的门形神纹：冷灰石壁上深深凿出一扇拱顶门的轮廓，凿痕很深却没凿干净，残留的纹线断断续续，凿痕缝里透出一点琥珀色的微光，龛沿积着灰与苔。
subject.en: The door-shaped divine sigil in the sixth niche of the ruins: the outline of an arched door cut deep into a cold gray stone wall, the chisel marks deep but unfinished so the lines break off here and there, a speck of amber light in the cracks, dust and moss on the niche rim.

subject.en: An old copper badge of the adventurers' guild: a small oval copper plate with the name rubbed away, the copper darkened with green patina, half a snapped leather cord through its hole with a blackened end, wedged between white bones and black feathers and catching a glint.

subject.zh: 灰里飘来的一页纸：一张又薄又脆的古纸，边缘烧得焦黄卷曲，纸面泛着灰白，正中只有一个由几道直线与弧线组成的几何字形，墨色很深。
subject.en: A page drifting out of the ash: a thin brittle sheet of old paper, its edges burned yellow brown and curling, the surface ash pale, at its center a single geometric glyph built from a few straight strokes and arcs in very dark ink.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。正中的字形是原创的几何图形，不得像任何现实文字或符号；除了它纸上没有别的字。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The glyph at the center is an original geometric figure that must not resemble any real script or symbol; apart from it there is no writing on the page.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。这是全部特写卡里唯一画进图里的字形，审核时确认它不像任何现实文字。

subject.en: The forbidding stele before the ruins' main gate: a white stone stele about two meters tall, its head carved with halo-like geometry, its polished face holding a few recessed blank text bands, behind it the rubble and broken beams that block the gate hall.

The readout slot is left blank for the engine; the crystal gives off no light at all.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。"不亮"是这张卡的重点，水晶里不要有任何光点。

subject.zh: 冒险者公会的公会卡：手掌大小的米白硬卡，外圈一道细木框，四边包着铜色边，左上角压着一枚交叉的剑与羽笔铜印，卡面嵌一小块透明水晶，水晶下是几栏空格。
subject.en: An adventurers' guild card: a palm-sized cream stiff card in a thin wooden frame with copper edging, a copper stamp of a crossed sword and quill pressed at the upper left, a small clear crystal set in its face with a few blank fields beneath it.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。新发的卡：木框与铜印都很新，栏位里只有淡淡的格线，等级与职能由引擎叠加。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. A newly issued card: the frame and stamp fresh, only faint grid lines in the fields; rank and vocation are overlaid by the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。与物品图标 art_ico_item_guild_card 同一种卡；栏位留空；之后三张公会卡特写以本张为参照。

subject.zh: 光之鉴的圣灯：一盏立灯，灯罩是半透的乳白瓷，灯座是黄铜铸的光环几何纹，灯罩里一朵小小的火焰，整盏灯立在一块白石台上。
subject.en: The holy lamp of the Lamp's Judgement: a standing lamp with a translucent milk white porcelain shade and a cast brass base worked in halo geometry, one small flame inside the shade, the lamp set on a white stone block.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧：灯焰又小又亮，带一点白金色，瓷罩透出柔光。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 1: the flame small and bright with a touch of white gold, the porcelain glowing softly.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_grey_lamp_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。第 2 帧的灰焰是本场的关键证据，灰色要明显，不能画成熄灭。

subject.zh: 光之鉴的圣灯：一盏立灯，灯罩是半透的乳白瓷，灯座是黄铜铸的光环几何纹，灯罩里一朵小小的火焰，整盏灯立在一块白石台上。
subject.en: The holy lamp of the Lamp's Judgement: a standing lamp with a translucent milk white porcelain shade and a cast brass base worked in halo geometry, one small flame inside the shade, the lamp set on a white stone block.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 2 帧：同一盏灯，灯焰转成灰色，像一缕不发光的烟，瓷罩跟着暗下来。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 2: the same lamp, the flame turned gray like a wisp of smoke that gives no light, the porcelain darkening with it.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。第 2 帧，共 2 帧：以 art_prop_cut_grey_lamp 为参照图生成，取景、物件大小与位置和第 1 帧完全一致，只改补充说明里写的变化。第 2 帧的灰焰是本场的关键证据，灰色要明显，不能画成熄灭。

subject.zh: 北泉的水瓶：一只粗玻璃瓶，瓶身厚而略带青色，瓶口塞着软木塞，瓶里的水微微浑浊，瓶底沉着一层灰白的细灰，玻璃里有几个小气泡。
subject.en: A bottle of North Spring water: a coarse glass bottle, thick and faintly green, stopped with a cork, the water inside slightly cloudy with a layer of pale gray ash settled at the bottom, a few small bubbles trapped in the glass.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。瓶底那层灰要看得清楚。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The layer of ash at the bottom must be clearly visible.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。玻璃用有限的色阶表现透明，不画平滑渐变；瓶上没有标签。

subject.zh: 五岁女孩摊开的小手心：手掌小而圆，掌心涂过的绿色草汁被洗掉了一半，残留成斑驳的淡绿，底下露出一个淡淡的门形纹，像一道浅金色的细线。
subject.en: The small open palm of a five-year-old girl: a little round hand, the green grass juice smeared on it half washed away into patchy pale green, and beneath it a faint door-shaped mark like a thin pale gold line.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画手掌与手腕，不画袖口；门形纹很淡。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Draw only the palm and wrist, no cuff; the door-shaped mark is faint.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。门形纹与 art_prop_cut_door_mark 同形，但更淡更小；手要明显是小孩的手。

subject.zh: 烛光下写好的周报：几张米白信纸叠在一起，纸面排着工整的灰色行线，一枚银色圣徽压着信角，信末的白色封蜡还没干透，泛着湿光，一截蜡烛的暖光照着纸面。
subject.en: A weekly report finished by candlelight: a few cream sheets stacked together with neat gray ruled lines, a silver holy emblem pressing one corner, the white wax seal at the end not yet dry and still glossy, the warm light of a candle stub falling across the paper.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。圣徽是光环纹样的小银章；行线工整，不画可读的字。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The emblem is a small silver badge with a halo motif; the ruled lines are neat with no readable writing.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。暖烛光只照亮纸面的一侧，封蜡的湿光是辨识点。

subject.zh: 澱巨像胸口嵌着的古石板：一块方形的冷灰石板，上面的纹样已经磨得认不出，只剩几道浅浅的弧线，石板边缘被灰白的灰壳与淡紫色的晶块包住，晶块缝里透着暗光。
subject.en: The ancient stone slab set in the dian colossus's chest: a square cold gray slab whose carvings have worn beyond recognition, only a few shallow arcs left, its edges wrapped in pale gray ash crust and pale purple crystal growths with a dim glow in their cracks.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画石板与紧贴它的一圈巨像躯体。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Draw only the slab and the ring of colossus body hugging it.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与首领三视图 art_boss_dian_colossus_ref 的胸口一致；弧线不能拼出任何可认的纹章。

subject.zh: 澱核：一颗悬在半空、比人头略大的灰紫色核，表面一层层细纹像在呼吸，微光一明一暗，四周飘着细小的灰尘与晶屑。
subject.en: A dian core: a gray purple core a little larger than a human head hanging in the air, its surface ringed with fine layers that seem to breathe, a faint light swelling and dimming, tiny dust and crystal flecks drifting around it.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。画微光最亮的一刻；核本身是实体，不是一团光。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Draw the moment the glow is brightest; the core itself is solid, not a ball of light.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。澱的颜色是灰紫，不用明亮的魔法紫；明暗变化由特效 art_vfx_cut_a1_core_glow 负责。

subject.zh: 地窖里打开的长木匣：一只旧木长匣掀开了盖，匣里垫着褪色的靛蓝粗布，布上躺着一把宽刃长刀，刀鞘的皮面磨得发白，刀柄缠着旧绳。
subject.en: A long wooden case opened in a cellar: an old wooden case with its lid raised, lined with faded indigo coarse cloth, on which lies a broad-bladed long sword in a scabbard whose leather has worn pale, its grip wrapped in old cord.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。俯视匣内，刀斜放在布上，地窖的光昏暗偏暖。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Looking down into the case, the sword lying diagonally on the cloth, the cellar light dim and warm.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。刀不出鞘、不发光；刀鞘与刀柄朴素，没有纹章。

subject.zh: 晨光里地面上的一道刀痕：夯实的土路上一道又长又直的切痕，边缘整整齐齐，像用尺子划出来，痕底露出新翻的深色泥土，两旁散着被斩断的草茎。
subject.en: A sword cut in the ground in morning light: a long perfectly straight gash across a packed dirt road, its edges clean as if ruled, fresh dark earth showing at its bottom, severed grass stems scattered on both sides.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。本张例外：地面就是主体的一部分，画一块略带俯视的方形地面切片，切片之外仍是洋红背景。刀痕从切片的一角斜贯到对角，笔直到不自然。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Exception for this card: the ground is part of the subject; draw a square slice of ground seen slightly from above, with the magenta background outside the slice. The cut runs diagonally from one corner of the slice to the other, unnaturally straight.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。晨光从左上方斜照，让切痕的边缘亮起一线。

subject.zh: 手背上的门纹：一只年轻人的手背，皮肤上浮着一个细线勾勒的门形，线条是偏白的暖金色 #f0d890，像淡金的墨迹渗在皮肤里，门形顶端是圆拱。
subject.en: The door mark on the back of a hand: the back of a young person's hand with a door shape drawn in fine lines on the skin, the lines a whitish warm gold #f0d890 like pale gold ink soaked into the skin, the top of the door shape a round arch.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧（浮现）：门形线条清楚发亮。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 1 (surfacing): the door-shaped lines clear and glowing.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_door_mark_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。玩家的手，按纸娃娃默认肤色画，不画袖口；门形与界面门纹标记 art_ico_marker_door_mark 同形。

subject.zh: 手背上的门纹：一只年轻人的手背，皮肤上浮着一个细线勾勒的门形，线条是偏白的暖金色 #f0d890，像淡金的墨迹渗在皮肤里，门形顶端是圆拱。
subject.en: The door mark on the back of a hand: the back of a young person's hand with a door shape drawn in fine lines on the skin, the lines a whitish warm gold #f0d890 like pale gold ink soaked into the skin, the top of the door shape a round arch.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 2 帧（隐没）：同一只手，线条淡到几乎看不见，只剩极浅的痕。

Frame 2 (fading): the same hand, the lines faded almost to nothing, only a very faint trace left.

subject.en: Yeyu's letter pouch: a flat old leather pouch in dark brown #6a4a30 with corners worn pale, its flap fastened by a brass clasp, its opening sealed with a dark red wax seal, the outline of seven stacked letters bulging the leather.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。信不露出来，只看得出鼓起的轮廓。

subject.zh: 边石背面磨平处的半个门形纹：一块风化的灰褐界石背面，有一小片被磨平的石面，上面浅浅刻着半个门形的轮廓，另一半被磨掉，晨光斜照让刻痕亮起一道。
subject.en: Half a door-shaped glyph on the smoothed back of the border stone: on the back of a weathered gray brown boundary stone a small patch has been ground flat, carrying a shallow outline of half a door shape, the other half worn away, slanting morning light making the groove flash.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画石面的局部；刻痕本身不发光，亮的是晨光。

subject.zh: 布伦的旧皮手套：一只左手的深棕色皮手套，指节处磨得发白起皱，指尖有几道修补的针脚，手腕系着一根皮绳，被随手扔在一张旧木柜台上。
subject.en: Brun's old leather glove: a dark brown left-hand leather glove, worn pale and wrinkled at the knuckles, mended stitches at the fingertips, a leather thong tied at the wrist, tossed carelessly on an old wooden counter.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。柜台木纹只露出手套周围的一小块。

subject.zh: 伯爵来信：一封厚实的奶白信纸，折痕笔挺，纸面排着书记处工整的灰色行线，信末压着一枚深蓝火漆，火漆上是城塔上立着一只展翅的鹰的纹章。
subject.en: The count's letter: a thick cream letter with crisp folds, neat gray ruled lines from the clerks' office across the page, a dark blue wax seal at its end stamped with a crest of a spread-winged eagle standing on a city tower.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。火漆纹章清楚，行线工整，不画可读的字。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The crest in the wax is clear; the ruled lines are neat with no readable writing.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。瓦伦边境伯爵府的纹章（城塔上的鹰）与伯爵印戒、封书一致。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡公会的大鉴定水晶：一块比人头还大的无色水晶立在雕花黄铜架上，架子正面有一块长条黄铜读数栏，水晶里有细密的切面，底座是一块深色石台。
subject.en: The great appraisal crystal of the Wallenburg guild: a clear crystal larger than a human head standing in a carved brass frame with a long brass readout bar on its front, fine facets inside the crystal, a dark stone pedestal beneath.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧（亮）：水晶亮起冷白的光，读数栏泛着光，栏内留空。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 1 (lit): the crystal glows cold white and the readout bar shines, left blank inside.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_exam_crystal_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。读数由引擎叠加；比第一幕柜台上的水晶大得多、架子更华丽。

subject.zh: 读数栏里浮出的残页：一张半透明的淡光纸页，上半页排着整齐的灰色行线，下半截一片空白，纸边像被撕过一样参差不齐，四周泛着水晶的冷白光。
subject.en: A torn page surfacing in the readout: a half translucent sheet of faint light, neat gray ruled lines across its upper half, the lower half blank, its edges ragged as if torn, rimmed with the crystal's cold white glow.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。纸页是光做的，边缘有细碎的光点；下半截的空白要明显。

subject.zh: 冒险者公会的公会卡：手掌大小的米白硬卡，外圈一道细木框，四边包着铜色边，左上角压着一枚交叉的剑与羽笔铜印，卡面嵌一小块透明水晶，水晶下是几栏空格。
subject.en: An adventurers' guild card: a palm-sized cream stiff card in a thin wooden frame with copper edging, a copper stamp of a crossed sword and quill pressed at the upper left, a small clear crystal set in its face with a few blank fields beneath it.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。瓦伦堡总部新发的卡：铜印更大更亮，木框漆成深色，栏位留空由引擎叠字。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. A new card from the Wallenburg headquarters: a bigger and brighter copper stamp, the frame lacquered dark, the fields left blank for the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。以 art_prop_cut_guild_card 为参照，卡型一致，只换总部的深色木框。

subject.zh: 船凳下油布裹着的一把普通铁剑：一块发黑的旧油布松松裹着剑身，露出一截朴素的铁剑柄与没有纹饰的十字护手，护手上有锈点，塞在湿漉漉的木船凳底下。
subject.en: An ordinary iron sword wrapped in oilcloth under a boat bench: a blackened old oilcloth loosely wound around the blade, showing a plain iron grip and an unadorned cross guard with rust spots, tucked under a wet wooden thwart.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。剑只露出柄与护手，剑身藏在油布里。

Only the grip and guard show; the blade stays hidden in the oilcloth.

subject.zh: 照规镜：一面手持的圆镜，银框上缠着细密的卷纹，镜面明亮冷白，镜柄是白银包着象牙白的握把，镜背刻满一圈圈细小的经文刻痕。
subject.en: The Mirror of Measure: a round hand mirror with a silver frame wound with fine scrollwork, its glass bright and cold white, its handle a silver-capped ivory white grip, its back engraved with ring after ring of tiny scripture grooves.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。四分之三角度，镜面与镜背的边沿都看得到；经文只是细密的刻痕，不成字。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. A three-quarter angle showing both the face and the rim of the back; the scripture is only fine grooves that form no letters.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与赛琳立绘里举的镜子是同一面；镜面不映出任何人。

subject.zh: 卷宗里比别的页都新的那一页：一叠泛黄卷边的旧纸用细绳装订，中间夹着一页雪白挺括的新纸，纸角锋利，行线也比别的页更黑。
subject.en: The one page newer than the rest in a dossier: a stack of yellowed dog-eared old sheets bound with thin cord, and among them one crisp snow white new page with sharp corners and darker ruled lines than the others.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。新旧纸色的对比是重点，新的那一页要一眼看出来。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The contrast of old and new paper is the point; the new page must stand out at a glance.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。行线不可读；不画装订以外的封皮文字。

subject.zh: 慢性毒药的证物：一只粗陶药碗，碗里是干了的褐色药渣，碗底积着一层闪着微光的灰白晶粉，碗边摊着一本账簿，其中一行被指甲划了一道。
subject.en: Evidence of a slow poison: a coarse earthenware medicine bowl with dried brown dregs, a layer of faintly glittering gray white crystal powder settled at its bottom, beside it an open account book with one line scored by a fingernail.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。账簿上只画灰色行线，被划的那一行由引擎叠字。

subject.zh: 伯爵印戒：一枚粗厚的金戒，椭圆形深蓝宝石戒面上阴刻着城塔上展翅的鹰，戒圈两肩各雕一片橡叶，戒圈内侧凸起一道小齿，像钥匙的齿。
subject.en: The count's signet ring: a heavy gold ring, its oval dark blue gem face intaglio-cut with a spread-winged eagle on a city tower, an oak leaf carved on each shoulder, and a small raised tooth on the inside of the band like the bit of a key.

subject.zh: 灰烬边境的封书：一卷宽幅厚羊皮纸展开，上方压着一枚瓦伦伯爵府的深蓝火漆印（城塔上的鹰），纸面是庄重的浓黑行线，右下角垂着一条暗红丝绦。
subject.en: The writ for the Ashen Border: a wide roll of heavy parchment unrolled, a dark blue wax seal of the Valen count's house (an eagle on a tower) at its top, solemn dense black ruled lines across it, a dark red silk ribbon hanging from the lower right.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。第 2 帧（代管文书版）：同一卷封书，丝绦下没有铜章，火漆旁多盖一枚小一点的灰色印。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. Frame 2 (stewardship version): the same writ with no medal on the ribbon, and a smaller gray seal stamped beside the wax.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。第 2 帧，共 2 帧：以 art_prop_cut_barony_writ 为参照图生成，取景、物件大小与位置和第 1 帧完全一致，只改补充说明里写的变化。两帧按城下潮的结局择一使用；正文由引擎叠加。

subject.zh: 一封旧信：米黄厚信纸叠成三折，折痕发软，纸边微微泛黄，封口压着一枚暗红火漆，火漆边缘像化开过一样淌下一道，纸面只有浅灰的行线。
subject.en: An old letter: heavy cream paper folded in three, the folds softened, the edges faintly yellowed, the closure pressed with a dark red wax seal whose edge has run down in one drip as if it had melted, only pale gray ruled lines on the page.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。第一封信：火漆化开顺着信纸淌下一道，信纸半展开，抬头一行留给引擎叠字。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The first letter: the wax has melted and run down the paper in one drip, the letter half unfolded, the heading line left for the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。七封信同一套构图，之后各封以本张为参照；信纸上只有行线。

subject.zh: 冒险者公会的公会卡：手掌大小的米白硬卡，外圈一道细木框，四边包着铜色边，左上角压着一枚交叉的剑与羽笔铜印，卡面嵌一小块透明水晶，水晶下是几栏空格。
subject.en: An adventurers' guild card: a palm-sized cream stiff card in a thin wooden frame with copper edging, a copper stamp of a crossed sword and quill pressed at the upper left, a small clear crystal set in its face with a few blank fields beneath it.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。用旧了的卡：木框磨圆，下面一栏的底色更白，像新填过，一旁有一道手画的细线；栏内文字由引擎叠加。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. A well-used card: the frame worn round, the lower field paler as if newly filled in, a thin hand-drawn line beside it; the field text is overlaid by the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。以 art_prop_cut_guild_card 为参照，同一张卡用旧了。

subject.zh: 熄灭的盾：一面高大的塔盾斜插在泥里，盾面浮雕着一圈光环，盾沿与盾面满是新的剑痕与凹坑，盾脚沾着黑泥与折断的苇秆。
subject.en: The extinguished shield: a tall tower shield standing slanted in the mud, a ring of halo relief on its face, its rim and face full of fresh sword cuts and dents, black mud and broken reed stalks at its foot.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧（亮）：光环浮雕亮着白金色的光。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 1 (lit): the halo relief glows white gold.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_dark_shield_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。盾脚插进泥里的部分画到切片底部为止；第 2 帧不要有任何光点。

subject.zh: 熄灭的盾：一面高大的塔盾斜插在泥里，盾面浮雕着一圈光环，盾沿与盾面满是新的剑痕与凹坑，盾脚沾着黑泥与折断的苇秆。
subject.en: The extinguished shield: a tall tower shield standing slanted in the mud, a ring of halo relief on its face, its rim and face full of fresh sword cuts and dents, black mud and broken reed stalks at its foot.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 2 帧（暗）：同一面盾，光环刚刚暗下，只剩冷灰的金属。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 2 (dark): the same shield, the halo just gone dark, only cold gray metal left.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。第 2 帧，共 2 帧：以 art_prop_cut_dark_shield 为参照图生成，取景、物件大小与位置和第 1 帧完全一致，只改补充说明里写的变化。盾脚插进泥里的部分画到切片底部为止；第 2 帧不要有任何光点。

subject.zh: 结衣的手写笔记本：一本软皮小笔记本摊开，封面是浅粉色布面，边角磨毛，新的一页正中画着一条竖直的铅笔线，把纸分成左右两栏，两栏顶端各留一处标题位置。
subject.en: Yui's handwritten notebook: a small soft-cover notebook lying open with a pale pink cloth cover and frayed corners, a straight vertical pencil line down the middle of the new page dividing it into two columns, each with a place for a heading at the top.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。封面的标题与两栏标题都由引擎叠字；左栏有几行浅灰行线，右栏空着。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The cover title and both column headings are overlaid by the engine; a few pale gray lines in the left column, the right one empty.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。笔记本是地球带来的普通本子，不加奇幻纹样。

subject.zh: 炭笔写满名字的几页纸：几张粗糙的灰白纸叠在一起，纸面密密麻麻是炭笔的黑色短行，手指抹过的地方糊成灰，一截炭笔断成两段搁在纸上。
subject.en: Pages filled with names in charcoal: a few rough gray white sheets stacked together, crowded with short black charcoal lines, smudged to gray where fingers brushed them, a stick of charcoal snapped in two lying on top.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。炭笔短行是不可读的笔画。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The charcoal lines are unreadable strokes.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。断成两截的炭笔是这张卡的重点。

subject.zh: 一座被凿毁的天启碑：高大的灰白碑面上原本的字全被凿掉，凿痕一道压一道，深得像要凿穿石头，碑边崩落了几块，碑脚堆着碎石屑。
subject.en: A defaced Apocalypse Stele: on its tall gray white face all the original writing has been chiseled away, the marks laid one over another so deep they seem about to break through the stone, a few chunks broken from its edges, stone chips heaped at its foot.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画碑面与碑脚，凿痕里不留任何可辨的字形。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Draw only the face and foot of the stele; no recognizable letterform survives in the chisel marks.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。凿痕的愤怒感要强，像反复凿过很多遍。

subject.zh: 坑沿一座残门框的断面：一截断裂的古石门框横在灰里，断面粗糙发黑，断面中间嵌着一点极小的金属，反出一星冷亮的光。
subject.en: The broken face of a ruined door frame on the crater rim: a snapped length of ancient stone door frame lying in the ash, its fracture rough and blackened, a tiny piece of metal set in the middle of the break throwing back one cold bright glint.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。那一星反光很小，但要是画面里最亮的一点。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The glint is tiny but must be the brightest point in the frame.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。不解释那块金属是什么，不画成钥匙或任何可认的形状。

subject.zh: 千门书库的铭环：一只半人高的厚铜环立在石座上，环面密密刻满极小的刻痕，铜色暗金，空中飘落的灰碰到环面便滑开，环面始终干净。
subject.en: The record ring of the Thousand Gates Archive: a thick copper ring half a person tall standing on a stone base, its surface densely engraved with tiny marks, dark gold in color; ash drifting down slides away when it touches the ring, so the ring stays clean.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。画几片正在滑落的灰，环面不沾一点灰。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Show a few flakes of ash sliding off; not a speck of ash clings to the ring.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。刻痕不成字。

subject.zh: 从灰里抽出的一页烧边残卷：一张焦黄的古纸，四边烧得焦黑卷曲，纸面沾着灰，中间几行深色墨迹却依然完整，排得整整齐齐。
subject.en: A burn-edged fragment pulled from the ash: a scorched yellow old sheet, all four edges burned black and curling, ash clinging to it, yet several lines of dark ink in the middle remain whole and neatly aligned.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。墨迹是不可读的整齐墨行，字由引擎叠加。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The ink is neat unreadable lines; the words are overlaid by the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。烧焦的边与完整的墨行对比是重点。

subject.zh: 冠石印：一方灰绿细石雕成的王国印玺，侧面一圈回纹，印钮是一顶王冠，冠尖镶一圈金边，端放在一只衬着深红丝绒的乌木匣里，匣上一把小铜锁。
subject.en: The Crownstone Seal: a square royal seal carved from fine gray green stone with a fret band around its sides, its knob a crown with a gold rim along the points, resting in an ebony box lined with deep red velvet, a small brass lock on the box.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。画匣盖正要合上、锁扣将要扣下的一刻。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Show the moment the lid is about to close and the lock about to snap shut.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与任务道具图标 art_ico_item_rl_crownstone_seal 是同一方印。

subject.zh: 落在寝殿石板上的王冠：一顶金色的王冠侧翻在冷灰石板地上，冠尖一处磕弯了，几颗红宝石映着烛光，旁边一道厚帘幕被夜风掀起一角。
subject.en: A crown fallen on the stone floor of a bedchamber: a gold crown tipped on its side on cold gray flagstones, one point bent from the fall, a few rubies catching the candlelight, the corner of a heavy curtain beside it lifted by the night wind.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。本张例外：地面就是主体的一部分，画一块略带俯视的方形地面切片，切片之外仍是洋红背景。帘幕只露出被掀起的下摆一角。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Exception for this card: the ground is part of the subject; draw a square slice of ground seen slightly from above, with the magenta background outside the slice. Only the lifted lower corner of the curtain shows.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。不画人与手；烛光暖、石板冷。

subject.zh: 奥丽芙的记录簿：一本皮面厚记录簿摊开，左页写满整齐的浅灰行线，右页整页空着，只在正中留一个字的位置，页边夹着一条暗绿书签带。
subject.en: Olive's record book: a thick leather-bound record book lying open, the left page full of neat pale gray ruled lines, the right page blank but for room for one character at its center, a dark green ribbon marker at the edge.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。右页正中那一个字由引擎叠加，图里不画。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The single character at the center of the right page is overlaid by the engine and not drawn.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。右页的空白要大而干净，不画注释。

subject.zh: 北境回信：一张粗硬的灰褐厚纸，没有信封，捆过麻绳的折痕还在，纸面正中只留两个大字的位置，边角沾着一点雪水的湿痕。
subject.en: The reply from the north: a stiff coarse gray brown sheet with no envelope, still creased where a hemp cord tied it, only room for two large characters at the center, a damp stain of snow water at one corner.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。两个大字由引擎叠加；纸面其余部分空白。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The two large characters are overlaid by the engine; the rest of the sheet is blank.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。纸要粗糙结实，像北境的军用纸。

subject.zh: 石桥栏上搭着的红披风：一条深红色的长披风随手搭在灰石桥栏上，下摆垂下来被风吹动，边缘烧焦了一截，领口的金色扣环空着。
subject.en: A red cloak draped over a stone bridge rail: a long deep red cloak thrown over a gray stone rail, its hem hanging and stirring in the wind, a stretch of its edge scorched, the gold clasp at the collar hanging open.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画桥栏的一段与披风。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Draw only a length of the rail and the cloak.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与陆辰立绘的红披风同色。

subject.zh: 桥头立起的名字板：一块新钉的宽木板立在桥头，板面用炭笔与刀刻写满一行行名字的笔画，木刺还没磨平，板脚压着几块石头，一个人的影子斜斜落在板上。
subject.en: The board of names raised at the bridgehead: a newly nailed wide wooden board standing at the bridgehead, its face filled with rows of name strokes in charcoal and knife cuts, splinters not yet smoothed, a few stones holding its foot, the shadow of a person falling slantwise across it.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。名字笔画不成字；只画影子，不画人。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The name strokes form no readable words; draw only the shadow, not the person.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。念名字的人由过场的立绘与立牌出演，卡上只画她落在板上的影子。

subject.zh: 誓光之门：一扇厚重的单扇门，门板像一整片锁子甲，铁环细密相扣，正中嵌着一面圆盾，盾面光滑空白，没有任何神纹，门缝透出一线暖白的光。
subject.en: The Door of the Vowed Light: a heavy single door whose leaf looks like one sheet of chain mail, fine iron rings tightly linked, a round shield set at its center with a smooth blank face bearing no divine sigil, a line of warm white light at its seam.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。盾面一定是空白的。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The face of the shield must be blank.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。门框是千门回廊的深灰石；锁子甲的铁环要细密整齐。

subject.zh: 一封旧信：米黄厚信纸叠成三折，折痕发软，纸边微微泛黄，封口压着一枚暗红火漆，火漆边缘像化开过一样淌下一道，纸面只有浅灰的行线。
subject.en: An old letter: heavy cream paper folded in three, the folds softened, the edges faintly yellowed, the closure pressed with a dark red wax seal whose edge has run down in one drip as if it had melted, only pale gray ruled lines on the page.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。第二封信，第 1 帧（封）：信还折着，火漆完整。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The second letter, frame 1 (sealed): still folded, the wax whole.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_letter2_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。以 art_prop_cut_barony_letter 为参照，构图一致；文字由引擎叠加。

subject.zh: 一封旧信：米黄厚信纸叠成三折，折痕发软，纸边微微泛黄，封口压着一枚暗红火漆，火漆边缘像化开过一样淌下一道，纸面只有浅灰的行线。
subject.en: An old letter: heavy cream paper folded in three, the folds softened, the edges faintly yellowed, the closure pressed with a dark red wax seal whose edge has run down in one drip as if it had melted, only pale gray ruled lines on the page.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。第 2 帧（开）：火漆化开，信纸展开，收件人与两句正文的位置只有行线。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. Frame 2 (open): the wax melted, the letter unfolded, only ruled lines where the addressee and the two sentences go.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。第 2 帧，共 2 帧：以 art_prop_cut_letter2 为参照图生成，取景、物件大小与位置和第 1 帧完全一致，只改补充说明里写的变化。以 art_prop_cut_barony_letter 为参照，构图一致；文字由引擎叠加。

subject.zh: 苇桥桥头的光蚀纹：烧黑的石板地上蚀出一圈齿轮般的白痕，痕边焦黑发亮，旁边曙光圣柱的白石柱身上，从下往上裂开一道烧黑的裂纹。
subject.en: The light-burn at the Reedbridge bridgehead: on scorched black paving a ring of gear-like white marks is etched into the stone, its rims charred and glossy, and on the white stone shaft of the Dawn Pillar beside it a blackened crack runs upward.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。本张例外：地面就是主体的一部分，画一块略带俯视的方形地面切片，切片之外仍是洋红背景。柱身只露出底部一段，裂纹从柱脚往上走。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Exception for this card: the ground is part of the subject; draw a square slice of ground seen slightly from above, with the magenta background outside the slice. Only the bottom of the pillar shaft shows, the crack climbing from its foot.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。齿轮般的白痕与特效 art_vfx_cut_gear_shadow 同形。

subject.zh: 长桌上的三顶王冠：一张铺着深色桌布的长桌上并排放着三顶王冠，一顶帝国式的暗金高冠镶着紫晶，一顶教会式的白金冠，一顶北境黑铁打的粗冠，桌边的椅子一把挨一把，没有空位。
subject.en: Three crowns on a long table: three crowns side by side on a long table with a dark cloth, a tall dark gold imperial crown set with amethysts, a white and gold church crown, and a rough crown hammered from northern black iron, the chairs pressed close all around with no empty place.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。不画人，只画桌面、王冠与椅背。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. No people; only the tabletop, the crowns and the chair backs.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。"没有空位"是重点，椅子要排满。

subject.zh: 千门回廊尽头一扇门的影子：幽暗里一扇门只看得见影子般的轮廓，门楣上没有任何图案，只刻着一块空白的小界碑，门缝的暖光把轮廓的边拉得很长。
subject.en: The shadow of a door at the end of the Corridor of a Thousand Doors: in the gloom a door shows only as a shadowy outline, its lintel bearing no emblem but a small blank boundary stone carved there, the warm light at its seam stretching the outline's edge.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。界碑是空白的；门本身不开。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The boundary stone is blank; the door itself stays shut.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。这是立国之门的预示，门形朴素，不画国徽。

subject.zh: 冒险者公会的公会卡：手掌大小的米白硬卡，外圈一道细木框，四边包着铜色边，左上角压着一枚交叉的剑与羽笔铜印，卡面嵌一小块透明水晶，水晶下是几栏空格。
subject.en: An adventurers' guild card: a palm-sized cream stiff card in a thin wooden frame with copper edging, a copper stamp of a crossed sword and quill pressed at the upper left, a small clear crystal set in its face with a few blank fields beneath it.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。同一张底卡用了很久：木框磨得发亮，旧栏之下新添了一栏，底色是刚刷过的白，栏内文字由引擎叠加。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The same base card after long use: the frame worn glossy, a new field added beneath the old ones, its ground freshly whitened; the field text is overlaid by the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。以 art_prop_cut_guild_card 为参照，同一张卡；新添的那一栏是辨识点。

subject.zh: 遗迹前垒起的故乡石：一小堆形状各异的石头垒在一起，有圆滑的河滩石、井沿的方石、一块黑石、一截刻着星图的残碑、一块草原的扁石和一只铸坏的铁秤砣。
subject.en: Home stones piled before the ruins: a small cairn of very different stones, a smooth river pebble, a square stone from a well rim, a black stone, a broken stele fragment carved with a star chart, a flat stone from the grasslands and a miscast iron counterweight.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。六样东西都要分得清，垒成一个不太稳的小堆。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. All six things must be distinguishable, stacked into a slightly unsteady little cairn.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。星图残碑上只刻点与线，不刻字。

subject.zh: 人簿的第一页：一本新装订的厚册子摊开在第一页，纸是干净的米白，页面没有等级与职能的格栏，只有正中一道用尺子画出的细墨横线。
subject.en: The first page of the People's Register: a newly bound thick book open at its first page, clean cream paper, no columns for rank or vocation, only one fine ink line drawn straight across the middle with a ruler.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。除了那一道横线，页面一片空白。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. Apart from that one line, the page is blank.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。第五幕救赎一场沿用这张卡；横线要笔直。

subject.zh: 剑帝的请柬：一张深紫色的厚卡纸，边上压着一圈暗银细线，没有称谓，没有落款，正中只留一行字的位置，卡角封着一枚黑铁色的小火漆。
subject.en: The Sword Emperor's invitation: a heavy card of deep purple stock edged with a thin dark silver line, no salutation and no signature, room for a single line at the center, a small iron black wax seal at one corner.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。那一行字由引擎叠加，卡面其余部分空着。

The single line is overlaid by the engine; the rest of the card is empty.

subject.zh: 无冠厅门口的铁钩：赭红石墙上钉着一排粗黑的铁钩，钩身打得简单结实，离门最近的那一只钩上挂着东西，钩尖磨得发亮。
subject.en: The iron hooks at the door of the Crownless Hall: a row of thick black iron hooks driven into an ochre red stone wall, forged simply and solidly, the one nearest the door with something hanging on it, its tip worn shiny.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧：钩上挂着一顶帝国式的暗金高冠，冠尖之间镶着紫晶。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. subject.en: Hart's contract: a long contract sheet densely written, rows of tiny gray lines across it, one block of fine print near the bottom pinned firmly under a fingertip wearing a gold ring, a gold wax seal on the corner.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。只画一根手指与指上的金戒，不画手腕以上。

subject.zh: 深账库里的钥匙环：一只粗铁环下压着一本厚账册的书脊，环上挂着古钥匙，有木柄、焦铜柄、银白柄、缠草绳的骨柄、黑铁月牙柄、刻字的青铜柄，以及一枚没有齿的钥匙。
subject.en: The key ring in the Deep Ledger Vault: a thick iron ring with the spine of a heavy ledger pinned beneath it, hung with ancient keys, with wooden, scorched copper and silver white bows, a bone bow wound with grass cord, a black iron crescent bow, an engraved bronze bow, and one key with no teeth.

subject.en: A key with no teeth: an old dark iron key, its shaft bare without a single tooth, its bow pierced by a door-shaped opening worn bright at the edges, fine ash settled on the shaft.

subject.en: Names carved all over the altar walls: a dark reddish brown stone wall densely carved with rows of name strokes, the carving styles of several peoples side by side, some square and angular, some round and flowing, some like claw marks, the newest still edged with stone chips.

subject.en: A page of Moira's book lying open: a cream page of an ancient great book carrying map-like line drawings in fine ink, the tip of an inked quill resting beside the lines, a thin gilt border along the page edge.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。第 1 帧（边石镇那一页）：小镇的线描平面图，六处地点各画一个小圆圈，其中五处旁边留着写名字的空白，孤儿院旁画着一扇小门。

subject.en: The copy of the Blank Chronicle: eleven thin sheets tied into a sheaf with fine string, topped by one older page tied with red cord, together a very slim little volume with neat edges, resting on a very long wooden table.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。细绳与红绳要分得清，纸面空白。

subject.en: The papal edict: an unrolled scroll of heavy white parchment with gilt-capped wooden rods at top and bottom, a large seal shaped like a white crown at its head, a solemn gold border and dense black ruled lines across it.

subject.zh: 审判庭的铁匣：一只巴掌长的黑铁小匣打开着，匣口残留着被揭开的朱漆封，匣里平躺着一张极薄的白纸，纸上只有一行字的位置。
subject.en: The tribunal's iron box: a palm-long black iron casket lying open, the remnants of a broken vermilion lacquer seal around its lid, a single very thin white sheet lying flat inside with room for only one line.

subject.zh: 天启碑的碑面：一块巨大的灰白古碑近到只看得见碑面，石面布满风化的细纹，正中横排着五个字的刻槽位置，白光正从刻槽里透出来，照亮碑面上的雪粒。
subject.en: The face of an Apocalypse Stele: a huge gray white ancient stele seen so close that only its face shows, the stone covered in fine weathered cracks, at its center the carved slots for five characters in a row with white light pouring out of them, lighting the grains of snow on the stone.

subject.zh: 凿碑拓片：一张薄白纸上拓着黑色的碑面，满纸是一道压一道的凿痕纹路，凿痕的缝里有五处透着光的空白，纸角拓着一圈凿子落下的白冕形印记。
subject.en: A rubbing of the chiseled stele: thin white paper bearing a black rubbing of the stone face, covered in chisel marks laid one over another, five pale gaps in the cracks where light came through, and in the corner the imprint of a white crown ring left by the chisel.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。五处空白里不拓出字形。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. No letterforms appear in the five gaps.

subject.en: Valda's broken sword: a broad black iron two-handed greatsword, its blade twice the width of an ordinary sword and covered in old battle scars, snapped through the middle with a jagged break, a strip of faded dark red cloth wrapped near the break.

subject.en: A silver dragon's eye opening in the water of the court mirror: in the middle of a silver gray mirror-like water surface a huge eye opens, its slit pupil long and narrow, its lids covered in grains of snow and tiny silver scales, ripples spreading ring after ring around it.

subject.en: An old letter: heavy cream paper folded in three, the folds softened, the edges faintly yellowed, the closure pressed with a dark red wax seal whose edge has run down in one drip as if it had melted, only pale gray ruled lines on the page.
