extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The seventh letter: unfolded, its dark red wax split in two with a small piece fallen aside; at the signature a line drawing of a small half open door (not writing), otherwise only gray ruled lines.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。以 art_prop_cut_barony_letter 为参照；半开的门是线描，不是门扉金的光。

subject.zh: 瓦尔妲的断剑：一把宽刃黑铁双手大剑，剑身比普通的剑宽一倍，刃面满是旧战痕，剑身中段断开，断口参差，断口附近缠着一段褪色的暗红布条。
subject.en: Valda's broken sword: a broad black iron two-handed greatsword, its blade twice the width of an ordinary sword and covered in old battle scars, snapped through the middle with a jagged break, a strip of faded dark red cloth wrapped near the break.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 1 帧（接好的剑）：断口只剩一道细细的接缝，剑横放在白色长桌上。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 1 (the mended sword): only a fine seam left where it broke, the sword lying across a white long table.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。多帧特写的第 1 帧，共 2 帧；后续帧为 art_prop_cut_sword_joined_2 起的条目，以本帧为参照图，导入时按编号顺序组成帧序列。按 a6_sword_returned 择一使用；以 art_prop_cut_sword_tip 为参照。

subject.zh: 瓦尔妲的断剑：一把宽刃黑铁双手大剑，剑身比普通的剑宽一倍，刃面满是旧战痕，剑身中段断开，断口参差，断口附近缠着一段褪色的暗红布条。
subject.en: Valda's broken sword: a broad black iron two-handed greatsword, its blade twice the width of an ordinary sword and covered in old battle scars, snapped through the middle with a jagged break, a strip of faded dark red cloth wrapped near the break.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。第 2 帧（未接回）：只有断剑横放在白色长桌上，剑尖不在。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Frame 2 (not mended): only the broken sword lying across the white long table, the tip absent.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。第 2 帧，共 2 帧：以 art_prop_cut_sword_joined 为参照图生成，取景、物件大小与位置和第 1 帧完全一致，只改补充说明里写的变化。按 a6_sword_returned 择一使用；以 art_prop_cut_sword_tip 为参照。

subject.zh: 推过长桌的账册与门钥：白色长桌上一摞深褐皮面的厚账册，封面压着金色的包角，账册前一枚枚古钥匙排成一列，钥匙柄的形状与材质各不相同。
subject.en: Ledgers and door keys pushed across the long table: a stack of thick dark brown leather ledgers with gold corner pieces on a white long table, and before them a row of ancient keys laid out one by one, their bows all of different shapes and materials.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。不画推账册的人与手。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Do not draw who pushes the ledgers, nor their hands.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。钥匙不发光；排列整齐像在交账。

subject.zh: 灵泉的记忆：一双纤细的手捧着一团柔和的光，光里隐约有水波的纹理，透出淡绿与白金两种颜色，光的边缘像水一样微微流动，指缝间漏出几粒光点。
subject.en: A memory of the spirit spring: two slender hands cupping a soft ball of light with faint water ripple patterns inside, glowing pale green and white gold, its rim flowing slightly like water, a few motes of light slipping between the fingers.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。手只画到手腕，不画袖口与饰物。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. The hands are drawn only to the wrists, no cuffs or ornaments.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。光用有限色阶表现，不画平滑渐变。

subject.zh: 最后的记录：一本厚书摊开的最后一页，米黄纸面上排着流畅工整的墨行，写到倒数第二行停住，最后一行换成另一种笔迹，笔画粗细不匀，写得很慢。
subject.en: The last record: the final page of a thick book lying open, flowing neat lines of ink across the cream paper stopping at the second to last line, the last line in a different hand, its strokes uneven in weight, written slowly.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。墨行都是不可读的笔画，两种笔迹只靠笔触区分。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. All the ink lines are unreadable strokes; the two hands differ only by their strokes.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。后日谈的文字由引擎叠加，这张卡只交代两种笔迹。

subject.zh: 握在手里的一部智能手机：黑色窄边机身套着一只磨旧的透明壳，屏幕亮着一片空白的冷白光，握着它的手只露出拇指与几根手指，指节微微发红。
subject.en: A smartphone held in a hand: a black narrow-bezel body in a worn clear case, its screen lit with a blank cold white glow; only the thumb and a few fingers of the holding hand show, the knuckles slightly red.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。屏幕上亮着一块浅色的消息气泡区域，气泡里留空，消息由引擎叠加；画面带一点清晨的光。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. A pale message bubble area glows on the screen, left blank inside for the engine; a touch of early morning light in the frame.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。以 art_prop_cut_phone 为参照，同一部手机；不画品牌标志。

subject.zh: 审庭的庭之席：一把由门木长成的椅子，从白石地板的裂纹里长出来，木纹天然，椅背的纹理是一扇半开的门，新木色带一点暖金微光，约 1.2 米高。
subject.en: The Garden's Seat of the tribunal: a chair grown from door wood, rising out of a crack in the white stone floor, its grain natural, the grain of its back forming a half open door, fresh wood color with a faint warm gold glow, about 1.2 m tall.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。只画椅背上半部的近景：椅背木纹里新长出一圈年轮，年轮的线比别处更亮。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. A close-up of the upper back only: a new growth ring has appeared in the grain of the back, its line brighter than the rest.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。以 art_prop_cut_garden_seat 为参照，同一把椅子。

subject.zh: 神之账本的一页：一本厚重账本摊开的一页，纸面画满整齐的表格，格子里只有一列列数字的位置，没有一个词，页边用尺子画着一条笔直的红线。
subject.en: A page of the god's ledger: one page of a heavy ledger lying open, filled with neat tables whose cells hold only columns of places for numbers and not a single word, a perfectly straight red line ruled down the margin.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。数字由引擎叠加，格子里只画极淡的点位。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The numbers are overlaid by the engine; the cells hold only very faint dots.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。冷而整齐，像一张没有人情的报表。

subject.zh: 门楣上破壳的影子雏鸦：一扇旧门的木门楣上搁着一枚暗色的蛋，蛋壳裂开，钻出一只由影子凝成的小雏鸦，黑得没有细节，只有一只眼睛映着门光。
subject.en: A shadow fledgling hatching on a door lintel: on the wooden lintel of an old door rests a dark egg, its shell cracking open as a tiny raven chick made of shadow pushes out, black without detail but for one eye catching the door light.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。门光从门缝透上来，照亮蛋壳的碎边。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Door light rising from the seam lights the broken edge of the shell.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。雏鸦是纯粹的影子，没有羽毛细节；眼睛是唯一的亮点。

subject.zh: 撕下的半页：一页书被斜着撕下一半，残留的半页米黄纸上是一行流畅的墨迹，写到一半就断在撕口，撕口的纸纤维毛茸茸地翘起。
subject.en: Half a torn page: a book page torn diagonally in half, the remaining cream half bearing one flowing line of ink that breaks off midway at the tear, the paper fibers at the torn edge sticking up fuzzily.

extra.zh: 过场插画卡：这张纸面（或卡面）正对镜头平铺，纸的材质、边缘、折痕与印记画清楚；画面上下两端各约八分之一只是纸面的延续，导入时裁掉，印、封蜡与要紧的细节不要放进这两段；要写字的地方只画浅灰行线或留白，由引擎叠加文字。墨迹不可读，半句话由引擎叠加。
extra.en: Cutscene illustration card: the sheet (or card) faces the camera flat, its material, edges, creases and marks clearly drawn; the top and bottom eighth of the canvas only continue the paper and are cropped on import, so keep seals, wax and important details out of them; where writing belongs draw only pale gray ruled lines or leave it blank, the engine overlays the text. The ink is unreadable; the half sentence is overlaid by the engine.

items.notes: 过场插画卡：导入时裁掉上下各八分之一，取中部正方形缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示；ui_card 是平面插画，与像素特写卡并用。墨迹与莫伊拉的卷轴、最后的记录同一种笔触。

subject.zh: 桌上的一封信：一张对折过的米白信纸摊在桌面上，旁边是拆开的信封与一枚蜡封，信纸上只有几行很淡的灰色线条，看不出写了什么，纸角压着一支钢笔。
subject.en: A letter on the desk: a cream sheet once folded in half lying open on the desktop beside its opened envelope and a wax seal, the page bearing only a few very faint grey lines that cannot be read, a pen weighing down one corner.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。近景只看拆开的信封正面：收信人的位置留空，名字由界面层叠加；信纸与钢笔在画面边缘。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Close in on the face of the opened envelope: the addressee space is blank, the name is overlaid by the interface layer; the letter and the pen stay at the edge of the frame.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与场景道具 art_prop_maker_letter 是同一封信，以它为参照。

subject.zh: 一叠草稿纸：几十张泛黄的纸散乱叠在一起，最上面几张用铅笔般的灰线画着一块大陆的轮廓、山脉记号与六个站立的袍服人形速写，笔触松散，与本作的画风明显不同，但仍是像素画。
subject.en: A stack of drafts: dozens of yellowed sheets piled untidily, the top few sketched in pencil-like grey lines with the outline of a continent, mountain marks and six standing robed figures, the strokes loose and clearly different from the game's own style, yet still pixel art.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。近景：最上面几张草稿摊开，能看清大陆的草图与六个袍服人形的速写，旁边一张表格被一遍遍划掉；笔触松散，与游戏内立绘的画风略有不同。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Close-up: the top drafts spread out, the continent sketch and the six robed figures readable, beside them a table crossed out again and again; loose strokes, a little different in style from the in-game portraits.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与场景道具 art_prop_maker_drafts 是同一叠草稿；速写只是袍服人形，不画出任何一位女神的可辨面貌；表格不写字。

subject.zh: 西墙的石板：一块约 1.5 米高的灰色旧石板靠墙立着，表面打磨平整，正中刻着一个大大的符号：几道横竖与斜笔交叠，像一个字却不属于任何文字，刻痕里积着细灰。
subject.en: The stone tablet on the west wall: an old grey slab about 1.5 m tall leaning against the wall, its face ground smooth, a single large sign carved at its center: a few horizontal, vertical and slanting strokes overlapping, looking like a written character yet belonging to no script at all, fine dust gathered in the grooves.

extra.zh: 过场特写卡：只画这一件物件的近景特写，物件放大到占满画面的七八成，构图集中在画面中部的正方形范围内，不按每米 16 像素的尺度，也不必贴住画面底边；物件所在的桌面、柜台或石面只画紧挨着它的一小块，其余仍是洋红背景；近景的材质细节用像素画清楚，画面里不出现任何可读的文字。近景只看石板正中的那个大符号，刻痕里积着细灰。
extra.en: Cutscene close-up card: draw only this one object as a close-up, enlarged to fill seventy to eighty percent of the frame and composed within a square area at the middle of the canvas, not at the 16 pixels per meter scale and not resting on the bottom edge; where it rests on a table, counter or stone draw only the small patch right around it and keep the magenta background elsewhere; render the close-up material detail in clear pixels, with no readable writing anywhere in the image. Close in on the large sign at the center of the slab, fine dust in its grooves.

items.notes: 过场特写卡：导入时取画面中部的正方形，缩为 256 乘 256，放大两倍显示。与场景道具 art_prop_maker_tablet 是同一块石板；符号像一个字却不属于任何文字，审核时确认它不像任何现实文字。
